hero.sub: ʻIke a me ka hoʻoponopono hōʻoia no ka Vortex pūnaewele peer-to-peer. Wehe. Hoʻopili ʻia. ʻAʻole hiki ke kāohi.

network.label: NETWORK
network.body: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia hoa i kahi ʻike pūlima. Hōʻoia nā mea kūʻai aku ma mua o ka hoʻopili ʻana, hōʻoia nā nodes i ke kuleana ma ke kau inoa ʻana. ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻopunipuni kekahi mana koʻikoʻi i ka mea i hōʻoia ʻia e ka cryptography.
network.stat_dual_sub: i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma ke kaulahao
network.dual_body: Hoʻopaʻa ʻia me ka mea hoʻoponopono AND i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma ke kaulahao ma o Solana. ʻElua mau mea hōʻike kūʻokoʻa e hōʻoia i ka code hash a me ka pubkey. Palekana no nā kau koʻikoʻi.
network.ctrl_body: Hōʻike ka pūlima i ka node i kāna kī pilikino, akā ʻaʻole i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka pono code ma ke kaulahao. Maikaʻi no ka hapa nui o nā kau; pilikia = hilinai i ka mea hooponopono.
network.unverif_body: ʻIke ʻia mai ka config a i ʻole gossip. ʻAʻohe hōʻike cryptographic i kēia manawa. E hoʻohana wale i ka bootstrap i ka papa inoa o nā hoa - ʻaʻole loa ma ke ʻano he pahuhopu lima no nā kau ola.
network.cta_browse: E nānā i nā node a pau →

security.label: SECURITY
security.body: ʻEhā mau kī kī kūʻokoʻa Ed25519, kēlā me kēia me kahi hana haiki. ʻAʻole e uhaʻi ʻia nā kī ʻē aʻe i ka hoʻololi ʻana i kekahi kī.
security.release_verified: Nā mea kūʻai - paʻi ʻia i ka manawa kūkulu
security.controller_signs: ʻO kēlā me kēia uku pane /v1/*
security.controller_verified: Nā mea kūʻai mai - mai SNS a i ʻole kūkulu i ka pine
security.node_signs: Kakau inoa a me ka puʻuwai
security.node_verified: Mea hooponopono — ma ke kakau inoa
security.user_signs: Nā hōʻailona hālāwai, nā envelopes memo
security.user_verified: Loaʻa i ka node wale nō
security.step1_d: Heluhelu vortexx.sol ma ke kaulahao. Nā moʻolelo i pūlima ʻia e ka ʻeke kālā Solana — hiki ʻole ke DNS-hijack.
security.step2_d: Kāhea ka mea kūʻai aku iā /v1/integrity. Hōʻole i kekahi pane koe wale status: verified mai ke kī hoʻokuʻu paʻa.
security.step3_d: ʻO kēlā me kēia API kelepona e hoʻi mai i {payload, sig, signed_by}. Hōʻoia ka mea kūʻai i ka inoa Ed25519 ma mua o ka hilinaʻi.
security.step4_d: Nā ʻōpū i hoʻopaʻa ʻia: heluhelu ka mea kūʻai aku i ka code_hash mai ke kākau inoa ʻo Solana. Hoʻokaʻawale mai ka mea hoʻoponopono = papa inoa ʻeleʻele mau loa.
security.check_auth: ʻOiaʻiʻo pane — hiki ʻole ke hoʻopololei i ka /v1/nodes me ka ʻole o ke kī pilikino o ka mea hoʻoponopono.
security.check_integrity: Code integrity — hoʻopili ʻia nā faila hoʻoponopono a nānā ʻia i kēlā me kēia hoʻomaka. Hoʻihoʻi ʻo Tampering i 503 ma mua o ka lawelawe ʻia ʻana o kekahi kaʻa.
security.check_identity: Node identity — pono nā node e kau inoa me kā lākou kī ponoʻī. ʻAʻole hiki i ka mea hoʻouka ke hoʻopaʻa inoa ma ka inoa o ka pubkey o kekahi node.
security.check_dns: DNS hijack protection — .sol records live on Solana. Pono ka ʻenemi e hoʻololi i ka ʻeke kālā, ʻaʻole ka mea kākau inoa DNS wale nō.
security.check_handoff: Handoff security — lawe ʻia nā hōʻailona hōʻailona Ed25519 me ka anti-replay, pono 5 mau minuke wale nō. Hōʻole ka pahuhopu i nā kumu ʻike ʻole.
security.check_transport: Ka pilikino — pili URL ʻike ʻia e kāu ISP / Cloudflare. E hoʻohana i ke aniani Tor inā pono ka metadata.
security.check_content: Maʻiʻo memo — NOT hoʻopā ʻia e ka mea hoʻoponopono. Hoʻopili ʻia ma waena o nā mea hoʻohana. ʻAʻole hiki i ka Controller ke heluhelu i kekahi mea inā ʻaʻole i hoʻopaʻa ʻia.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel — inā paʻa ka VPS, hiki ke ʻaihue ʻia nā kī. E hoʻohana i ka pūlima i kākoʻo ʻia e nā lako hana no nā hoʻolaha paranoid.

access.label: ACCESS
access.heading_line1: Hiki ke loaʻa i nā manawa a pau.
access.body: ʻO ka nui o nā helu komo, ʻaʻole hiki i kahi hui ke ālai i kāu komo. Hāʻawi nā pūnaewele aniani i nā ʻike like ʻole i pūlima ʻia mai nā ʻōnaehana kūʻokoʻa.
access.tunnel_body: He helu *.trycloudflare.com manuahi. ʻAʻohe moʻokāki pono. Hoʻololi ka URL i ka wā e hoʻomaka hou ai ka tunnel - mālama ʻia e like me ka ephemeral.
access.tor_body: .onion address, hiki ke hiki wale ma o Tor. Hōʻoiaʻiʻo a me ka metadata-private, akā lohi. Pono ka mea kūʻai aku Tor.
access.ipfs_body: ʻO ke kope i hoʻoponopono ʻia ma ka ʻikepili o ka ʻaoʻao paʻa. Hiki i kēlā me kēia ʻīpuka IPFS ke lawelawe iā ia — ʻaʻohe kikowaena hoʻokahi e ālai.
access.direct_body: Paena maʻamau + TLS. ʻO ke koho wikiwiki loa. Hiki ke ālai ʻia ma ka pae DNS/IP — hāʻule hou i nā poʻe ʻē aʻe inā hoʻopaʻa ʻia.
access.mirrors_body: ʻO nā mea hoʻokipa ʻē aʻe e lawelawe ana i ka maʻiʻo i hoʻopaʻa ʻia e like me kēia mea hoʻoponopono. Hoʻopili ʻia kēlā me kēia aniani i kēlā me kēia manawa - ʻo ke kiko ʻōmaʻomaʻo e hiki ke loaʻa i loko o nā minuke 5 i hala. ʻAʻole hiki ke nānā ʻia nā aniani Tor .onion me ka ʻole o kahi koho Tor kūloko.

start.label: GET STARTED
start.step1: E hoʻouka i ka Vortex ma kāu kelepona — kelepona a i ʻole papapihi.
start.step2: E koho i ke ʻano pūnaewele Global ma ka wizard hoʻonohonoho.
start.step3: Hoʻopili i ka mea hoʻoponopono URL (auto-hoʻoholo ʻia ma o SNS) a i ʻole entry URL mai ka ʻaoʻao Entries.
start.step4: E hōʻoia i ka pubkey ma kāu app e like me ka mea hoʻoponopono manamana lima ma lalo. ʻO ka mismatch, ʻo ia hoʻi ka hana ʻino.
start.step5: Pili ʻoe. Hoʻohana ʻia ka papa inoa node, pūlima, a me ke ala ala akomi.
start.fingerprint_note: E paʻi i kēia kī i kāu mea kūʻai ma mua o ka hilinaʻi ʻana i kekahi pane.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS
treasury.transparency_title: ʻO ka māliko ma ke kaulahao
treasury.transparency_body: ʻO nā kumukūʻai protocol āpau - nā uku hoʻopaʻa inoa node a me kahi ʻoki 20% o nā kau inoa premium - kahe i ka ʻeke waihona kālā ma Solana. ʻO kēlā me kēia kālepa e hōʻoia ʻia e kekahi.
treasury.rewards_title: Ka uku o ka mea hana
treasury.rewards_body: ʻO 70% o kēlā me kēia sub premium e hele i ka loko wai uku, hāʻawi ʻia i ka pro-rata i nā mea hana node ikaika. 20% kālā hoʻomohala kumu. 10% puhi a noho paha ma ke ʻano he ʻinikua.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Kuhi ʻōlelo
gravitixDocs.subtitle: He ʻōlelo kākau moʻolelo kiʻekiʻe no ke kūkulu ʻana i nā bots. 96 hiʻona. ʻO ke kua hope.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: ʻO Gravitix kahi ʻōlelo domain-specific (DSL) i hoʻolālā ʻia mai ka honua aʻe no ke kākau ʻana i nā bots Vortex. Ma kahi e makemake ai nā ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe i nā hale waihona puke, callbacks, a me ka boilerplate, hāʻawi ʻo Gravitix iā ʻoe i nā mea hoʻokele hanana papa mua, nā kahe kamaʻilio, a me ka mokuʻāina i kūkulu ʻia - nā mea āpau ma kahi syntax maʻemaʻe a hiki ke heluhelu ʻia i hoʻoulu ʻia e Rust.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Hiki ke heluhelu — heluhelu ʻia ke code e like me ka manaʻo, ʻaʻole me ka mīkini
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Palekana - hopu nā ʻano static i nā hewa ma mua o ka wā holo
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Hōʻike - hoʻokomo ʻia nā kahe, nā kiaʻi, a me ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i ke ʻano
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Ka liʻiliʻi - ʻaʻohe papa, ʻaʻohe hoʻoilina, ʻaʻohe papa hana e aʻo ai
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: ʻO Gravitix no ka poʻe makemake e kūkulu wikiwiki i kahi bot Vortex - inā ʻaʻole ʻoe i kākau i nā code ma mua, a i ʻole he mea hoʻomohala loea i luhi i ka Python boilerplate. Ke aʻo nei kēia ʻōlelo iā Gravitix mai nā kumu mua: ʻaʻohe pono o ka ʻike mua.
gravitixDocs.howToRead: Pehea e heluhelu ai i kēia kuhikuhi
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Hoʻokumu kēlā me kēia ʻāpana i nā mea mua. Inā he mea hou ʻoe i ka polokalamu, e heluhelu mai luna a lalo. Inā ʻike mua ʻoe i ka ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe, e hoʻohana i ka papa ʻike e lele pololei i kāu mea hoihoi.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: ʻO ke ala wikiwiki loa mai ka zero a i ka bot holo.
gravitixDocs.whatHappened: He aha ka mea i hana ʻia?
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: on /start { ... } — wehewehe i ka mea lawelawe e holo ana ke hoʻouna ka mea hoʻohana /start. emit "..." - hoʻouna i kahi leka i ka mea hoʻohana. {ctx.first_name} — hoʻopili i ka inoa mua o ka mea hoʻohana i ke kaula.
gravitixDocs.runningTheBot: Ke holo nei i ka bot
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Ma ka Gravitix IDE, e kaomi i ke pihi holo ma ka pahu luna. E hoʻokomo i kāu Vortex Bot Token ke koi ʻia. Hoʻomaka koke ka bot - ʻaʻohe hana kūkulu e pono ai.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Hoʻokumu ʻia kēlā me kēia papahana Gravitix mai ʻekolu mau poloka kūkulu kumu: nā mea lawelawe, nā ʻōlelo emit, a me nā loina.

gravitixDocs.operatorPrecedence: Ka mua o ka mea hana

gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Hoʻohālikelike-hoʻohālikelike i kahi waiwai me nā mamana he nui. E noʻonoʻo iā ia he ʻōlelo hoʻololi ikaika.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: ʻO nā hana he mau poloka code i hoʻohana hou ʻia. Kōkua lākou iā ʻoe e pale i ka hana hou ʻana a e maʻalahi ka hoʻomaopopo ʻana i ke code.

gravitixDocs.guardDesc: ʻAe nā kiaʻi iā ʻoe e hoʻohui i kahi kūlana i kahi mea lawelawe. Holo wale ka mea lawelawe inā loiloi ke kiaʻi i ka ʻoiaʻiʻo.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: Loaʻa ka mea ctx i loko o kēlā me kēia mea lawelawe. Loaʻa iā ia ka ʻike e pili ana i ka memo o kēia manawa a me ka mea hoʻohana nāna i hoʻouna.

bestpractices.h2: 2. E hōʻoia i ka hoʻokomo mea hoʻohana
bestpractices.h3: 3. E hoʻohana i nā guards ma kahi o nā kaulahao inā no nā ʻae
bestpractices.h4: 4. Wehe i ka loiloi i loko o nā hana
bestpractices.h5: 5. E hoʻohana mua i ka return e hōʻemi i ka pūnana
bestpractices.h6: 6. E inoa maopopo i nā mea
bestpractices.h7: 7. Hoʻoponopono hou i ka state me ka akahele
bestpractices.h8: 8. E hoʻohana i ka state e pale aku i ka spam
bestpractices.p1: ʻO nā hiʻohiʻona a me nā maʻamau e ʻoi aku ka hilinaʻi o kāu mau bots Gravitix, hiki ke heluhelu ʻia a mālama ʻia.
bestpractices.p2: Pono e loaʻa i kēlā me kēia bot kahi mea hoʻokele hāʻule on msg i loaʻa mau i nā mea hoʻohana i ka pane:
bestpractices.p3: Mai noʻonoʻo pono i ka mea i hoʻouna ʻia e ka mea hoʻohana:
bestpractices.p4: E mālama pōkole i nā mea lawelawe. E hoʻoneʻe i ka loina paʻakikī i nā hana i kapa ʻia:
bestpractices.p6: ʻO ke ala maikaʻi loa e aʻo ai i ka Gravitix ʻo ke kūkulu ʻana. E hoʻomaka me ka simple echo bot, a laila hoʻohui i ka state, a laila hoʻohui i ka flows. ʻO kēlā me kēia manaʻo hou āu e aʻo ai e wehe i nā mea hiki.

bestpractices.h1_b: Implementation overview for "1. E mālama mau i nā mea i ʻike ʻole ʻia". The mechanism is implemented in the corresponding module under `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, or `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. The module README calls out exact file paths.
bestpractices.h1_c: The "1. E mālama mau i nā mea i ʻike ʻole ʻia" mechanism evolved across Vortex releases. The design traces back to published research and production practices of prior messengers. Version history in `CHANGELOG.md` records when each piece landed and what motivated it.

intro.li1: Heluhelu — heluhelu ʻia ke code e like me ka manaʻo, ʻaʻole nā mīkini.
intro.li2: Safe — nā ʻano static catch hewa ma mua o ka wā holo
intro.li3: Expressive — flows, guards, and pattern matching is built-in
intro.li4: Minimal — ʻaʻohe papa, ʻaʻohe hoʻoilina, ʻaʻohe papa hana e aʻo ai.
intro.p1: ʻO Gravitix he ʻōlelo kikoʻī domain (DSL) i hoʻolālā ʻia mai ka honua aʻe no ke kākau ʻana i nā bots Vortex. Ma kahi o nā ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe e makemake ai i nā hale waihona puke, callbacks, a me ka boilerplate, Gravitix hāʻawi iā ʻoe i nā mea hoʻokele hanana papa mua, kamaʻilio flows, a me state i kūkulu ʻia - nā mea āpau i loko o kahi syntax maʻemaʻe a hiki ke heluhelu ʻia e Rust.
intro.p2: Gravitix no ka mea makemake e kūkulu i ka Vortex bot me ka wikiwiki — inā ʻaʻole ʻoe i kākau i ke code ma mua, a i ʻole he mea hoʻomohala loea ʻoe i luhi i ka Python boilerplate. Ke aʻo nei kēia kuhikuhi i ka Gravitix mai nā loina mua: ʻaʻohe pono o ka ʻike mua.
intro.p3: Hoʻokumu kēlā me kēia ʻāpana i nā mea mua. Inā he mea hou ʻoe i ka polokalamu, e heluhelu mai luna a lalo. Inā ʻike mua ʻoe i ka ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe, e hoʻohana i ka papa ʻike e lele pololei i kāu mea hoihoi.
intro.p4: Ma kēia ʻōlelo a pau, ʻo → ʻo ia ka "e loiloi i" a i ʻole "hoʻopuka", a ʻo // ... hōʻike i nā manaʻo i mālama ʻole ʻia e ka mea hoʻopili.

math_special.p1: ʻO ka Gamma hana Γ(n) ʻo ia ka hoʻomau mau o ka factorial: Γ(n) = (n−1)! no na huina kupono. Hoʻonui ia i ka factorial i nā helu maoli a paʻakikī.
math_special.p2: ʻO ka hana hewa erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t²)dt ka mea hoʻohui o ka Gaussian. Pili pololei ia i ka CDF maʻamau a ʻike ʻia ma nā hoʻohālikelike wela a me ke kumumanaʻo probability.
math_special.p3: ζ(s) = Σ 1/nˢ no n=1,2,3,… (ke Re(s)>1). Hoʻopili i ka hāʻawi mua ʻana ma o ka huahana Euler. ʻO ka Riemann Hypothesis (ʻaʻole i hoʻoholo ʻia!) pili i nā zero o ζ i ka mokulele paʻakikī.
math_special.p4: ʻO nā hana Bessel Jₙ(x) a me Yₙ(x) he mau hoʻonā i ka hoʻohālikelike ʻokoʻa o Bessel: x²y'' + xy' + (x²−n²)y = 0. Hōʻike ʻia lākou i ka hoʻolaha ʻana o ka nalu, ka hoʻoheheʻe ʻana i ka wela ma nā cylinders, a me ka mechanics quantum.
math_special.p5: ʻO Ai(x) a me Bi(x) nā haʻina no y'' = xy. Hōʻike ʻia lākou ma ka quantum tunneling (WKB approximation) a me optics (diffraction).
math_special.p6: Ke kū nei kēia mau ʻohana polynomial ma ke ʻano he eigenfunction o nā mea hana nui a hoʻohana ʻia i nā ʻano spectral, quadrature, a me quantum mechanics.
math_special.p7: K(k) a me E(k) he mau huikau elliptic piha o ke ano mua a me ka lua. Hoʻopili lākou i ka manawa o kahi pendulum nonlinear a me ke anapuni o kahi ellipse.
math_special.td1: Γ(x) = ∫₀^∞ tˣ⁻¹e⁻ᵗdt. Hoʻopili ʻo Lanczos. Γ(n+1)=n!
math_special.td2: ln|Γ(x)|. Avoids ʻoi akuflow no x nui.
math_special.td5: Pₙ(x): orthogonal ma [−1,1]. ʻO ka ʻāpana angular o nā hawewe hydrogen.
math_special.td6: Hₙ(x): orthogonal w.r.t. e^(−x²). Kuantum harmonic oscillator.
math_special.td7: Tₙ(x) = cos(n·acos(x)): ka hoʻohālikelike polynomial maikaʻi loa.
math_special.td8: Lₙ(x): orthogonal ma [0,∞) w.r.t. e^(−x). Nā hana hawewe radial hydrogen.

architexDocs.title: Hōʻike ʻōlelo Architex
architexDocs.subtitle: He ʻōlelo hoʻolaha UI no Vortex Mini Apps. ʻO ke kūlana hoʻolalelale, nā papa hana haku mele, ʻaʻohe pae kūkulu.
architexDocs.introDesc: ʻO Architex kahi huaʻōlelo liʻiliʻi DSL i hoʻolālā ʻia e hoʻouna i UI i loko o ka Vortex ʻelele. E wehewehe ʻoe i ke ʻano o ka pale; Mālama ka runtime i nā pika me ka mokuʻāina. ʻAʻohe DOM virtual, ʻaʻohe puʻupuʻu, ʻaʻohe JSX - ʻo ka faila `.arx` ka app.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Hōʻike - kākau ʻoe i ka UI āu e makemake ai, ʻaʻole i nā ʻanuʻu e kūkulu ai
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~ helu += 1` a me kēlā me kēia lepili e heluhelu ana e hoʻonui ʻia ma kahi
architexDocs.goalPortable: Hiki ke lawe — e holo ana ka `.arx` ma ka punaewele, IOS, a me ka Android me ka hooponopono ole
architexDocs.goalTiny: Liʻiliʻi — parser + renderer moku ma lalo o 30 KB, no laila Mini App wehe koke
architexDocs.goalReadable: Hiki ke heluhelu ʻia - ʻo ka indentation ke ʻano; ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā mea hoʻololi me `::`; ʻaʻohe ʻauhau kiko
architexDocs.whoDesc: ʻO ka poʻe makemake e hoʻouna i kahi pale pānaʻi ma Vortex — palapala kūʻai, dashboards, ʻaoʻao koho, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Inā ua kākau ʻoe i ka HTML+CSS+JS, e ʻike ʻo Architex i kamaʻāina akā ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki e kākau. Inā ʻaʻole ʻoe, ʻo Architex kahi hoʻolauna haʻahaʻa i ka hoʻolālā reactive no ka mea ʻoi aku ka liʻiliʻi o ka ʻōlelo.
architexDocs.howToRead: Pehea e heluhelu ai i keia kuhikuhi
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Hoʻokumu kēlā me kēia ʻāpana i ka mea ma mua. E hoʻomaka ma ka hoʻomaka wikiwiki, a laila heluhelu i ka Syntax, State, Layout, Modifiers, Actions, a me ka ʻāpana kiʻekiʻe ma hope. E lele a puni ma o ka papa ʻike inā ʻike mua ʻoe iā React a i ʻole Svelte - maʻemaʻe ka palapala manaʻo.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: ʻO ke ala pōkole loa mai kahi faila hakahaka i kahi holo Mini App.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@pale Aloha

  ~ inoa = "honua"

  col :: pad(24) āpau(12) kikowaena

    poʻomanaʻo "Aloha, {~inoa}!" :: nui wiwo ʻole(28)

    hookomo ~inoa :: pad(8) radius(6) palena(#ccc)

    kikokiko "E kikokiko i kahi inoa ma luna - e hoʻohou kēia kikokikona i kou paʻi ʻana."
      :: nui(12) kala(#888)
architexDocs.whatHappened: He aha ka mea i hana ʻia?
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` hai mai ke kumu. `~inoa = "honua"` hana i kahi hoʻololi hoʻololi. ʻO `col`, `header`, `input`, `text` nā mea i kūkulu ʻia. `::` hoʻopili i nā mea hoʻololi (padding, kala, nui). Ke hoʻokomo ka mea hoʻohana i ka mea hoʻokomo, hoʻohou kēlā me kēia '{~name}` - ʻaʻohe uwea, ʻaʻohe kau inoa, ʻaʻohe hāʻawi lima.
architexDocs.runningIt: Ke holo nei i ka pale
architexDocs.runningItDesc: E wehe i ka pā Architex ma ka Vortex bot studio, e hoʻopili i ke code, e kaomi iā Run. Hāʻawi ka manawa holo i ka pane ʻike a me ka hoʻouka hou ʻana i ka mālama. Ke hoʻopuka ʻoe, wehe kāu mea hoʻohana i ka polokalamu mai kekahi kamaʻilio - ʻaʻohe mea hoʻokomo.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Hana ʻia kēlā me kēia papahana Architex i ʻehā mau mea: nā ʻōlelo hoʻomaka me ka `@`, nā mea hoʻololi hoʻololi i hoʻopaʻa mua ʻia me ka `~`, nā ʻāpana i kākau ʻia ma ke ʻano he mau mea hōʻike, a me nā mea hoʻololi i hoʻopili ʻia ma hope o `::`.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: ʻ@Ka inoa ʻo ka pale, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, a me `@no ka mea i loko o ~papa inoa` hoʻomaka nā mea a pau ma ke kolamu 0. No kēlā poloka nā mea a pau i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma lalo o lākou.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Noho nā ʻāpana ma ko lākou laina ponoʻī: `text`, `button`, `image`, `header`, `label`, `badge`, `divider`, `col`, `laina`. ʻO kā lākou hoʻopaʻapaʻa kūlana ma hope pono o ka inoa: `text ~message`, `button "Save"`,`image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Ma hope o `::` hiki iā ʻoe ke kaulahao i nā mea hoʻololi e like me kou makemake. Lawe ʻia kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo hoʻopaʻapaʻa ʻaʻohe a ʻoi aku paha i loko o nā pale: `:: pad(24) gap(16) kikowaena bold nui(20) kala(#4f8ef7)`. He kūlana kūlana nā mea hoʻololi, ʻaʻole huaʻōlelo - ʻaʻole pili ke kauoha koe wale nō nā mea kākau hope-lanakila e like me 'color'.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: ʻ=>` ma kahi pihi (a i ʻole kekahi mea pili) e holo i ka haʻawina a i ʻole kelepona hana ma hope. Nui `=>` kaulahao ma ka ʻaoʻao: ` pihi "Submit" => ~busy = ʻoiaʻiʻo => hoʻouna (hana: "mālama", ʻikepili: ~form)`.
architexDocs.variablesAndTypes: Nā ʻano like ʻole a me nā ʻano
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: ʻO kēlā me kēia inoa i kau mua ʻia me `~` he cell reactive. Kākau i ka `~ helu = 0` e haʻi aku, `~ helu = 5` no ka hoʻonoho hou ʻana, `~ helu += 1` e hoʻohou. ʻO kēlā me kēia UI node e heluhelu ana i ke kelepona — pololei a i ʻole ma ka interpolation — e hoʻihoʻi hou i ka wā e loli ai ke kelepona.
architexDocs.computedVars: Nā mea hoʻololi i helu ʻia
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: E hoʻohana i ka `:=` ma kahi o `=` no ka haʻi ʻana i kahi huaʻōlelo helu: `~total := ~helu * ~step`. Hoʻololi hou ka ʻaoʻao ʻākau i ka wā e loli ai kekahi hilinaʻi. ʻAʻohe kau inoa lima a ʻaʻohe pahu waiwai paʻa - inā heluhelu ʻoe i ka '~a' ma kahi o ka ʻōlelo, hilinaʻi ʻoe iā ia.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: He koho wale nō nā hōʻikeʻike akā kōkua me ka hoʻopiha piha ʻana a me nā memo hewa: `~ helu: helu = 0`, `~inoa: string = ""`, `~ok: boolean = false`, `~ 'ikamu: array = []`, `~mea hoʻohana: mea = {}`. Inā hoʻokuʻu ʻoe iā lākou, ʻike ʻia ke ʻano mai ka initialiser.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `helu`, `string`, `boolean`, `hui`, `mea`, `null`. Hāʻawi ʻia nā lā a me nā pōpō e like me nā kaula a me nā mea. Hoʻohana ka wā holo i nā lula koi a JavaScript ma lalo o ka puʻupuʻu, no laila e hana ʻo `~count + 1` inā hoʻomaka ʻo `~count` i ke ola ma ke ʻano he kaula.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Hiki i kēlā me kēia kaula ke hoʻokomo i nā manaʻo me `{...}`: `"Aloha, {~user.name}!"`, `"Total: {~helu * ~price}"`. Hoʻololi mau ka interpolation.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Loaʻa iā Architex ʻelua mau ipu i haku ʻia a me nā ʻāpana lau he kakini. E hoʻopaʻa iā lākou me ka indentation - ʻaʻohe hōʻailona pani.
architexDocs.containers: Nā pahu: col a me ka lālani
architexDocs.containersDesc: Hoʻopaʻa ʻo `col` i nā keiki ma ke kū pololei, `laina` ma ka pae. ʻAe lāua ʻelua i ka `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `center`, `grow`, a me ka mea hoʻololi laula/kiʻekiʻe. E hoʻokomo i nā keiki i kahi pae hohonu i ka pūnana.
architexDocs.containerExample:
lālani :: āpau (8) papa (16) kikowaena
  kiʻi "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) radius(20)
  col :: ulu ka āwaha(2)
    kikokikona ~ inoa :: wiwo ole
    kikokikona ~bio :: nui(12) kala(#888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: 'kikokiko' - kekahi kope kino. `header` - he poʻomanaʻo. `label` — kikokikona liʻiliʻi. 'Pūpoko' - mana hiki ke paʻi. `input` — kahua kikokikona i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i kahi var reactive. `kiʻi` — kiʻi mai kahi URL. `badge` - hōʻailona pila. `divider` - laina hoʻokaʻawale lahilahi. `toast` - ʻai meaʻai ephemeral. `tabs` / `tab` — mea hoololi papa.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `kikokikona "Aloha"` hana i ke kaula paʻa. ʻO ka 'text ~message' ke hoʻololi nei i kahi mea hoʻoikaika. Hoʻohui me ka interpolation: `text "Total: {~count}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Poʻomanaʻo kikokikona. Paʻamau i ka nui, ʻoi aku ka wiwo ʻole ma mua o ka 'text'. ʻO ka hoʻopaʻapaʻa kūlana like: `header "Settings"`. Nā unahi nui me ka pale — hoʻopau me ka `nui(n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: ʻElemu hiki ke paʻi. ʻO ke kaula kūlana ka lepili; holo ka hana `=>` ma ke kaomi. ` pihi "Save" => ~draft = null`. Nui ʻ=>` ahi i ka hoʻonohonoho.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: kahua kikokikona pili ʻelua ʻaoʻao. ʻO ka hoʻololi reactive ma hope o ka inoa e paʻa i ka waiwai o kēia manawa: `hookomo ~ leka uila`. Nā mea hoʻololi: `placeholder("…")`, `debounce(300)` no nā mea hou i hoʻopaʻa ʻia.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Hoʻouka ʻia mai kahi ala HTTPS URL a i ʻole `/uploads/...`. Mea hoʻololi `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` ʻoki i ka pahu. E hāʻule i hope i kahi silhouette i hoʻopaʻa ʻia inā ʻo ka URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: ʻO ka mea hoʻokaʻawale lauoho, 1px, mahalo i ke kala kumuhana o kēia manawa. ʻAʻohe hoʻopaʻapaʻa.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Pill e pili ana i kona ʻike: `badge ~count`, `badge "hou"`. E hoʻohana no nā helu helu ʻaʻole i heluhelu ʻia a me nā chips tag.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Kāpena/kōkua kikokikona — hoʻohaʻahaʻa ʻia. Good no nā inoa kahua puka.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Hoʻolaha pāpā ʻole. `toast ~ʻike 'ia "Ho'ōla!" :: lōʻihi(2000)` hōʻike ʻia no 2 mau kekona inā he ʻoiaʻiʻo ʻo `~visible`, a laila hoʻopau ʻokoʻa. ʻAʻohe modal stacking, ʻaʻohe kaua z-index.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: ʻO ka pahu pahu i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i kahi kaula hoʻihoʻi: `tabs ~activeTab`. I loko o ia mea, hoʻolaha kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao "Label" "key"ʻ i hoʻokahi papa; hōʻike ʻia ke kino i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma lalo ke paʻa ke kī.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: ʻO nā mea hoʻololi wale ke ala e hoʻokala i kahi ʻāpana. E kaulahao iā lākou ma hope o `::`. Hele mai lākou i loko o ʻelima ʻohana: spacing, sizing, color, typography, and behaviour.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` - hoʻopā ma nā ʻaoʻao a pau. `pad(x, y)` — paepae + kū pololei. `pad(luna, ʻākau, lalo, hema)` — CSS-kauoha. `gap(n)` — kaawale ma waena o nā keiki o kahi `col` / `laina`. `margin(n)` - kaawale waho mai nā kaikaina.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: ʻw(px)` — laula paʻa. `h(px)` — kiʻekiʻe paʻa. `grow` — hoʻopiha i ke koena wahi ma kahi lālani/col. `center` - ke kikowaena ma ke axis kea; i loko o kahi `col` ke kikowaena ma ke alo, ma ka `lalani` ke kikowaena pololei.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `kala(#rrggbb)` — ke alo. `bg(#rrggbb)` — hope. ʻAe ʻelua i nā hōʻailona kumuhana: `color(~primary)` heluhelu mai ka poloka `@theme` o kēia manawa. Hele ʻo Opacity i kahi hex 8-helu: `#00000080` he 50 %% ʻeleʻele.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `nui(px)` — ka nui kikokiko. `bold` / `italic` — kaumaha a me ke ʻano. `align(hema|waena|akau)` — hooponopono kikokikona.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `huna(~flag)` — wehe i ka node i ka wa oiaio o ka hae. `ʻike (~ hae)` - hoʻololi. Hoʻokuʻu ʻia nā node i kau ʻole ʻia i kā lākou DOM, no laila ʻoi aku ka maʻalahi o ke kūlana UI.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce(ms)` ma ka `input` throttles mea hou. Hōʻike ʻo `placeholder("…")` i kahi kaula kuhikuhi. ʻano (ʻano, arg)` ma nā ʻano kikokikona he helu: `format("kālā", "USD")`, `format("pakeneka")`, `format("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: ʻO `radius(px)` puni nā kihi. ʻO `border(#rrggbb)` e kaha kiʻi i ka 1 px. Hoʻonohonoho ʻo `border(px, #rrggbb)` i ka mānoanoa.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Hoʻololi nā hana i ka mokuʻāina a kamaʻilio paha me ka honua o waho. Holo like lākou i loko o ka mea hoʻopaʻa tap/keypress.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~helu = 0`, `=> ~busy = oiaio`, `=> ~papa inoa = []`. Hiki ke kākau ʻia kēlā me kēia ʻano hoʻololi.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. ʻ=> ~helu += 1ʻ he ʻōlelo no nā helu helu.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Nui nā `=>` ma ka laina hoʻokahi e ahi mai luna-a-lalo i ka māka hoʻokahi, no laila, hoʻokahi manawa hou ka UI i ka hopena: ` pihi "Buy" => ~busy = ʻoiaʻiʻo => hoʻouna (action: "kūʻai") => ~busy = false`. No ka hana async, makemake i ka `@reaction` i helu ʻia.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: ʻO `send(action: "name", ...args)` ʻo ia ke alahaka e hoʻi i ka bot. Loaʻa i ka host (Vortex runtime) ma ke ʻano he JSON RPC memo a hiki iā ia ke kāhea i ke code o kāu bot. E hoʻohana iā ia no ke komo ʻana, API kiʻi, uku - ʻaʻole hiki i ka DSL ke hōʻike.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: ʻO `goto("ScreenName", arg: waiwai, ...)` hoʻokuʻu i kekahi `@screen` ma luna o ka waihona; `hope ()` pops. Hoʻomaka ka wā holo ma ke ʻano paʻamau.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `kope (~ kikokikona)`, `kaʻana (~ kikokikona)`, `haptic("māmā" | "medium" | "kaumaha")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("…")`, `confirm("…") => ~ok = it` — ʻo ka `it` shorthand ka waiwai hoʻihoʻi o ka huaʻōlelo mua.
architexDocs.themeDesc: E haʻi aku i kahi palette i hoʻokahi manawa, e hoʻohana hou i nā wahi āpau. Lilo nā hōʻailona i nā mea hoʻololi hoʻololi maʻamau i hiki i kāu polokalamu ke hoʻouna i kahi hoʻololi ʻeleʻele ma nā laina ʻekolu.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` huki i kēlā me kēia `@component` a me `@screen` mai kēlā faila a i ka laulā o kēia manawa. Pili nā ala i ka faila lawe mai; ʻike ʻia a hōʻike ʻia nā lawe ʻana mai i ka pōʻai i ka manawa parse.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: E wehewehe hoʻokahi, e hoʻohana i nā manawa he nui: `@component Avatar url nui\n kiʻi url :: w(nui) h(nui) radius(nui / 2)`. I loko o ke kino ʻāpana, aia nā ʻāpana i kapa ʻia ma ke ʻano he mea hōʻike maʻalahi (me ka ʻole `~`).
architexDocs.forLoops: @no - e hana hou ana i kahi poloka
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@no ka mea i loko o ~papa inoa' ​​e hoʻolilo i hoʻokahi lālani no kēlā me kēia mea. `@no ka mea, idx i ka ~list` hoʻopaʻa pū i ka helu helu ʻole. Hoʻopili ka wā holo i ka ʻike ma o ka element ponoʻī, no laila e hoʻohui i nā mea ma luna o kahi papa inoa 10 000-lālani koina O(1) DOM hana.
architexDocs.forExample:
@no ka mea, idx i ~ mau mea
  lālani :: āwaha(8) papa(4)
    hōʻailona ~idx
    kikokikona ~ mea :: ulu
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `cond ? a : b` hana ma nā wahi a pau i ʻae ʻia kahi ʻōlelo. Pūnana no nā enum: `~ kūlana >= 10 ? "kiʻekiʻe" : ~ kūlana >= 5 ? "waena" : "haahaa"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Ma loko o ka ʻōlelo hoʻolaha, ʻo ka 'slot' e hōʻailona i kahi e hoʻopili ai ke kino o ka mea kelepona.
architexDocs.reactivity: Pehea e hana ai ka reactivity
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: He hōʻailona kēlā me kēia `~var`. Ke heluhelu ʻoe iā ia i loko o kahi hoʻopaʻapaʻa helu, hoʻololi hoʻololi, a i ʻole interpolation, ʻike ka runtime i ka heluhelu ʻana ma ka pakuhi hilinaʻi o kēia manawa. Ke kākau ʻoe, e loiloi hou ʻia kēlā me kēia node e heluhelu iā ia - hoʻokahi, ma ka hopena o ka microtask o kēia manawa.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā helu he nui i ka mea lawelawe hoʻokahi. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` ho'āla i hoʻokahi hāʻawi pass.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Ma ka paʻamau, hoʻohana ka runtime i ke kaulike koʻikoʻi (`===`). ʻAʻole holo hou ke kākau ʻana i ka waiwai like. E hāʻawi i kahi mea hou / hui e hoʻoikaika i kahi mea hou; paipai ʻia ka immutability akā ʻaʻole koi ʻia.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: ʻEhā mau polokalamu canonical, paʻa kēlā me kēia a ma lalo o 40 mau laina. E kope i kekahi o ia mau mea i loko o ka pā Architex a kaomi iā Run.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter — kūlana reactive, helu ʻia, mea hoʻohana pihi, hoʻopaʻa kikokikona.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo - ka papa inoa, hoʻohui / wehe, hoʻoponopono inline.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profile — kiʻi, ʻino, ʻike kūlana, hoʻokele.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: ʻO nā hiʻohiʻona pepehi kanaka - nā kumumanaʻo, nā mea lawe mai, nā ʻaoʻao, nā kīʻaha, nā helu i hoʻonohonoho ʻia, nā ternaries, nā vars typed.
architexDocs.errors: Nā hewa maʻamau a me ka mea e hana ai
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `inoa ʻike ʻole ~foo` — ua hoʻohana ʻoe i kahi hoʻololi hoʻololi ma mua o ka haʻi ʻana. E hoʻohui i ka `~foo = …` ma ka piko o ka `@screen`.
architexDocs.errIndent: 'indent unexpected' — pono hoʻokahi pae ka hohonu o nā keiki ma mua o ko lākou makua. Hoʻohana ʻo Architex i ʻelua mau hakahaka ma kēlā me kēia pae; Hōʻole ʻia nā ʻaoʻao no ka pale ʻana i nā pōpoki ʻike ʻole-whitespace.
architexDocs.errModifier: `unknown modifier` — ua kākau ʻoe iā `:: shadow` akā ʻaʻole kākoʻo ka wā holo. E nānā i ka papa inoa hoʻololi ma luna; Paʻa loa ʻo Architex e pili ana i nā inoa ʻike ʻole e pale i ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i mua.
architexDocs.errType: `type mismatch` — laʻa. ua hala ʻoe i kahi kaula i manaʻo ʻia ai kahi helu. E hōʻike i ka hoʻololi hoʻololi (`~helu: helu`) a na ka parser e haʻi iā ʻoe i kahi i loaʻa ai ka waiwai ʻino.
architexDocs.errDebug: No ka debug i ka wā holo, e hoʻopili i ka ʻōlelo kānalua i ka `debug(...)` — hoʻopaʻa ka runtime i kēlā me kēia loiloi i ka console me ka ʻole o ka pili ʻana i ka waiwai.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Pūnaewele — hoʻolilo ʻia i loko o ka vanilla DOM me CSS mau ʻano hoʻololi no nā hōʻailona kumuhana. ʻAʻohe React / Vue / Svelte hilinaʻi.
architexDocs.compatIOS: ʻO iOS - ʻo ka `.arx` hoʻokahi i paʻi ʻia a hāʻawi ʻia i nā hiʻohiʻona SwiftUI ma o ka Vortex iOS host. Kuhi ʻia kēlā me kēia mea hoʻololi i kahi ʻano SwiftUI.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android - hoʻopuka ka mea hoʻokipa iā Jetpack Compose. Unuhi ʻia nā mea hoʻololi hoʻololi (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) i nā mea like.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Kulekele mana — Hoʻopaʻa ʻo Architex i ka hoʻokō ʻana i hope no nā faila `.arx` ma nā mana liʻiliʻi. Ke hana mau nei ka faila `.arx` i ka 0.1 ma 0.9.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: E heluhelu i ka puke kuke no nā mamana (nā papa inoa pau ʻole, nā palapala, nā uku), ke alakaʻi mea hana no ka plugin CLI a me VS Code, a me ke alakaʻi hāʻawi inā makemake ʻoe e hoʻohui i kahi mea i kūkulu ʻia. Aia ke kumu piha ma github.com/vortex/Architex.

meta.title: Vortex Kuhikuhi
meta.subtitle: ʻO kēlā me kēia subsystem o Vortex ma kahi hoʻokahi.
meta.intro: Hoʻopau ʻia kēia kuhikuhi ma ka hoʻolālā ʻana. E hoʻomaka i kēlā me kēia wahi - paʻa pono kēlā me kēia mokuna. Hoʻi kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo i nā ala kumu inā pili. Kāhea ʻia kēlā me kēia ʻano like ʻole.
meta.howToUse: Hōʻike ka papa ʻike ma ka ʻaoʻao hema i nā mokuna ma aneʻi. Kaomi i kahi mokuna e lele ai; Aia i kēlā me kēia mokuna nā poʻomanaʻo a me nā papa inoa hiki iā ʻoe ke nānā i 30 kekona ma mua o ka luʻu ʻana.
meta.updatedBy: Hana ʻia mai `scripts/build_vortex_docs_v2.py`. Hana hou me `python3 scripts/build_vortex_docs_v2.py`.

architecture.title: Nānā kiʻi kiʻi
architecture.subtitle: ʻEkolu kaʻina hana - ka mea kūʻai, node, ka mea hoʻoponopono - a me hoʻokahi protocol e hoʻopaʻa iā lākou.
architecture.intro: Vortex he ʻelele hoʻokaʻawale. Ma kahi o ka hope hope hoʻokahi nona ka hui hoʻokahi, hoʻohui ia i kahi mesh hāmama o **nodes** kūʻokoʻa, ʻike ʻia a hōʻoia ʻia e kahi **controller** paʻa e hoʻopuka ana i kahi hōʻike pūlima o ke code āna i hōʻoia ai. **Paʻa nā mea kūʻai** i nā kī pilikino āpau a hāʻawi i ka UI. ʻO ke koena o kēia mokuna e hele ana i nā kaʻina hana ʻekolu, ko lākou mau palena, a me ka ʻikepili e kahe ana ma waena o lākou.
architecture.h1p1: ʻO nā ʻelele kikowaena he wahi hoʻokahi o ke koi. ʻO ke kauoha ʻaha hoʻokolokolo, ka hoʻopau ʻana o ka mea hoʻolako ao, a i ʻole ka loaʻa ʻana o ka ʻenemi i unuhi ʻia i "nā mea hoʻohana i nalowale ke komo". Vortex ʻaoʻao ʻaoʻao ma ka ʻae ʻana i kekahi e holo i kahi node a hoʻokuʻu i nā mea kūʻai aku e neʻe ma waena o nā node me ke kākau inoa ʻole.
architecture.h1p2: Pono ka Decentralization e mālama i ka hūnā a me ka pono. Ke hana wale nei ka hui o nā kikowaena hilinaʻi ʻole inā ʻaʻole hiki i nā kikowaena ke heluhelu i ka plaintext a ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻopaʻa i nā memo. Hoʻoikaika ʻo Vortex ma o ka hoʻopili ʻana i ka hopena a i ka hopena a me nā hōʻoia Ed25519 ma kēlā me kēia memo cross-node.
architecture.h1p3: ʻO ka mea hoʻoponopono ka ʻāpana kikowaena-ish, akā liʻiliʻi. Hoʻopuka wale ʻia ʻo `INTEGRITY.sig.json` a me kahi papa inoa o nā wahi komo hilinaʻi. Hiki i kekahi ke hoʻokipa iā ia iho i ke aniani, no laila ʻaʻole ʻo ka mea hoʻokele kahi wahi o ka hāʻule - hoʻokahi wale nō kumu o ka ʻoiaʻiʻo no "ka pubkey e hōʻailona ai i nā hoʻokuʻu kūhelu".
architecture.h1l1: ʻAʻohe mea kūʻai paʻa: hiki i nā mea kūʻai ke neʻe i ko lākou ʻike ma waena o nā node i kēlā me kēia manawa ma ke kau inoa hou ʻana i ka X25519 pubkey me kahi JWT hou.
architecture.h1l2: ʻAʻohe hoʻopili ʻana i waho: i ka wā e iho ai kekahi node, ʻaʻole ʻike nā mea hoʻohana ma nā node ʻē aʻe.
architecture.h1l3: ʻAʻohe mana hoʻokahi: koho nā mea hoʻohana i ko lākou home kānāwai, a koho nā mea hoʻohana i kā lākou mea hoʻohana.
architecture.h1l4: ʻAʻohe UI hoʻokahi: IOS, Android, pūnaewele he mau hoa papa mua - ʻaʻohe paepae he ʻōwili lahilahi ma luna o kekahi.
architecture.h2p1: Holo ka mea kūʻai ma luna o ka mea hoʻohana. ʻO ia wale nō kahi e ola ai nā memo maʻemaʻe, nā kī pilikino, a me nā faila-in-the-clear. ʻAʻole ʻike ka node iā lākou.
architecture.h2p2: Hoʻokomo kēlā me kēia paepae i kākoʻo ʻia i nā protocol uea like (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-split feature modules (`api/` protocols, `impl/` code, `ui/` views) e mālama pono i ka aelike a ho'opa'a 'ia ke code kiko'ī platform.
architecture.h2p3: Ka waiho ʻana ma ka hāmeʻa: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / HttpOnly cookie no nā hōʻailona; SQLite (GRDB ma IOS, lumi ma Android, IndexedDB wrapper ma ka punaewele) no ka ciphertext cache + ka FTS index.
architecture.h2l1: ʻO iOS - Swift Package me 30+ hiʻohiʻona modules. ʻO iOS 17 ka palena o ka hoʻolālā.
architecture.h2l2: Android — Kotlin + Compose + Hilt. minSdk 26, targetSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Pūnaewele — vanilla JS PWA, limahana lawelawe, ʻaʻohe pae kūkulu ma mua o ES pūʻulu module.
architecture.h2l4: Papakaukau - ʻO Tauri ʻōwili a puni ka mea kūʻai pūnaewele; pūʻolo like, mea hoʻopuka Chrome maoli.
architecture.h3p1: He kaʻina Python ka node (`python -m app.main`, a i ʻole ka pūʻolo `run.py`) e hoʻolohe ana i ka 9000 ma ka paʻamau. Ke hoʻomau nei ia i ka ciphertext, ka poʻe i waho i nā hanana WebSocket, paʻa i ka TURN hōʻoia, a me nā hui brokers me nā node ʻē aʻe.
architecture.h3p2: ʻO ka ʻaoʻao node he ʻano lahilahi. Hōʻike ʻo ia ma kahi o 120 ala ma waena o ka lāʻau ʻ/api/*` a me `/ws` no ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana i ka manawa maoli. Hoʻokomo ʻia ka hāpai kaumaha (crypto, presence, scheduling) i `app/security/`, `app/transport/`, `app/peer/`.
architecture.h3p3: Hoʻokahi node ma ke ʻano SQLite paʻamau e mālama i ka ~50 mea hoʻohana like me ka ʻoluʻolu ma kahi M1. Me ka Postgres a me Redis i hoʻohana ʻia, ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka pāʻālua like ʻole - lilo kēlā me kēia node i stateless ma mua o ka DB a me ka fan-out.
architecture.h3l1: Nā helu komo: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/integrity` a me `/health` no ke ola.
architecture.h3l2: Pili: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, Pillow, Rust extension `vortex_chat` no ka crypto ala wela.
architecture.h3l3: Koho: ʻO Redis (hōʻike ʻia ma waho o nā node he nui), Postgres (hana DB), coturn (TURN relay), fluent-bit (log shipping).
architecture.h3l4: Ka nui binary: ~60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust hoʻonui. Kiʻi Docker ma kahi o 400 MB ma mua o ka ʻōpala.
architecture.h4p1: He kaʻina Python kaʻawale ka mea hoʻoponopono (`vortex_controller`) me kahi kumu haiki: hoʻopuka a hōʻoia i ka `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, hōʻike i nā URL komo, a nānā i ke olakino o nā hoa hui.
architecture.h4p2: I ka hoʻomaka ʻana, hele ka mea hoʻoponopono i ke kumu kumu, hashes i kēlā me kēia faila, a hoʻohālikelike i ka hōʻike. Inā like ʻole kekahi hash, hōʻole ka mea hoʻoponopono e hoʻomaka. 'O ia ho'i, 'a'ole hiki ke lawelawe 'ia ka waihona ma ka diski 'kūlana:"hō'oia"`.
architecture.h4p3: Ua paʻi nā mea kūʻai iā '/v1/integrity' ma mua o ko lākou hilinaʻi ʻana i kahi node. Inā ʻike lākou i ka 'status != "hōʻoia"ʻ hōʻole lākou i ka hāʻawi ʻana i nā palapala hōʻoia, manawa. ʻO ia ka heleuma hilinaʻi.
architecture.h4l1: Kakau ʻia me `keys/release.key` (Ed25519). Hoʻomoʻa ʻia ka hapalua lehulehu i nā hoʻokuʻu o ka mea kūʻai aku.
architecture.h4l2: Hōʻike manaʻo: `{path, sha256, size}` no kēlā me kēia faila i ʻike ʻole ʻia.
architecture.h4l3: Hana hou: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Nā huahana `INTEGRITY.sig.json` ma ke kumu repo.
architecture.h4l4: Hoʻololi: hoʻololi nā mea hana Vortex i ka `release.key`. Hoʻonohonoho ʻia nā mea kūʻai aku me kā lākou pubkey a laila hilinaʻi i kēlā ʻōpala.
architecture.h5p1: E hele i nā mea i hana ʻia ke hoʻouna ʻo Alice iā "hi" iā Bob:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Nānā ka mea kūʻai aku i ke kī kumu o ka lumi ma kona hale kūʻai kūloko. Inā ʻaʻole, kiʻi ʻo ia i kahi envelop hou mai `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` no kāna puʻupuʻu ponoʻī. ʻO nā DM manawa mua e holo i hoʻokahi puni Diffie-Hellman ma nā prekeys.
architecture.h5p3: 2. Hoʻopili ka mea kūʻai i ka ukana ma ke ʻano he CBOR `{v:1, kikokikona: "hi", reply_to:null, sent_at:...}`, hoʻopuka i kahi 96-bit nonce, sila me AES-256-GCM, a me nā POST `/api/rooms/{id}/messages` me hex, nonce:text. hex}`.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Hoʻopaʻa ʻo Node i ka lālani a hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā pā i `{type:"m", lumi:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` i kēlā me kēia WebSocket i hoʻopili ʻia i ka lumi.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Loaʻa i ka mea kūʻai aku ʻo Bob ke kiʻi, hoʻokaʻawale me ke kī kumu hoʻokahi, hōʻoia i ka mea hoʻouna pseudo kūpono i ka lālā i manaʻo ʻia, a hāʻawi i ka ʻōhū.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Hoʻouna ka mea kūʻai aku ʻo Bob iā `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` me ka helu leka heluhelu hope loa. Hoʻomaka ia i kahi hoʻolaha `{type:"r"}` no laila e hōʻike ana ka ʻōhū o Alice i kahi kiko.
architecture.h6p1: ʻO CBOR (RFC 8949) he koʻikoʻi, binary, a wikiwiki hoʻi e hoʻopaʻa inoa. Hoʻohālikelike ʻia me JSON ʻoki ʻo ia i ka nui o ka uku e ~30 % ma ka ciphertext kamaʻilio maʻamau a hoʻopau i ka ambiguity keʻokeʻo.
architecture.h6p2: Hoʻohālikelike ʻia me Protobuf ʻaʻole ia e koi i kahi mea hoʻomohala schema a ʻaʻole hoʻokuʻu i nā helu kahua. He mea nui ia no ka mea e ulu ana ka Vortex - ua hoʻohui mākou i ka `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `rections_count`, `kind` ma luna o nā hoʻokuʻu me ka haki ʻole i nā mea kūʻai aku kahiko.
architecture.h6p3: ʻO CBOR ka mea hoʻohana ʻo Signal, Matrix, a me NIP-29 no nā kumu like loa. ʻO ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i kā lākou koho, ʻoi aku ka maʻalahi o kā mākou protocol e loiloi e nā mea noiʻi palekana i ʻike mua i ka hoʻopili.
architecture.h7: Ka hoʻololi ʻana o ka protocol
architecture.h7p1: Lawe ʻia kēlā me kēia kiʻi `v:<int>`. ʻO ka mana o kēia manawa ʻo 1. Hoʻokuʻu ʻia kahi kiʻi me kahi mana ʻike ʻole; hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā mea kūʻai aku i kahi ʻōlelo aʻo a hoʻomau me ke kiʻi aʻe.
architecture.h7p2: Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka hoʻokō ʻana i hope no kēlā me kēia kiʻi e paʻa mau ana ʻo `v:1`. ʻOi aku ka maikaʻi o ka hoʻokō ʻana i mua: ua hoʻohui ʻia nā kahua hou ma ka hope o ka dict, ʻaʻole e haʻalele ka poʻe kahiko iā lākou.
architecture.h7p3: Mālama ʻia ka haki paʻakikī no nā hoʻololi koʻikoʻi palekana (e laʻa. Ma ia mau hihia, lele ka mana i ka 2 a paʻi ʻia kahi puka makani neʻe.
architecture.h1_a: Hoʻokaʻawale ka Vortex i ʻekolu kaʻina hana. Holo kēlā me kēia ma kāna iho, kamaʻilio me nā poʻe ʻē aʻe ma o nā protocol uea i wehewehe maikaʻi ʻia, a hiki ke pani kūʻokoʻa. ʻAʻohe monolith - pili kēlā me kēia hiʻohiʻona i kekahi o nā kuleana ʻekolu.
architecture.h1_b: Paʻa ka mea kūʻai i nā kī a hāʻawi i ka UI. Hoʻomau ka node i ka ciphertext, hoʻopuka i nā hanana ma luna o WebSocket, a me nā mea hoʻolaha WebRTC hōʻailona. Hoʻopuka ka mea hoʻoponopono i ka hōʻike i kau inoa ʻia a me nā URL komo. Kūkākūkā lākou ma luna o HTTPS + WebSocket me ka hoʻohana ʻana i CBOR-encoded payloads i loko o AES-GCM envelopes.
architecture.h1_c: Ua hoʻokomo ʻia ka māhele ma v0.0.3 ma hope o ka holo ʻana o ka mana monolith mua i ʻelua pilikia: ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka hōʻoia hoʻokuʻu ʻana i ka node holo (no laila hiki ke hoʻopunipuni ka node e pili ana i kāna code ponoʻī), a ʻaʻole hiki ke hui ʻia no ka noho ʻana o ka node state a me ka hilinaʻi i nā papa like. ʻO ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i ka hōʻoia i loko o kāna kaʻina hana ponoʻī ua hāʻawi i kēlā me kēia mea hoʻohana i hoʻokahi pahu kī hoʻokahi e pine a e hoʻonui mākou i ka hui i N.
architecture.h1_f:
mea kūʻai aku --HTTPS/WSS--> node
  ^ |
  |                        v
  +-----/v1/kūpono-- hoʻoponopono (hōʻike pūlima ʻia)
architecture.h2_a: Hoʻokaʻawale ka node/controller i ke kiʻi paʻa palekana (ka hōʻike pūlima) mai ka ʻili hoʻouka kaua nui loa (ke kikowaena API).
architecture.h2_b: Mālama ʻo Controller i kahi SQLite liʻiliʻi DB: nā pubkey hilinaʻi, URL aniani, a me nā helu olakino. Hōʻole ʻo ia e hoʻomaka inā ʻaʻole kūlike ʻo INTEGRITY.sig.json i ka lāʻau ma ka disk - ʻaʻole hiki i kahi faila i hoʻololi ʻia ke lawelawe ʻo `status:"hōʻoia"`. Holo ka node ma kāna iho Postgres/SQLite a ʻaʻole paʻa i ke kī hoʻokuʻu.
architecture.h2_c: Loaʻa ke kumu mai ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana o ka hale kūʻai a Chrome (nā palapala hōʻoia ma ke ala hoʻokuʻu o ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele, ʻaʻole ke kumu pūnaewele) a me Debian's Release.gpg (hōʻailona hōʻike ʻia, ʻaʻole i kau inoa ʻia nā pūʻolo). Apono ʻia no ka mea ua ola nā hoʻolālā ʻelua i nā makahiki he ʻumi o ka loiloi ʻenemi.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 ma kēlā me kēia hop, nā uku hoʻopili i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i loko. TLS mālama i ka halihali; Mālama ʻo AES-GCM i ka ʻike.
architecture.h3_b: Ma waena o ka mea kūʻai aku a me ka node: HTTPS (`/api/*`) a me WSS (`/ws`). Ma waena o nā node: HTTPS (`/hui/*`). Ma waena o ka node a me ka mea hoʻoponopono: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Hoʻohana nā mea a pau i ka TLS 1.3 me nā manamana lima Chrome 120 e pale aku i ka DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Ua hoʻohana mua ʻo Vortex i ka TCP maka me ka laʻa lima noise-protocol maʻamau. Ua hoʻololi ʻia i TLS 1.3 ma v0.0.4 ma hope o ka ʻike ʻana ua hōʻailona nā kuʻuna maʻamau i ka "hoihoi" i nā mea nānā passive. TLS 1.3 ʻoluʻolu, maʻamau, a ECH-mākaukau — ʻekolu mau waiwai a mākou i makemake ai.
architecture.h3_f:
papa lawe: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + koho ECH (RFC 9460)
papa maʻiʻo: AES-256-GCM sila i loko CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Hoʻokahi memo i waho e hele ma nā ʻanuʻu ʻehā: frame → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Hoʻopili ka mea kūʻai aku i ke kī lumi (X25519 + HKDF), hoʻopaʻa i ka memo ma ke ʻano he CBOR, sila me AES-256-GCM me ka hoʻohana ʻana i ka 96-bit nonce, POSTs i `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Mālama ʻo Node i ka lālani ciphertext a me nā mea pā i kēlā me kēia pili WebSocket i kākau inoa i ka lumi. Hoʻokaʻawale ka mea kūʻai aku me ke kī like. ʻO ka lōʻihi o ka huakaʻi a puni ma lalo o 50 ms ma ka LAN kūloko, ~120 ms maʻamau WAN.
architecture.h4_c: ʻO ka pipeline ʻehā-step ka like me ka Signal i hoʻohana ʻia ma 2014; Ua hoʻololi wale mākou i ka halihali (WebSocket ma kahi o Signal's TCP) a me ka hoʻopili ʻana (CBOR ma kahi o protobuf). ʻO ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i kahi hoʻolālā i hōʻoia ʻia e paʻi i ka hana ʻana i kahi mea hou.
architecture.h5_a: Ua koho mākou iā CBOR ma luna o JSON a me Protobuf ma hope o ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i ka nui o ka uku, evolvability, a me ka debug ergonomics ma nā haʻawina kamaʻilio maoli.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR hoʻopuka i ~30% mau uku liʻiliʻi ma mua o JSON ma nā memo unicode-kaumaha, ʻaʻohe wahi kikoʻī keʻokeʻo, a kākoʻo i ka hoʻohui ʻana me ka ʻole o nā mea hoʻomohala. Pono ʻo Proto i kahi faila .proto no ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana a hoʻopaʻa i nā helu kahua.
architecture.h5_c: Ua hoʻololi ʻia ka hōʻailona mai protobuf i CBOR-like framing ma 2017 no nā kumu like. Hoʻohana ʻo Matrix i ka CBOR ma kāna papa hoʻonā mokuʻāina. ʻO CBOR kahi maʻamau IETF (RFC 8949) a ʻo kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo a mākou e kiʻi ai he hale waihona puke makua.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR nui: ~0.7 × JSON ma ka hui utf-8
          ~1.05 × protobuf ma ka papahana like
Hoʻohui i kahi kahua = hoʻohui i ka hopena. Hoʻowahāwahā nā mea kūʻai kahiko.
architecture.h6_a: No ke aha CBOR — ʻāpana o ka mokuna hoʻolālā. ʻO kēia kekahi o nā mīkini kumu i kuhikuhi ʻia ma ka Vortex kuhikuhi. E heluhelu i ka mokuna a puni no ka pōʻaiapili ākea; hoʻonui kēia ʻāpana i ke ʻano kikoʻī.
architecture.h6_b: Ike hoʻokō no "No ke aha CBOR". Hoʻokō ʻia ka mīkini ma ka module pili ma lalo o `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, a i ʻole `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Kāhea ka module README i nā ala faila pololei.
architecture.h6_c: Ua ulu ka hana "No ke aha CBOR" ma waena o Vortex hoʻokuʻu. Hoʻi ka hoʻolālā i ka noiʻi i paʻi ʻia a me nā hana hana o nā ʻelele mua. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka mōʻaukala mana ma `CHANGELOG.md` i ka pae ʻana o kēlā me kēia ʻāpana a me ka mea i hoʻoikaika ai.
architecture.h7_a: Ka hoʻololi ʻana o ka protocol — ʻāpana o ka mokuna hoʻolālā. ʻO kēia kekahi o nā mīkini kumu i kuhikuhi ʻia ma ka Vortex kuhikuhi. E heluhelu i ka mokuna a puni no ka pōʻaiapili ākea; hoʻonui kēia ʻāpana i ke ʻano kikoʻī.
architecture.h7_b: Ka nānā 'ana i ka ho'okō 'ana no "Protocol versioning". Hoʻokō ʻia ka mīkini ma ka module pili ma lalo o `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, a i ʻole `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Kāhea ka module README i nā ala waihona pololei.
architecture.h7_c: Ua ulu ka hana "Protocol versioning" ma Vortex hoʻokuʻu. Hoʻi ka hoʻolālā i ka noiʻi i paʻi ʻia a me nā hana hana o nā ʻelele mua. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka mōʻaukala mana ma `CHANGELOG.md` i ka pae ʻana o kēlā me kēia ʻāpana a me ka mea i hoʻoikaika ai.

crypto.title: ʻO nā mea mua cryptographic
crypto.subtitle: ʻO kēlā me kēia algorithm i ka waihona, kona kumu, kona mau palena, kona RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex hoʻohana i nā mea kahiko i nānā ʻia e nā hoa. ʻAʻohe kīpē poloka maʻamau, ʻaʻohe KDF i ulu ʻia i ka home, ʻaʻohe papahana pūlima hou. Hoʻopaʻa kēia mokuna i nā mea mua a mākou e hoʻohana ai, nā ʻāpana pololei, a me ke kumu o kēlā me kēia koho.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) ma kona ʻano Montgomery, hoʻohana ʻia no Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. Nā kī pilikino 32-byte, 32-byte kī lehulehu, 32-byte i kaʻana like i nā mea huna.
crypto.h1p2: Hoʻohana ʻia no: ʻike pono mea paʻa, nā kī wā ephemeral, nā envelopes hoʻopaʻa i hoʻopaʻa ʻia, ka ʻōwili kī o ka lumi, nā envelopes hui.
crypto.h1p3: IOS hoʻokō: `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` mai CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek` ma o JNI. Node: `cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` ma luna o OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: ʻO kēlā me kēia ʻekolu interop bit-for-bit. Ua hoʻāʻo ʻia ka huakaʻi puni RFC 7748 Alice/Bob hōʻike vectors ma kēlā me kēia hale.
crypto.h1p5: Hana: ~100 µs no Diffie-Hellman ma kahi iPhone 2020, ~30 µs ma kahi Mac 2020. ʻO ka pōʻai o nā kī kī lumi no kahi hui 200 mau lālā e lawe ma kahi o 10 ms uaki paia.
crypto.h1p6: Ka manawa mau: ʻae, ma ka helu helu a me ke ala decoding raw-byte.
crypto.h1p7: ʻO ke kū ʻana o ka ʻaoʻao ʻaoʻao: ʻAʻole paʻa ke alapiʻi Montgomery i ka papa o ka hoʻouka ʻana i ka manawa i pā i nā pihi Weierstrass; Hoʻohana ʻia ʻo OpenSSL a me Swift CryptoKit.
crypto.h1p8: ʻO ka hoʻonohonoho kī: 32-byte little-endian. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā kī lehulehu ma ka lawe ʻana mai no laila ʻaʻole e hoʻoheheʻe ʻia nā mea hoʻokomo hewa.
crypto.h1l1: No ke aha X25519 a ʻaʻole P-256: ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki, liʻiliʻi, ʻaʻohe pilikia NIST-curve.
crypto.h1l2: No ke aha he 32-byte puka a ʻaʻole 64: pili pono i ka HKDF-SHA256 ka lōʻihi komo.
crypto.h1l3: No ke aha ʻo Montgomery a ʻaʻole ʻo Edwards: pono mākou DH, ʻaʻole pūlima, ma kēia mea kī. Pono ʻo Edwards i kahi hoʻololi i kēlā me kēia manawa.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) ma luna o edwards25519. 32-byte kī lehulehu, 64-byte pūlima.
crypto.h2p2: Hoʻohana ʻia no: nā hōʻike node ma nā leka hui, nā pūlima kī hoʻokuʻu ma luna o ka hōʻike kūpaʻa, ke kau inoa ʻana i ka bot, ka ʻike lōʻihi o ka mīkini no Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Determinism: ʻo ka RFC 8032 ʻokoʻa a mākou e hoʻohana ai e hana i ka pūlima like ʻelua no ka memo + kī like. Hoʻohana ʻo Apple's CryptoKit ma iOS 17+ i ka RFC 8032bis ʻano ʻano like ʻole - kūpono nā mea ʻelua a hōʻoia ʻelua me kekahi mea hōʻoia kūpono.
crypto.h2p4: Uku hōʻoia: ~200 µs ma kahi CPU hou. ʻO ka hōʻoia pūʻulu (`batch_verify([msg,sig,pk]*N)`) he ~10× ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o kēlā me kēia pūlima.
crypto.h2p5: Hōʻailona pūlima: `R || S`, 32 bytes kēlā me kēia, little-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Hōʻike kī lehulehu: 32-byte kiko kōmi. Pono mau — ʻaʻohe hihia "point at infinity".
crypto.h2l2: Hōʻike kī pilikino: hua 32-byte. Loaʻa ka scalar i hoʻonui ʻia ma ka lele ma SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: No ke aha ʻaʻole ECDSA: ECDSA pono i kahi kiʻekiʻe RNG no kēlā me kēia pūlima; RNG hoʻokaʻawale i ke kī pilikino. Hoʻoholo ʻia ʻo Ed25519, ʻaʻohe RNG pono i ka manawa hōʻailona.
crypto.h3p1: AES ma ke ʻano Galois/Counter (NIST SP 800-38D). Nā kī 256-bit, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit hōʻoia hōʻailona.
crypto.h3p2: Hoʻohana ʻia no: ka envelope ciphertext memo, nā envelopes puʻupuʻu waihona, nā uku hoʻihoʻi i hoʻopili ʻia, nā uku hoʻopaʻa paʻa.
crypto.h3p3: ʻAʻole hana ʻia: hoʻopuka kēlā me kēia memo i kahi 96-bit random nonce. Hoʻopili ka node i nā 10^6 nonces hope loa i kēlā me kēia lumi a hāʻule i nā kope me ka pale - ʻaʻole pono ka mea kūʻai aku e hoʻopuka i nā kope ma ka mua, akā manaʻo ʻia ʻaʻohe mea maʻalahi.
crypto.h3p4: No ke aha he 96-bit nonces a ʻaʻole 128-bit: 96 bits ka GCM-standard "deterministic" nonce lōʻihi, a hāʻawi ia iā mākou i 2^32 nonces ma mua o ka lilo ʻana o ka lā hānau i mea hopohopo. Hoʻololi ʻia kahi kī lumi hoʻokahi ma mua o kēlā, no laila palekana.
crypto.h3p5: Nui o ka tag: piha 128 mau bits. ʻAʻole mākou e ʻoki - ʻaʻole hiki ke mālama ʻia ka mālama ʻana a hoʻonui ka ʻoki ʻana i ka hiki ke hoʻopunipuni.
crypto.h3l1: ʻO ka wikiwiki o nā lakohana: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A hoʻonui crypto, nā poloka crypto i hoʻolaʻa ʻia ma Apple Silicon. ʻO ka hoʻopili hoʻopili ʻana ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: Ma nā mea kahiko ARM me ka ʻole o nā hoʻonui crypto: ~300 MB/s ma o ka lako polokalamu. ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki ma mua o ka disk IO.
crypto.h3l3: ʻIkepili pili: ua hoʻoholo ʻia ke poʻomanaʻo kiʻi (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) ma ke ʻano he AAD no laila ʻaʻole e hōʻoia ʻia kahi poʻomanaʻo hoʻopunipuni.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) me SHA-256. Loaʻa i nā kī liʻiliʻi he 32-byte mai kahi hoʻokomo 32-byte hoʻokahi.
crypto.h4p2: Hoʻohana ʻia no: ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i ka X25519 puka i loko o kahi kī hoʻopunipuni + MAC kī + kī poʻomanaʻo; ka loaʻa ʻana o ke kī ratchet aʻa mai kahi puni Diffie-Hellman; ke kūkulu ʻana i nā kī file per-chunk mai ke kumu waihona.
crypto.h4p3: Hoʻoholo mau nā kaula ʻike ASCII: `"v1: hoʻopunipuni"`, `"v1:mac"`, `"v1:header"`, `"v1:backup"`. Hiki iā mākou ke hoʻololi i ka hierarchy kī holoʻokoʻa ma o ka hoʻololi ʻike-string.
crypto.h4p4: He koho ka paʻakai. Ma Vortex hoʻohana mākou i ka lumi id e like me ka paʻakai no ka lawe ʻana i nā kī kī lumi no laila ʻaʻole hiki i nā lumi like ʻole ke hoʻohana hou i nā kī i loaʻa inā ʻike ʻia ka X25519 like.
crypto.h4l1: No ke aha SHA-256 ʻaʻole SHA-512: loaʻa i nā paepae a pau ka wikiwiki SHA-256; ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o SHA-512 ma nā CPU 64-bit akā ʻaʻole ma nā kelepona.
crypto.h4l2: No ke aha ʻaʻole kahi KMAC-based KDF: KMAC he niche. Aia ka HKDF i kēlā me kēia waihona crypto a mākou e hoʻohana ai.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106). Nā ʻāpana: m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5p2: Hoʻohana ʻia no: ʻaoʻao-server password hash (`users.password_hash`), kī hoʻopaʻa hoʻihoʻi kūloko, ka huaʻōlelo hoʻokomo huaʻōlelo.
crypto.h5p3: No ke aha kēia mau ʻāpana: OWASP 2023 manaʻo. Lawe ʻo 64 MiB + 3 i ka ~0.5 s ma kahi iPhone X — kā mākou mea kākoʻo lohi. ʻO ka mea hoʻouka kaua ASIC me 100× ka bandwidth hoʻomanaʻo o ke kelepona e pono mau iā ~5 ms no ka hoʻāʻo. ʻO nā ʻōlelo huna lōʻihi (entropy > 40 bits) hiki ʻole ke hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma ka pālākiō.
crypto.h5p4: Hōʻano waihona: `argon2:<encoded>` kahi i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ʻo ke kaula RFC-format me ka paʻakai, ka hoʻomanaʻo, nā hoʻololi, a me ka hash.
crypto.h5l1: No ke aha ʻo Argon2id a ʻaʻole ʻo Argon2i a i ʻole Argon2d: ʻo 2id ka hybrid — kūʻē ka hele mua i nā ala-ʻaoʻao (i-mode), kūʻē nā ala hope i GPU/ASIC (d-mode). Hoʻohana like ka hōʻailona.
crypto.h5l2: Hoʻohālikelike Dummy-hash: ʻoiai ʻaʻole i loaʻa ka mea hoʻohana, ke holo nei mākou i kahi Argon2 hoʻopunipuni me ka hash mau. Hoʻohālikelike kēia i ka manawa komo no laila ʻaʻole hiki i nā mea hoʻouka ke helu i nā inoa inoa ma ka manawa pane.
crypto.h5l3: E hoʻopaʻa hou i ka hoʻopaʻa inoa ʻana: inā hoʻopaʻa ʻia ke kumu hoʻomanaʻo o ka mea lawelawe, e hoʻihoʻi hou ʻia nā hashes kahiko i ka wā e hiki mai ana. Akaka i ka mea hoʻohana.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024). ML-KEM-768. 1184-byte kī lehulehu, 1088-byte ciphertext, 32-byte mea huna.
crypto.h6p2: Hoʻohana ʻia no: hybrid post-quantum session keys. Ke hoʻolaha nā hoa ʻelua i ke kākoʻo ʻo Kyber, ʻo ke kī o ka hālāwai ʻo `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: No ke aha ʻo hybrid: ʻoiai inā ua haki ʻo Kyber ma hope (he ʻōpio ia), ʻo ka ʻāpana X25519 ke pale nei iā mākou. Hāʻawi ka hui ʻana i ka maikaʻi o nā mea ʻelua.
crypto.h6p4: No ke aha ʻo Kyber a ʻaʻole nā ​​moho NIST ʻē aʻe: ʻo ia ka mea i koho ʻia no ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana. He ākea ka loaʻa ʻana o ke code (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Hana: hana kī ~ 100 µs, encapsulation ~ 30 µs, decapsulation ~ 50 µs. ʻAʻole hiki ke hoʻohālikelike ʻia me ka lōʻihi o ka huakaʻi hele.
crypto.h6l2: Ke kumu kūʻai o ka bandwidth: 1088 bytes i kēlā me kēia manawa ciphertext, 1184 bytes no ke kī lehulehu. Ua uku ʻia ke kau ma ka hui mua ʻana; ma hope iho, he zero.
crypto.h6l3: ʻaoʻao kikowaena: `pqcrypto` Python pūʻolo me `kem.ml_kem_768`. ʻO ka ʻaoʻao o nā mea kūʻai aku: liboqs ma o nā paʻa paʻa.
crypto.h7p1: ʻO Signal's Double Ratchet (e like me ka mea i hōʻike ʻia ma ka 2016 public spec). Hoʻohui i kahi ratchet Diffie-Hellman me kahi kaulahao kī like.
crypto.h7p2: Hoʻohana ʻia no: nā leka pololei ma waena o nā mea ʻelua. Hoʻohana nā lumi hui i kahi hoʻolālā "ki hoʻouna" maʻalahi i kī ʻia mai ke kumu o ka lumi.
crypto.h7p3: Nā waiwai: ka hūnā i mua (e hōʻike wale ana i nā memo i loaʻa iā ia, ʻaʻole nā ​​​​mea e hiki mai ana), ka palekana ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻapaʻa ʻana (hoʻōla hou ʻia ma hope o kahi kuʻikahi kī), ka lawe ʻana i waho (a hiki i 1000 memo o ka skip).
crypto.h7p4: Aia kā mākou hoʻokō ma `app/security/double_ratchet.py` a me `ios/Modules/Sources/Chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.swift` / `android/app/src/main/.../chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.kt`.
crypto.h7l1: ʻO ka pāpale lōʻihi o ke kaulahao: 1000 memo no kēlā me kēia kaulahao ma mua o ka hoʻopaʻa hou ʻana. Hoʻopau i ka pōʻino mai kahi kī kaulahao ʻaihue.
crypto.h7l2: Hoʻokuʻu ʻia-key cache: a hiki i 1000 mau kī i waho o ke kauoha i mālama ʻia i ka hoʻomanaʻo no kēlā me kēia kaulahao. Ma waho aʻe o kēlā, ua hōʻole ʻia ka ʻōlelo ma ke ʻano he pala.
crypto.h7l3: Hoʻopili poʻomanaʻo: hoʻā ma ka paʻamau. Lawe ke poʻo i ka metadata ratchet a hoʻopili ʻia me kahi kī poʻomanaʻo hoʻolaʻa i loaʻa mai ke kumu ma o HKDF.
crypto.h8p1: Hoʻohana ʻia ka ʻike faila non-cryptographic a me ka pololei i ka BLAKE3 no ka mea ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o 10x ma mua o SHA-256 ma nā pōpō nui.
crypto.h8p2: Hoʻohana ʻia no: faila `sha256` kolamu ma ka DB (inoa mōʻaukala; ʻoiaʻiʻo BLAKE3 ma lalo o ka puʻupuʻu mai v0.1.2), hoʻokuʻu ʻia ka hoʻopili, ka nānā pono ʻana i ka faila.
crypto.h8p3: ʻO ke kūlana palekana: BLAKE3 ikaika loa i ka cryptographically (256-bit); kapa mākou i ke kolamu ʻo `sha256` no ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i ka neʻe ʻana wale nō.
crypto.h9p1: Hoʻokumu ʻia nā kumu waiwai ʻole a pau, nā prekey, nā waiwai paʻakikī ma o ka OS RNG: `SecRandom` ma iOS, `java.security.SecureRandom` ma Android, `secrets.token_bytes` ma Python (wrapping `/dev/urandom` a i ʻole like).
crypto.h9p2: ʻAʻole loa `random.random()`, ʻaʻole loa `Math.random()`, ʻaʻole `rand()`. Hoʻopau nā lula Lint i kā lākou hoʻohana ʻana i nā modula crypto.
crypto.h10p1: HMAC hoʻohālikelike, hōʻoia pūlima, hōʻoia hash password — hoʻohana nā mea a pau i nā primitive manawa mau e pale ai i nā kaila ʻaoʻao manawa.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 ʻo ia ka elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman ma luna o Curve25519 ma kona ʻano Montgomery. 32-byte kī, 32-byte kaʻana huna. Ke hoʻohana nei kēlā me kēia kī pilikino / static device identity / session key in Vortex.
crypto.h1_b: Loaʻa iā Alice lāua ʻo Bob nā kī pilikino a, b a me nā kī lehulehu A = a·G, B = b·G kahi G ʻo ia ka piko o ka piko. Helu lākou s = a·B = b·A. Hele kēia mea huna 32-byte i HKDF-SHA256 e kiʻi i nā kī AES-GCM symmetric. Hana ʻia ka helu kuhi i ka manawa mau me ke alapiʻi Montgomery; ʻaʻohe lālā o ka ʻikepili huna.
crypto.h1_c: Ua paʻi ʻia ʻo Curve25519 e Daniel J. Bernstein i ka makahiki 2005 a ua koho ʻia e ka IETF ma RFC 7748 (2016). Hoʻohana ʻia e Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard. Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex iā ia no ka mea ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki ma mua o P-256, ʻoi aku ka paʻa o ka nui kī 32-byte, pale i nā hopohopo NIST, a hoʻokō paʻakikī kēlā me kēia paepae.
crypto.h1_f:
Kī pilikino: a ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes little-endian)
Ki lehulehu: A = a · G (32-byte kiko kōmi ʻia)
Kahi huna: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, →HKDF komo)
crypto.h2_a: ʻO Ed25519 ke kaikunāne pūlima o X25519, me ka hoʻohana ʻana i ka pihi like ma kona ʻano wili-Edwards. 32-byte kī lehulehu, 64-byte pūlima, deterministic ma ka paʻamau.
crypto.h2_b: No ka hōʻailona i ka memo m me ke kī pilikino d: helu r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. ʻO ka pūlima (R, S). Hōʻoia: nānā R + c·A = S·G. ʻAʻole e hoʻohana hou ka hoʻopaʻa inoa ʻana - ʻelua pūlima o ka memo hoʻokahi me ke kī like he ʻano like.
crypto.h2_c: Ua puka mai ʻo Ed25519 (RFC 8032) mai ka pepa 2011 a Bernstein me Duif, Lange, Schwabe, a me Yang. Hoʻohana nui ʻia ma hope o 2013. Apple's CryptoKit, Google's Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH hoʻohana a pau ia. Vortex hōʻailona i kēlā me kēia envelope hui a me kēlā me kēia node hōʻoia me Ed25519.
crypto.h2_f:
Hōʻailona(d, m): r = SHA-512(d∥m);  R = r·G
              c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  S = r + ca·a
              hoʻi (R, S)

E hōʻoia: c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
crypto.h3_a: AES ma ke ʻano Galois/Counter. Nā kī 256-bit, 96-bit random nonces, 128-bit hōʻoia hōʻailona. Hoʻohana nā blob i hoʻopili ʻia ma Vortex i ka GCM.
crypto.h3_b: Holo ka GCM i AES ma ke ʻano CTR a helu i ka GHASH ma luna o ka ciphertext + AAD me ka hoʻohana ʻana i kekahi kī ʻokoʻa i loaʻa mai ke kī hoʻopunipuni. Tag = GHASH(AAD, ciphertext) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Hoʻopili hou ka Decryption i ka GHASH a hoʻohālikelike - ʻaʻole i hōʻoia ʻia kekahi bit-flip hoʻokahi. Hoʻoikaika ʻia nā lako lako ma kēlā me kēia CPU hou ma o AES-NI a i ʻole ARMv8-A hoʻonui crypto.
crypto.h3_c: Ua lanakila ʻo AES i ka hoʻokūkū NIST AES i ka makahiki 2001. Ua hoʻohālikelike ʻia ʻo GCM ma NIST SP 800-38D i ka makahiki 2007 a ʻo ia ka AEAD paʻamau ma TLS. Vortex koho i nā kī 256-bit ʻoiai ua lawa ka 128-bit i nā ʻenemi kahiko - ʻo ka lele ʻana i ka 256-bit hāʻawi iā mākou ma kahi o 128 bits o ka palekana post-quantum ma lalo o ka algorithm a Grover.
crypto.h3_f:
Hoʻopili(k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR(k, n, pt)
                          tag = GHASH_h(aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES(k, n∥1)
                          hoʻihoʻi ct∥tag
ʻAʻole hoʻohana hou ⇒ hūnā + ʻoiaʻiʻo i haki.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-based KDF, RFC 5869) hoʻololi i hoʻokahi kī i mau nui. Lawe i kahi hoʻokomo kiʻekiʻe-entropy a me kahi lepili pōʻaiapili; hoʻopuka i 32 bytes no ka lepili.
crypto.h4_b: ʻElua-ʻanuʻu: E unuhi a hoʻonui. Unuhi = HMAC-SHA256(paʻakai, IKM) → PRK. Hoʻonui = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) i hui pū ʻia no nā paita len. Hoʻohana mākou i kēia no ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i kahi X25519 puka i loko o kahi kī hoʻopunipuni, kahi kī MAC, a me kahi kī poʻomanaʻo me nā kaula ʻike "v1: encryption", "v1: mac", "v1: header".
crypto.h4_c: Ua paʻi ʻia ka HKDF e Hugo Krawczyk ma EUROCRYPT 2010 a ua hoʻohālikelike ʻia ʻo RFC 5869 i ka makahiki 2010. Hoʻohana ʻia e TLS 1.3 no kāna papa manawa, na Signal for Double Ratchet, na WireGuard no nā kī kī. ʻO ka hoʻololi ʻana i nā kaula ʻike e hiki ai iā mākou ke hoʻololi i ka hierarchy kī āpau ma ke kī ʻana i "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(paakai, IKM)
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ ʻike ∥ i)
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ … ʻoki ʻia i nā paita len
crypto.h5_a: ʻO Argon2id kahi ʻōlelo huna hoʻomanaʻo paʻakikī i hoʻolālā ʻia e pale aku i ka GPU a me ASIC mea hoʻouka. Nā ʻāpana m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5_b: Hoʻohui ʻo Argon2id iā Argon2i (kūʻē i nā ʻaoʻao ʻaoʻao ma ka hoʻopili ʻole ʻana i ka ʻikepili i loaʻa mai i ka ʻōlelo huna) me Argon2d (hoʻopiha i ka hoʻomanaʻo me ka manaʻo ʻole no laila ʻaʻole hiki i nā hāmeʻa like ke ʻoki i nā kihi). ʻO ka hapa mua o ka hala he ʻikepili kūʻokoʻa (i-mode); ʻO ke koena pili i ka ʻikepili (d-mode). 0.5 kekona o ka helu ʻana ma kahi iPhone X ma kā mākou mau ʻāpana, ma kahi o 5 ms ma kahi ASIC - liʻiliʻi ka wikiwiki ~100x i hoʻohālikelike ʻia me nā hashes e pili ana i SHA-256 kahi i lanakila ai nā ASIC ma 1 000 000 ×.
crypto.h5_c: Ua lanakila ʻo Argon2 i ka 2015 Password Hashing Competition i hoʻonohonoho ʻia e Dmitry Khovratovich lāua ʻo Alex Biryukov. Hoʻohana ʻia e like me RFC 9106 i 2021. Hoʻohana ʻia e 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. No ka OWASP 2023 mau ʻōlelo aʻoaʻo mai Vortex, i hoʻopaʻa ʻia e hoʻopaʻa inoa ma kā mākou mea kākoʻo lohi loa (iPhone X) ma lalo o 1 kekona.
crypto.h5_f:
kumu kūʻai(m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ≈ 0.5 s ma iPhone X
kumu kūʻai o ka mea hoʻouka kaua: m × t × (p / attack_parallelism)
Ma 10¹⁰ kuhi/s me 40-bit password entropy:
  10¹² kekona = 32 000 makahiki
crypto.h6_a: ʻO Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) ka NIST-standarddised post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism. Hāʻawi i nā kī hui quantum-safe i hui pū ʻia me X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Hana ʻo Alice (pk, sk). Kāhea ʻo Bob iā Encapsulate(pk) → (c, ss); hoʻouna c iā Alice. Kāhea ʻo Alice iā Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Hoʻokaʻawale nā ​​ʻaoʻao ʻelua i ka ss, kahi huna 32-byte. Hoʻemi ka palekana i ka pilikia Module-LWE, i manaʻo ʻia he quantum-hard. Hoʻohui mākou me X25519: session_key = HKDF(x25519_output ∥ kyber_output). Inā ola kekahi hapalua, ola ka hālāwai.
crypto.h6_c: Ua koho ʻia ʻo Kyber e NIST i Iulai 2022 ma hope o ka hoʻokūkū 6 makahiki. Hoʻohālikelike ʻia ʻo FIPS 203 i ʻAukake 2024. Hoʻouna ʻo Vortex iā Kyber ma ke ʻano he koho no ka mea ua hoʻohui ʻo ia i ~2 KB i kēlā me kēia kau lima lima; hoʻohana ʻia ma ka paʻamau no nā pae uku, koho i kahi ʻē aʻe. Ua ʻōlelo ʻia ke ala hybrid e Signal i 2023 a ua lawe ʻia e Chrome i 2024.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Hoʻopili(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Decaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶
hui huila = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="sesion-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Hāʻawi ʻo Signal's Double Ratchet i kahi huna huna a me ka palekana post-compromise no nā kamaʻilio 1:1.
crypto.h7_b: ʻElua kaulahao: kahi kaulahao hoʻouna a me kahi kaulahao loaʻa. Hoʻomaka kēlā me kēia memo i kāna kaulahao ma o HKDF. I kēlā me kēia manawa, hoʻomaka ka ratchet Diffie-Hellman i ke kumu, e kī hou ana i nā kaulahao ʻelua. ʻO ka ʻae ʻana i kahi kī kaulahao e hōʻike wale i nā memo i hoʻopili pololei ʻia. Ma hope o ka DH ratchet, palekana nā memo e hiki mai ana inā ʻaihue ka mea hoʻouka i ke kī kaulahao.
crypto.h7_c: Hoʻolālā ʻia e Trevor Perrin lāua ʻo Moxie Marlinspike i ka makahiki 2013, i kau ʻia ma Signal 2014, apono ʻia e WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Messenger Secret Conversations, Skype Private Conversations. ʻO nā kikoʻī lehulehu ma 2016. ʻO ka hoʻokō ʻana o Vortex he awa pololei; e launa pū me nā mea kūʻai aku ʻo Signal-protocol ma ka palapala alanui v0.4.
crypto.h7_f:
hoʻouna: CK = HKDF(CK, "step");  MK = HKDF(CK, "msg")
loaʻa: CK' = HKDF(CK', "step"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "msg")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(kou_eph, their_eph), RK_prev)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing no nā faila — ʻāpana o ka mokuna crypto. ʻO kēia kekahi o nā mīkini kumu i kuhikuhi ʻia ma ka Vortex kuhikuhi. E heluhelu i ka mokuna a puni no ka pōʻaiapili ākea; hoʻonui kēia ʻāpana i ke ʻano kikoʻī.
crypto.h8_b: Hōʻike manaʻo hoʻokō no "BLAKE3 hashing no nā faila". Hoʻokō ʻia ka mīkini ma ka module pili ma lalo o `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, a i ʻole `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Kāhea ka module README i nā ala faila pololei.
crypto.h8_c: Ua ulu ka hana "BLAKE3 hashing no nā faila" ma waena o Vortex hoʻokuʻu. Hoʻi ka hoʻolālā i ka noiʻi i paʻi ʻia a me nā hana hana o nā ʻelele mua. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka mōʻaukala mana ma `CHANGELOG.md` i ka pae ʻana o kēlā me kēia ʻāpana a me ka mea i hoʻoikaika ai.

crypto.h9_b: ʻO ka nānā ʻana o ka hoʻokō ʻana no ka "Hanauna helu random". Hoʻokō ʻia ka mīkini ma ka module pili ma lalo o `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, a i ʻole `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Kāhea ka module README i nā ala waihona pololei.
