  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd…@https://a.example,efgh…@https://b.example

hoʻomaka:
  no ka hoa ma BOOTSTRAP_PEERS:
    ho'āʻo: hoa ← peer.get('/v1/trusted_nodes'); hakihaki
    koe: hoʻomau
  hoʻomaka i ka ʻōhumu ʻōlelo

stealth.title: Uena huna
stealth.subtitle: ʻElima papa, 28 mau mīkini. ʻO nā mea a pau mai ka TLS padding a hiki i nā lawelawe onion Tor.
stealth.intro: Manaʻo ʻo Vortex i ka ʻenemi pae aupuni. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka puʻu ʻaihue no laila ʻoiai ke kāʻe ʻia nā papa o waho, hāʻawi mau nā mea i loko i ka lawelawe hoʻohaʻahaʻa-akā-hana.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 — hoʻomaʻamaʻa i ka manamana lima. Hoʻopau i nā mea hoʻohālikelike passive.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 — hoʻololi kino / nui. Hoʻopau i ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i nā mea hoʻohālikelike.
stealth.h1p3: Layer 3 — protocol camouflage. Hoʻopau i ka hana DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 - nā lawe hoʻopili. Hana ʻia ma nā pūnaewele e ālai ana i kā mākou mea mua.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 — hope-resort fallback. ʻOniona, BMP, hoʻokuʻu hoʻopaneʻe nui. Hana ʻia inā ʻaʻohe mea ʻē aʻe.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello pili iā Chrome ma Windows 11 byte-for-byte. JA3/JA4 hash pili i ka Chrome 120 — ʻaʻohe Vortex-paʻi manamana lima.
stealth.h2p2: Padding papa mooolelo: pau TLS mooolelo a pau i 16 KB. Hoʻohālikelike ka nui o ka ʻeke i ka hele ʻana o ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele.
stealth.h2p3: Hoʻouna helu mau: hoʻopuka ka queue i hoʻokahi kiʻi i kēlā me kēia N ms me ka nānā ʻole i ka hana noi. Hoʻopuka nā wā hana ʻole i nā kiʻi dummy i kaha ʻia i loko o ka enveloppe no laila e hoʻolei ka poʻe loaʻa iā lākou.
stealth.h2p4: Hoʻopaneʻe manawa: 0-50 ms ka lōʻihi ma ka puka ʻana e lanakila ai i ka latency-based DPI.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morpher: ka hāʻawi ʻana i ka nui o ka packet, ka ʻūhā ʻana, a me ka hāmau ʻana e like me ke kahawai ola YouTube. ʻAʻole kūlike nā papa helu e ʻimi ana i ka puʻuwai messenger.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath: hoʻokaʻawale ka kahe like ma luna o Wi-Fi, cellular, a me kekahi VPN hana i ka manawa like. Hoʻohui hou i ka mea hoʻokipa. E lanakila ana i ke ala hoʻokahi.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC tunnel ʻikepili: ke ālai ʻia ʻo TLS akā hana WebRTC, Vortex tunnels ma kahi ala DTLS-SRTP i kahi hoa i ʻike ʻia.
stealth.h3p4: Nā pilina hoʻopunipuni: 3 mau manawa ʻole TLS lōʻihi i Google, YouTube, a me Cloudflare. ʻIke ka mea nānā i ke ʻano o ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele maʻamau.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): ua hoʻoholo ʻia nā DNS a pau ma o DoH i Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP ʻike wale i HTTPS i kēlā mau mea hoʻoholo, ʻaʻole ka papa inoa kikowaena maoli.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Encrypted Client Hello): SNI i hoʻopili ʻia me kahi kī i paʻi ʻia ma ka moʻolelo DNS HTTPS. ʻAʻole hiki i ka poʻe mākaʻikaʻi ke ʻike i ka inoa hoʻokipa wahi.
stealth.h4p3: ʻIke ʻimi noiʻi: hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka node i nā noi me ka ʻole o ka manawa hōʻoia. ʻEkolu mau ʻimi i hāʻule ʻole mai kahi IP i 5 min e hoʻāla i ke ʻano "pae hoʻopunipuni" - ʻike ʻia ʻo IP i kēia manawa i kahi palapala pae HTML me 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): mea hoʻoheheʻe domain deterministic i hua ʻia me ka lā o kēia lā. Inā pāpā ʻia ka helu hope mua, helu nā mea kūʻai aku i ka moho aʻe a hoʻāʻo.
stealth.h5: Papa 4 — Nā halihali hiki ke hoʻopili
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: ka lawe ʻana i ke ʻano V2Ray maʻamau me kahi config JSON pluggable.
stealth.h5p2: ʻOiaʻiʻo: TLS-i loko-TLS tunnel. Nā pahu lima o waho www.microsoft.com; ʻO Vortex ka lima lima o loko. Hoʻouna ʻia nā ʻimi kūʻē i waho i Microsoft no laila ʻaʻole hōʻike ʻia ka hoʻāʻo ikaika.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: hāʻawi nā mea hoʻokele manawaleʻa Vortex kaʻa ma luna o WebRTC. Hāʻawi nā mea hoʻohana i ka hoʻonui Snowflake i ka uhi.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: hoʻololi i ka HTTPS probes e hui pū me ke ʻano ponoʻī o Chromium a hiki i ka microsecond.
stealth.h6p1: Nā lawelawe ʻonika: hōʻike ʻia kēlā me kēia node iā ia iho he '.onionʻ. Hiki i nā mea kūʻai me ke kākoʻo Tor ke hāʻule i kēia ke hāʻule nā ​​​​mea āpau.
stealth.h6p2: Blind Mailbox Protocol (BMP): hale kūʻai inoa ʻole-a-mua no nā memo. E nānā i ka mokuna BMP.
stealth.h6p3: Relay multi-hop: hiki i nā memo ke lele ma waena o 5 mau node waena, e hoʻohui ana kēlā me kēia i kahi papa o ka envelopp. E like me Tor akā i loko o kā mākou mesh ponoʻī.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): poina HTTP ma o ka relay. ʻAʻohe ʻaoʻao i ʻike i ka noi a me ka pane.
stealth.h1_a: Hoʻonohonoho ʻia ʻo Stealth e like me ʻelima mau papa kūʻokoʻa. Ua lanakila kēlā me kēia papa i kahi ʻano ʻenemi like ʻole. ʻO ka hāʻule ʻole o hoʻokahi papa e hoʻohaʻahaʻa i kahi aʻe - ʻaʻole ia e holo.
stealth.h1_b: Hoʻomaʻamaʻa ka Layer 1 i kā mākou TLS manamana lima no laila ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻokaʻawale ʻia DPI. Hoʻololi ka Layer 2 i ke ʻano o ke kahe e like me ke kahe ʻana. Hoʻopili ʻo Layer 3 i ka protocol ma o ECH / DoH / probe-pane tricks. Hoʻololi ʻo Layer 4 i nā transportable pluggable (vmess, reality, Snowflake) ke hoʻopaʻa ikaika ʻia ka mea mua. ʻO ka Layer 5 ka hopena hope loa: Tor onion, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: ʻO ke kumu hoʻohālike i hoʻopaʻa ʻia e hele mai ana mai Tor's pluggable-transports architecture (2013). Ua hoʻohui ʻo Vortex i ʻelima papa ma mua o nā ʻekolu o Tor no ka mea ma ka makahiki 2025 ua komo ka ʻāina ʻenemi DPI i ʻike i ka lawe ʻana o Tor iā lākou iho (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Hoʻokomo ʻia kēlā me kēia papa Vortex ma hope o kahi hanana kahua: L1 ma hope o ka pāpā ʻana o Kazakhstan (2019-equivalent), L2 ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻapaʻa ʻana o Iran i ka makahiki 2022, L3 ma hope o ka ʻike ʻana o DoH 2020 a Kina, L423 ma hope o nā poloka 5 o Turkey.
stealth.h1_f:
Papa enemi | pio e
------------------- | -----------
paʻa DPI | L1 (paʻi manamana lima)
kaʻa kaʻa kaʻa | L2 (kino)
ʻeleu DPI | L3 (kāhili)

stealth.h2_a: Hoʻomaopopo ka Layer 1 i ka Vortex traffic mai Chrome ma Windows 11 ma ka papa TLS.
stealth.h2_b: ʻO ke kauoha ClientHello, papa inoa hoʻonui, papa inoa cipher suite, ALPN waiwai — hoʻokani ʻia nā mea a pau e hoʻokūkū i nā bytes pololei o Chrome 120. JA3/JA4 hash pili i ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana o Chrome. TLS hoʻopaʻa paʻa i ka 16 KB. Hoʻopuka ka mea hoʻouna helu mau i hoʻokahi kiʻi i kēlā me kēia N ms me nā mea hoʻopiha dummy i ka wā hoʻomaha. He 0-50 ms ka manawa e lanakila ai ka nānā ʻana i ka latency. E holo ana nā pilina decoy i Google, YouTube, Cloudflare ma ke kua i nā 45 s.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 paʻi manamana lima i paʻi ʻia e Salesforce engineers i ka makahiki 2017. Ma ka 2019 he maʻamau ia ma ka ʻoihana DPI. Hoʻohālike ʻia ka hana maʻamau o ka manamana lima o Vortex ma uTLS, ka waihona Go a Snowflake e hoʻohana ai no ke kumu like. ʻO nā mea hoʻouna maʻamau he awa pololei o ka manaʻo "cover traffic" a WireGuard.
stealth.h3_a: ʻO ka Layer 2 morphs traffics e like me ka media streaming nui ma mua o ke kamaʻilio kūkākūkā.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morpher: hoʻolikelike ka hāʻawi ʻana i ka nui o ka packet i kahi kahawai 720p YouTube live stream (papakaukau empirical), nā pāʻani cadence pohā, nā pāʻani hāmau. Multipath: hoʻokaʻawale ʻia ke kahawai like ʻole ma luna o Wi-Fi, cellular, a me kekahi VPN hana i ka manawa like; hui hou ka mea lawe ma ke kaʻina helu. WebRTC hāʻule hoʻi hope: ke ālai ʻia ka TLS akā ke komo ʻo WebRTC, e hoʻolele i ke alahele Vortex ma o ka DTLS-SRTP kaila ʻikepili i kahi hoa i ʻike ʻia.
stealth.h3_c: Hoʻi hou ka noiʻi morphing traffic iā Wright et al. 2009. Ua hoʻokō ʻo Obfs4 iā ia ma ke ʻano he "morph" sub-mode i ka makahiki 2014. Meek+domain-fronting i aʻo mai iā mākou he mea nui ke ʻano e like me ka encryption. Ua koho ʻia ʻo YouTube no ka mea ʻo ia ka pūnaewele nui loa ʻaʻole i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i ka hapa nui o nā pūnaewele paʻa - ʻo ka peʻe ʻana i loko o ke ʻano YouTube e "pee ana i ka lehulehu".

nui_packet[i] ~ P(nui | YT-720p)

hoʻokomo ʻia nā dummy_frames i ka wā ʻole e mālama i ke ʻano o ka envelopp
stealth.h4_a: Hoʻopili ka Layer 3 i ka ʻike protocol - SNI, DNS, nā helu pane.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): hele nā ​​DNS a pau ma DNS-over-HTTPS a i Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ʻIke ʻo ISP i ka HTTPS i kēlā mau mea hoʻoholo. ECH (RFC 9460): Ua hoʻopili ʻia ʻo SNI me kahi kī i paʻi ʻia ma ka moʻolelo DNS HTTPS. ʻIke wale ka poʻe mākaʻikaʻi i ke alo mua IP. ʻImi ʻimi: ʻimi nā node i nā IP i hoʻopaʻa ʻole ʻia i ka `/api/*`; ʻekolu hāʻule i ka 5 min e hoʻohuli i ka IP i "decoy mode" - ʻike ʻo IP i kēia manawa i kahi ʻaoʻao pae static HTML me 200 OK. DGA: mea hoʻoheheʻe domain deterministic i hua ʻia me ka lā o kēia lā no laila e ʻike nā mea kūʻai aku i kahi hāʻule ke kāohi ʻia ka mea mua.
stealth.h4_c: Hoʻokuʻu ʻia ʻo DoH ma Firefox 2018 a lilo i mea paʻamau no Chrome ma 2019. Ua hele ʻo ECH i ʻelima mau kikoʻī ma mua o ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i ka makahiki 2024 — Vortex i hoʻouna i ke kākoʻo i ka wā draft-13 a ke kākoʻo nei i ka spec hope loa. Ua ʻaiʻē ʻia nā hoʻopunipuni probe-pane mai ka hoʻolālā haʻahaʻa o 2014 a hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻia i ka makahiki 2023 ma hope o ka ʻike ʻana o nā mea hoʻoikaika ikaika o Iran i ka haʻahaʻa e kona manawa pane.
stealth.h5_a: Hoʻohana ʻo Layer 4 i nā kaʻa hiki ke hoʻopili - nā ʻaoʻao ʻekolu e like me kahi mea ʻē aʻe.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: ka lawe ʻana i waho o ke ʻano V2Ray maʻamau; config JSON. ʻOiaʻiʻo: TLS-i loko-TLS tunnel kahi i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ai nā lima lima waho www.microsoft.com; ʻO Vortex ka lima lima o loko. Hoʻouna ʻia nā ʻimi hoʻoikaika i waho i Microsoft, no laila ʻaʻohe mea e hōʻike i ka hoʻāʻo ʻana. Snowflake: hāʻawi nā mea hoʻokele manawaleʻa Vortex ma luna o WebRTC; ʻaʻohe infra ma ko mākou ʻaoʻao. NaiveProxy: hoʻololi i ka HTTPS probes e hui pū me ke ʻano pololei o Chromium.
stealth.h5_c: Ua hoʻokomo ʻia ʻo V2Ray's VMess i ka makahiki 2015 e ke kaiāulu anti-censorship Kina. Hoʻokuʻu ʻia ʻo Trojan i 2019. ʻO ka ʻoiaʻiʻo mai 2022 - he pane i ka ʻike ʻana i ka manamana lima o ka Great Firewall TLS. ʻO Snowflake ka Tor Project 2020 pani no obfs4; Vortex hoʻohui i ke kākoʻo ma v0.0.9 ma hope o ka 2023 paʻa piha piha o Iran o nā wahi komo Tor.
stealth.h5_f:
ʻoiaʻiʻo inbound laʻana:
  inoa kikowaena: www.microsoft.com
  kahi: www.microsoft.com:443
  shortId: ["<ʻokoʻa>"]
Hoʻopili ka mea kūʻai aku i kā mākou IP, SNI=www.microsoft.com, koho mākou i ka pane Microsoft maoli
inā pili ke ala shortId+auth ⇒ ala i Vortex
stealth.h6_a: ʻO ka Layer 5 ka ʻeke hope loa o nā hoʻopunipuni: lawelawe aniani, BMP hale kūʻai-a-mua, relay multi-hop, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Hoʻopuka kēlā me kēia node i kahi helu `.onion`. Hāʻule nā ​​mea kūʻai me kahi pūʻali Tor-hiki i ka wā TLS + L1-L4 pau ʻole. BMP (Blind Mailbox Protocol): hoʻokuʻu ka mea hoʻouna i kahi huna i hoʻopili ʻia ma kēlā me kēia node i kī ʻia e `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")`; hoʻolaha ʻia ka ʻōlelo ʻino; huki mai ka mea loaa mai ko lakou home node. Multi-hop: lele nā ​​memo ma waena o 5 mau node waena, hoʻohui kēlā me kēia i kahi papa o ka enveloppi - e like me Tor akā i loko o kā mākou mīkini. OHTTP (RFC 9458): poina HTTP ma o ka relay no laila ʻaʻohe ʻaoʻao e ʻike i ka noi a me ka pane.
stealth.h6_c: ʻO nā lawelawe Onion i hoʻi i ka makahiki 2004 ma Tor. ʻO BMP kā mākou mea hana ponoʻī, i hoʻohālike ʻia ma ka ʻōlelo huna huna a Tor. Nā aniani relay multi-hop Ka mea hoʻouna i hoʻopaʻa ʻia a Signal me ke ala ʻala. OHTTP mai 2024, i haku ʻia e Cloudflare a me Apple no ka telemetry mālama pilikino; ua lawe mākou iā ia ma v0.0.9 ma ke ʻano he hāʻule hope loa.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP mailbox_id = HKDF(loaa_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Waiho: POST /bmp/deposit { mailbox_id, blob }
Kohi: GET /bmp/messages (hōʻoia ʻia)
TTL: 7200 s |  ʻO ka pahu kiʻekiʻe: 1 MB |  Max node: 500 MB

bmp.title: Palekana pahu leta makapō
bmp.subtitle: Hale kūʻai inoa ʻole-a-i mua no nā memo ma o ka uʻi gossip mesh.
bmp.intro: BMP hiki i ka mea hoʻouna ke waiho i kahi memo ma kekahi node me ka hōʻike ʻole ʻana i ka ʻike. ʻO ka ʻōlelo ʻinoʻino a hiki i ka node home o ka mea hoʻokipa, kahi e hoʻokaʻawale ai e like me ka mea maʻamau.
bmp.h1p1: Loaʻa ka mea hoʻouna `mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, ʻike: "bmp-v1", len: 32)`. ʻO ka mea hoʻouna wale nō (ka mea ʻike i ka recipient_pubkey) hiki ke helu; ʻike pū ka mea hoʻokipa.
bmp.h1p2: Hoʻouna ʻia nā memo `POST /bmp/deposit` me `{mailbox_id, blob}` i kēlā me kēia node ʻōlelo.
bmp.h1p3: Node hale kūʻai pālua a hiki i 7200 s. Hoʻokomo pū ʻia ʻo Node i ka mailbox_id ma ka kānana Bloom a puni ka pōʻai.
bmp.h1p4: Huki nā node ʻē aʻe i nā pōpō no nā mailbox_id a lākou e mālama nei (nā mea loaʻa ma kā lākou node).
bmp.h1p5: Koho ka mea kūʻai aku iā `GET /bmp/messages` a hoʻokaʻawale i nā pōpō hou me kāna mea kī maʻamau.
bmp.h2p1: ʻAʻole hiki i ka node ke hoʻopili i kahi blob i kahi mea hoʻouna - ʻo ka pilina TLS o ka mea hoʻouna e hōʻike i ke kumu IP, akā naʻe ke kaulahao o ka ʻaiki ma waena o ka mea hoʻouna a me ka BMP node mua e wehe pū kekahi.
bmp.h2p2: Huna ka mea hoʻokipa: hoʻopili ʻia ka blob me ka pubkey a ka mea hoʻokipa. ʻIke wale nā ​​pona waena i kahi kaula opaque byte a me kahi mailbox_id.
bmp.h2p3: ʻAʻohe hōʻoia hoʻouna i ka mea hoʻouna. ʻO nā semantics ma kahi o hoʻokahi manawa.
bmp.h3p1: ʻO ka nui o ka blob nui: 1 MB. Pono e ʻoki ʻia nā ukana ʻoi aku ma o ke kahe faila maʻamau.
bmp.h3p2: ʻO ka nui o ka waiho ʻana i kēlā me kēia node: 500 MB o nā waihona i ka huina. LRU kipaku ʻia ma ka pāpale. Hiki i nā mea hoʻohana ke hoʻololi.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: no kēlā me kēia-IP pākēneka waiho i kaupalena ʻia i 10 / min. ʻO nā ID pahu leta i ʻike ʻia ma mua o 3 mau manawa / hola ma ka node hoʻokahi i kaupalena ʻia e like me ka manaʻo o ka wai.
bmp.h4p1: ʻAʻole pono e ʻike ka mea hoʻouna i ka node home o ka mea hoʻouna.
bmp.h4p2: Hoʻohui manawa: kali nā blobs a hiki i ka hoʻopili hou ʻana a me nā koho balota.
bmp.h4p3: ʻO ka ʻōlelo hoʻoheheʻe inoa ʻole: ʻo ka ʻaoʻao o ka mea hoʻouna + BMP = ʻaʻohe metadata ma ka mea nāna i waiho i ka mea.
bmp.h1_a: BMP he papa hale kūʻai-a-mua me ka inoa ʻole. Hoʻokuʻu ka mea hoʻouna i kahi puʻupuʻu ma kēlā me kēia node i hiki ke ʻōlelo ʻia; kali ka blob ma kahi pahu leta i kī wale ʻia i ke kī lehulehu o ka mea lawe.
bmp.h1_b: Hoʻopili ka mea hoʻouna i ka `mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. ʻO ka mea ʻike wale i ka 'recipient_pubkey' hiki ke helu ia - ʻike ka mea loaʻa, ʻike ka mea hoʻouna, ʻaʻole ʻike ka ʻaoʻao ʻekolu. E hoʻouna aku i nā POST `{mailbox_id, blob}` i kēlā me kēia node haʻalulu. Mālama ʻo Node i ka lua a hiki i 7200 s (2 h), a hoʻolaha i ka mailbox_id ma ke kānana Bloom hou aʻe. ʻO nā node ʻē aʻe e ʻike ana i ka mailbox_id e pili ana i ka pahu leta huna a kahi mea hoʻohana e huki i ka blob a hoʻi i mua i ka mea kūʻai aku o kēlā mea hoʻohana.
bmp.h1_c: Ua hoʻolālā ʻia ʻo BMP mai ka wā ʻōpala e ka hui Vortex. Ua kūkulu mākou iā ia no ka mea ʻaʻohe ʻelele nui i makemake e hoʻolilo i nā kumuwaiwai e pono ai e hūnā i ka metadata end-to-end - ʻo kēlā me kēia huahana koʻikoʻi i hoʻouna ʻia i ka hoʻopiʻi maʻiʻo akā waiho ʻia ka papa hāʻawi i hāmama, no laila ʻike mau kahi kikowaena i kamaʻilio me wai a i ka wā hea. I loko o ka hui ua ʻōlelo mau mākou "he ʻelele palekana e hoʻokuʻu i ka pakuhi kaiapili he hapalua wale nō ia." BMP ʻo kā mākou pane: ʻo ka mea hoʻouna, ka mea hoʻokipa, a me ka ʻike, lilo nā mea a pau i opaque; ʻaʻohe node i loko o ka mesh i lawa nā ʻāpana e hana hou i kahi kamaʻilio. Holo ʻo ia ma luna o ka lole ʻōhumu ponoʻī a Vortex ma mua o nā ʻōnaehana paʻa, ʻo ia ka mea i kūpono ke kumukūʻai kālepa a hiki ke loiloi ʻia ka hoʻolālā i loko o ka hale.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, info="bmp-v1", len=32)

Waiho: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Hoʻolaha: gossip Bloom filter += mailbox_id
ʻOhi: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → blobs no nā pahu leka uila o ka mea hoʻohana
TTL: 7200 s |  pāpale mālama node: 500 MB |  uku helu: 10/min/IP
bmp.h2_a: Hāʻawi ʻo BMP i ʻekolu mau waiwai pilikino kūʻokoʻa: huna hoʻouna, hūnā i ka mea hoʻokipa, hūnā ʻike.
bmp.h2_b: Huna ka mea hoʻouna: TLS pili i ka node waiho i hōʻike i ke kumu IP; ʻO ka hoʻohui ʻana i kahi Tor hop a i ʻole kahi kaulahao ala ʻala i ka node BMP mua e wehe i kēlā. Huna ka mea hoʻokipa: mailbox_id he ʻano hash hoʻokahi o ka recipient_pubkey i paʻakai ʻia me ke kaula BMP — ʻike ʻia kahi puʻupuʻu waena i kahi mea ʻike 32-byte opaque. Huna maʻiʻo: ua E2E-hoʻopili ʻia ka blob no ka mea loaʻa me ka hoʻohana ʻana i nā kī maʻamau Vortex lumi / DM, no laila ʻike ʻia ka ciphertext wale nō ka piko waena.
bmp.h2_c: ʻO ka hoʻokumu ʻana i nā waiwai ʻekolu ke ʻano o ka wehewehe ʻana o Pond i kāna mau pahuhopu i ka makahiki 2014. Vortex hoʻomaʻemaʻe iā ia ma ka hana ʻana i ka mailbox_id collision-resistant (256-bit hash) no laila ʻaʻole hiki i nā mea hoʻohana pili ʻole ke kaʻana like i ka pahu leta. ʻO ka 7200-kekona TTL mai ka ʻike ʻana ua huki ʻia ka 95 % o ka poʻe i loaʻa i kā mākou beta i loko o 2 h; ʻoi aku ka lōʻihi o TTL i hoʻonui ʻia i kēlā me kēia node me ka ʻole o ka loaʻa ʻana o ka loaʻa.
bmp.h2_f:
ʻO ka ʻenemi i ʻike i ke kūlana node:
  - ʻike i ka mailbox_id i ka manawa T
  - ua ʻike anei ʻo NOT i ka mea hoʻouna (he TLS/Tor hop i haʻalele)
  - ʻike ʻo NOT i ka mea loaʻa (mailbox_id is one-way hash)
  - ʻike ʻo NOT i ka ʻike (ʻo E2E-encrypted ka blob)
bmp.h3_a: ʻO nā palena paʻa i ka nui o ka blob, ka waiho ʻana i kēlā me kēia node, a me ka uku waihona e mālama iā BMP mai ka lilo ʻana i make-drop no ka ʻikepili ʻole.
bmp.h3_b: ʻO ka nui o ka blob nui: 1 MB. Pono e ʻoki ʻia nā ukana ʻoi aku ma o ka ʻōnaehana faila maʻamau, nona kona ala mālama ponoʻī. ʻO ka nui o ka mālama ʻana i kēlā me kēia node: 500 MB ka huina o BMP waihona. I ka hiki ʻana o ka pāpale, e hāʻule nā ​​ʻōpala mua o ka kipaku mua loa ma mua o ko lākou TTL — hiki i nā mea hoʻohana ke hoʻoponopono ma o `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Ka uku hoʻopaʻa no IP: 10 i kēlā me kēia minuke, e pale aku i ke kahe mai ka mea hoʻouka hoʻokahi. ʻO nā ID pahu leka i ʻike ʻia ma mua o 3 mau manawa/hola ma waena o ka pūnaewele i kaupalena ʻia e like me "ka manaʻo i manaʻo ʻia he waikahe".
bmp.h3_c: Hoʻohālikelike ka pāpale blob 1 MB me IRC DCC-send convention a me Signal's sealed-sender cap — lawa ka nui no nā memo pōkole a me nā kiʻi liʻiliʻi, ʻaʻole hiki i ka mea hoʻouka ke hoʻohana i ka BMP no ka mālama faila. ʻO 500 MB node node he OSS-paʻamau noʻonoʻo; Hoʻonui nā mea hoʻohana nui me `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Ua hiki mai ka palena helu ma hope o ka v0.0.8 beta kahi i ho'opiha ai ka palapala ho'ā'o a ka mea ho'ā'o i nā node 50 me nā waihona i loko o 20 minuke.
bmp.h3_f:
palena:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # i kēlā me kēia minuke i kēlā me kēia IP
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # pahu leka uila like no kēlā me kēia hola
bmp.h4_a: BMP ʻālohilohi i ʻekolu hiʻohiʻona: ka poʻe i loaʻa i ka censorship kiʻekiʻe, ka pilina paʻa, ka whistleblowing inoa ʻole.
bmp.h4_b: Kiʻekiʻe-censorship: ʻaʻole ʻike ka mea hoʻouna i ka node home o ka mea hoʻokipa (a ʻaʻole hiki ke kiʻi iā ia). E hāʻule i kēlā me kēia hoa, e ʻae i ke ala ʻōlelo. Hoʻohui manawaleʻa: pahemo ka mea loaʻa no nā hola; kali blob, ʻaʻole pono e hoʻāʻo hou. ʻO ka ʻōlelo hoʻoheheʻe inoa ʻole: ʻo ka ʻaoʻao o ka mea hoʻouna + BMP = ʻaʻohe metadata e pili ana i ka mea nāna i waiho i ka mea. Hoʻohui pū ʻia me kahi kī lumi i ʻike ʻia e nā poʻe hilinaʻi wale nō, ʻaʻohe opaque ka ʻike i kekahi interceptor.
bmp.h4_c: ʻO nā hihia hoʻohana ʻekolu e hahai i nā manaʻo o ka mōʻaukala no nā hāʻule make i ka mākaʻikaʻi kino (Soviet-era), no ka 'alt.anonymous.messages' ma Usenet (1990s), a no SecureDrop (2013 ma luna). ʻO BMP kā mākou hoʻāʻo e lawe i kēlā moʻolelo i loko o kahi ʻelele hou me ka ʻole e koi i kahi mea hana kaʻawale.

push.title: Nā leka hoʻomaopopo
push.subtitle: APN, FCM, Web Push — pau me na envelopes i sila i hiki ole i na mea lawelawe ke heluhelu.
push.intro: ʻIke ʻia nā lawelawe pana maʻamau (APN, FCM, Web Push) i kēlā me kēia uku. Hoʻopili ʻo Vortex i kēlā me kēia leka hoʻomaopopo i kahi papa E2E ʻokoʻa i ʻike ka mea hāʻawi i kahi opaque blob me ka ʻole o ka id lumi, ka mea hoʻouna, a i ʻole kikokikona.
push.h1p1: Loaʻa ka mea kūʻai aku i kahi hōʻailona platform (APNs device token, FCM registration id, a i ʻole Web Push subscription JWT).
push.h1p2: Hoʻopuka ka mea kūʻai aku i kahi kī 32-byte X25519 hou `p256dh_pub` a me 16-byte ʻauth` huna. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` me `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform}`.
push.h1p3: Hoʻomau ka Node i ka 'push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at)`.
push.h2p1: Ke hiki mai ka hoʻolaha ʻana (memo hou i loko o kahi lumi leo i hoʻonohonoho ʻia e haʻi, e ʻōlelo, e kāhea i ke kono), hoʻopili ka node i ka uku me AES-GCM me ke kī i loaʻa mai `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` ma o HKDF.
push.h2p2: Node pūʻolo `{endpoint, TTL, wikiwiki, kumuhana: <collapse_key>, ikepili: <ciphertext>}` a hoʻouna aku i nā APN / FCM / Pūnaewele Push server.
push.h2p3: 'Ike 'ikepili' (ciphertext) + 'kumuhana' wale nō ka mea ho'olako. ʻAʻohe leke kikokikona.
push.h3p1: Ki kumuhana no kēlā me kēia lumi: `lumi:<id>`. E hāʻule nā ​​leka he nui i loko o ka lumi hoʻokahi i hoʻokahi hoʻolaha ma ka pae OS.
push.h3p2: Ke kumuhana pākahi: `kahea:<id>`. ʻO ka pane ʻana a i ʻole ka hōʻole ʻana e huki i ka hae; kahea hou kono i ka lumi hookahi e pani i ka mea kahiko.
push.h4p1: IOS: Hoʻopau ʻia ka hoʻonui ʻia ʻana o ka lawelawe hoʻolaha ma ke kaʻina NSE (hoʻokaʻawale ʻia mai ka app nui). Hoʻohana i nā ʻano like ʻole CryptoKit.
push.h4p2: Android: Wehewehe ʻo FirebaseMessagingService i kahi lawelawe hope. Hoʻonohonoho ʻo JobScheduler i ka UI hōʻano hou i ka wā i hoʻokumu ʻia ai ka app.
push.h4p3: Pūnaewele: Hoʻokaʻawale ʻo Service Worker ma ka pōʻaiapili SW, hoʻolaha i kahi leka kūloko ma o ka Pūnaewele Pūnaewele API.
push.h5p1: Nā APN: pono e hōʻano hou ʻia ka hōʻailona mea hoʻolako i kēlā me kēia 60 min. Hoʻomaʻamaʻa ʻia ka hōʻailona hōʻailona ma o ka Apple ʻauth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 kī faila.
push.h5p2: FCM: hoʻoilina HTTP i hoʻopau ʻia; hoʻohana mākou i ka HTTP v1 hope me OAuth2 hōʻoia moʻokāki lawelawe. Hoʻololi i kēlā me kēia 1 hola.
push.h5p3: Push Pūnaewele: VAPID kī (hoʻokahi kī paʻa ma ka node). TTL i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i nā lā 28 e ka hapa nui o nā mākaʻikaʻi.
push.h1_a: Hoʻopaʻa inoa ka mea kūʻai aku i kahi hōʻailona hāmeʻa (APNs/FCM/Web Push) me kahi kī lehulehu X25519 hou a me kahi huna 16-byte auth.
push.h1_b: Hoʻopuka ka mea kūʻai iā `p256dh_priv = rand(32)` a ʻauth = rand(16)`. Loaʻa iā `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` me `{endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, user_agent}`. Hoʻomau ʻo Node i ka 'push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at, last_refreshed_at)`. Hoʻololi: hoʻopaʻa inoa hou ka mea kūʻai aku i kēlā me kēia hoʻomaka ʻana o ka app, e hōʻoluʻolu ana i ka 'last_refreshed_at'. Hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻia nā kau inoa ma mua o 30 mau lā.
push.h1_c: Loaʻa nā kahua p256dh + auth mai ka Pūnaewele Push RFC 8291 (2017). Ua hoʻohana hou mākou iā lākou no nā APN a me FCM ʻoiai ʻaʻole pono ia mau lawelawe i ke ʻano i hoʻopaʻa ʻia - ʻo ia ka mālama ʻana i hoʻokahi ala code ma nā ʻekolu. Ma mua o ka hoʻouna ʻana o v0.0.5 Vortex i nā uku kikoʻī ma o nā lawelawe pana; ma hope o ka Apple's 2022 push privacy update a me kahi hanana ʻokoʻa kahi i kuhi hewa ʻia ai ka FCM papahana leke i nā leka hoʻomaopopo, ua hoʻoneʻe mākou i nā mea āpau i nā envelopes i hoʻopaʻa ʻia.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand(32)
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519
auth = rand(16)

POST /api/push/subscribe
  { ka hopena, p256dh: hex(p256dh_pub), auth: hex(auth), paepae }
push.h2_a: Ke pau ka hoʻolaha ʻana, hoʻopili ka node i ka uku no laila hiki i ka mea lawe wale ke heluhelu. ʻIke ʻia ka lawelawe pana (Apple / Google / Mozilla) i kahi opaque blob.
push.h2_b: Koho ʻo Node i kahi hui kī ephemeral X25519. Loaʻa ka `ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)`. Holo HKDF(paakai=auth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → kī. Hoʻopili ʻo `{title, body, room_id, message_id}` me CBOR → AES-GCM me ke kī i loaʻa + 96-bit nonce. Hoʻouna ʻo `{endpoint, TTL, wikiwiki, kumuhana: collapse_key, data: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {salt, pub_ephemeral}}` iā APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Loaʻa ka hāmeʻa, hoʻonui ʻia / lawelawe limahana hana i ka derivation kī like i ka huli ʻana, decrypts, hōʻike i ka hoʻolaha.
push.h2_c: ʻO ka pahu i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ʻo ia ka Web Push Message Encryption spec mai 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple's 2022 iOS 16 update i hoʻohui i ke kākoʻo papa mua no nā hoʻonui lawelawe hoʻolaha e hana ana i ka decryption; Ua kākoʻo ʻo Android iā ia ma o FCM memo data no nā makahiki. Vortex ʻo ia kekahi o nā ʻelele liʻiliʻi e hoʻokō nei i ke kahe piha me ka code like ma nā kahua ʻekolu - hoʻohana ʻo IOS iā `NotificationServiceExtension`, hoʻohana ʻo Android iā `FirebaseMessagingService`, hoʻohana ka Pūnaewele i ka limahana lawelawe.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = rand(32);  ephemeral_pub = ephemeral_priv · G
ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm)
kī = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Content-Encoding: aes128gcm\x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Expand(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt(kī, nonce, uku uku)
e hoʻouna { helu hope, ʻikepili: salt∥record_size∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Kāohi nā kī hoʻokaʻawale i nā leka hoʻomaopopo he nui mai ke kamaʻilio like ʻana mai ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana e like me nā hae pākahi - hoʻohui ka OS iā lākou i hoʻokahi.
push.h3_b: Hāʻule i kēlā me kēia lumi: kumuhana = `lumi:<id>`. ʻO ka `apns-collapse-id` o APN a me FCM `collapse_key` e haʻi i ka OS e hoʻololi i nā hoʻolaha mua me ke kumuhana like. ʻIke ka mea hoʻohana i hoʻokahi hae no kēlā me kēia lumi me ka nui o nā memo i hiki mai. Hāʻule kēlā me kēia kelepona: kumuhana = `kahea:<id>`; kāhea hou i ke keʻena like e hoʻololi i nā mea mua. Ka helu ʻana: kumuhana = ʻōlelo:<mea hoʻohana:<lumi>`; hoʻokahi ʻōlelo hae no kēlā me kēia lumi hoʻohana.
push.h3_c: Ua hoʻohui ʻia nā kī collapse i nā APN ma iOS 10 (2016) a i FCM i 2014. Ma mua o kēlā, ua hoʻokumu ʻia nā pūʻulu hae lehulehu i hoʻowahāwahā ʻia e nā mea hoʻohana. Telegram i paionia i ka hāʻule ʻana o kēlā me kēia lumi UX i ka makahiki 2015; ua hahai kēlā me kēia ʻelele nui. ʻO ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana o Vortex i loko o ka lumi / kelepona / hāʻule ʻōlelo mai ka manaʻo o ka mea hoʻohana i ka v0.0.6 beta i manaʻo hewa ʻia ka "kāhea kāhea e pani i ka hae kamaʻilio" - ua hoʻoponopono ʻia nā kumuhana ʻokoʻa.
push.h3_f:
Nā APN: apns-collapse-id = lumi: 42 → pani i nā hae mua
FCM: collapse_key = kelepona:17 → pani i nā hae ma mua
Pūnaewele: kumuhana = haʻi:u12:r5 → pani i nā hae mua
push.h4_a: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia paepae kona gotchas ponoʻī. Pono ʻo iOS i ka Hoʻonui lawelawe Hoʻolaha; Pono ka Android FCM memo ʻikepili; Pono ka pūnaewele i ka mea lawelawe + VAPID.
push.h4_b: IOS: hoʻouna ka pūʻulu app i kahi 'NotificationServiceExtension' pahu hopu. Hāʻawi ka ʻōnaehana i ka ukana i hoʻopili ʻia i ka NSE; NSE he 30 s o CPU + 25 MB o ka hoʻomanaʻo e hoʻokaʻawale a hoʻololi i ka leka hoʻomaopopo ma mua o ka hōʻike ʻia ʻana. FCM: hoʻouna mākou i nā memo `data` (ʻaʻole `hoʻolaha`) no laila e holo ana ka FirebaseMessagingService o ka app i ka hōʻea ʻana mai - e hāʻawi iā mākou i ka mana e hōʻike i kahi hae. Push Pūnaewele: keʻakeʻa ka mea lawelawe i nā hanana `push`, wehe, hōʻike ma o `self.registration.showNotification`.
push.h4_c: Ua hoʻokomo ʻia ke ʻano NSE e Apple ma iOS 10 (2016) kūikawā no nā hihia hoʻohana i ka memo-decryption. Ma mua o kēlā, pono e koho nā ʻelele i hoʻopili ʻia ma waena o nā uku paʻa paʻa (privacy-hostile) a me nā pahu hōʻailona wale nō (UX-hostile). Ua lele ʻo WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram i nā NSE i loko o hoʻokahi makahiki. Vortex hahai i ke kumu like.
push.h5_a: Nā mea hoʻolako kikoʻī - ʻāpana o ka mokuna pana. ʻO kēia kekahi o nā mīkini kumu i kuhikuhi ʻia ma ka Vortex kuhikuhi. E heluhelu i ka mokuna a puni no ka pōʻaiapili ākea; hoʻonui kēia ʻāpana i ke ʻano kikoʻī.
push.h5_b: Ka nānā 'ana i ka ho'okō 'ana no "Nā mea ho'olako kiko'ī". Hoʻokō ʻia ka mīkini ma ka module pili ma lalo o `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, a i ʻole `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Kāhea ka module README i nā ala waihona pololei.
push.h5_c: Ua ulu ka mīkini "mea hoʻolako kiko'ī" ma waena o Vortex hoʻokuʻu. Hoʻi ka hoʻolālā i ka noiʻi i paʻi ʻia a me nā hana hana o nā ʻelele mua. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka mōʻaukala mana ma `CHANGELOG.md` i ka pae ʻana o kēlā me kēia ʻāpana a me ka mea i hoʻoikaika ai.

controller.title: lawelawe hooponopono
controller.subtitle: ʻO ka hōʻoia pono, ka ʻike komo, ka nānā ʻana i ke olakino.
controller.intro: He kaʻina Python kaʻawale ka mea hoʻoponopono. He liʻiliʻi kona wahi hoʻouka kaua (e pili ana i hoʻokahi kakini ala) a ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia kona hilinaʻi i hoʻokahi kī lehulehu Ed25519 i kālua ʻia i nā mea kūʻai.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/kūpono` — hopena hōʻoia. Papahana: `{kūlana, pūlima_e, trusted_pubkey, version, built_at, matched, mismatched, missing, extra, message}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/ola` — ola. Papahana: `{kūlana: "ok", version, pubkey, stats:{online, aponoia, total}}`.
controller.h1p3: `GET /v1/entries` — hoʻokomo i nā URL. Papahana: `[{protocol: "wss"|"https", url}...]`.
controller.h1p4: `GET /v1/mirrors` — nā mea hoʻoponopono aniani (DNS + IPFS + .onion nā ʻano like ʻole).
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` — ʻimi hoʻonanea node. Hoʻohana ʻia e nā node hui e mālama hou i kā lākou hoʻopaʻa inoa.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — pili ka node hou no ka hilinaʻi. Pono ka ʻae o ke alakaʻi ke ʻole `AUTO_APPROVE=ʻoiaʻiʻo`.
controller.h2p1: Kōnae hōʻike: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia faila BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 pūlima.
controller.h2p2: Hanana: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Heluhelu i ke kī hoʻokuʻu mai `keys/release.key`, hele lāʻau, kākau hōʻike.
controller.h2p3: Hōʻoia: heluhelu ka mea hoʻoponopono i ka hōʻike ma ka hoʻomaka ʻana a hoʻohālikelike i ka disk. Haʻule nui ka hoʻomaka ʻana i ka like ʻole.
controller.h3p1: Holo nā aniani i ke code hoʻoponopono like me ke kī hoʻokuʻu like i kope ʻia. ʻIke nā mea kūʻai aku i ka 'signed_by' ma nā aniani - ʻo kahi ala e ʻike ai i kahi aniani hoʻopunipuni ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i nā pubkey.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS hoʻopuka i nā kuhikuhi i kekahi o nā aniani. E ho'āʻo nā mea kūʻai ma ka papa hana mua me nā manawa pau.
controller.h3p3: ʻO ka papa kuhikuhi `vortex.sol-mirror/` ma kēia repo he aniani trycloudflare mākaukau no ka hoʻomohala ʻana.
controller.h1_a: ʻO ka ʻili o ka lehulehu API ma kahi o ʻumi mau ala. ʻO nā mea liʻiliʻi, nā mea a pau i kālele i ka hōʻoia a me ke komo ʻana-URL ʻike.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/kūpono` — hōʻike hōʻike pūlima ʻia. `/v1/ola` — ola + pubkey + helu. `/v1/entries` — hoʻokomo i nā URL no ka hoʻohui ʻana. `/v1/mirrors` — nā mea hoʻoponopono aniani. `/v1/trusted_nodes` - nā hoa hui. `/v1/puʻuwai puʻuwai/{pubkey}` — ʻimi node liveness. `/v1/register` — pili ka node hou no ka hilinaʻi (ʻae ʻia ke admin koe wale nō ʻAUTO_APPROVE=ʻoiaʻiʻoʻ). ʻO ia nō - me ka noʻonoʻo haiki e mālama i ka liʻiliʻi o ka hoʻouka kaua.
controller.h1_c: Hoʻomaopopo ʻia ka hoʻolālā ʻili haiki e ka ʻike ʻana e lilo ke kaʻina hana hōʻoia i ka pahu waiwai kiʻekiʻe loa ke paʻi nā mea kūʻai aku iā ia. Code liʻiliʻi = ʻili liʻiliʻi. Hoʻohālikelike i ka node nona nā ala he 120+; he 12 ka mea hoʻoponopono. ʻO ke ʻano like: hilinaʻi ʻo Debian's apt-get i kahi kaʻina liʻiliʻi `Release.gpg` ʻokoʻa mai ka hoʻokipa pūʻolo.
controller.h2_a: ʻO `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` hele i ke kumu kumu, hashes i kēlā me kēia faila, hōʻailona me ke kī hoʻokuʻu, kākau ʻo `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Heluhelu 'ia nā kī/release.key' (32-byte Ed25519 kī pilikino). Hele `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (waiho i nā faila gitignored). No kēlā me kēia faila: `blake3(maʻiʻo) → hash`. Hoʻokumu i ka hōʻike '{version, built_at, faila: [{path, sha256, size}]}`. Hoʻopili i ka `canonical_bytes = CBOR(hōʻike)`. Nā hōʻailona: `sig = Ed25519-Sign(release_key, canonical_bytes)`. Kākau `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {hōʻike, pūlima_e: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Hoʻihoʻi ʻia nā hōʻike i kau inoa ʻia i Debian's Release.gpg (1997) a me PGP-kaulima Linux kernel tarballs. Ua hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻo Sigstore (2021) i ke kumu hoʻohālike no ka hōʻoia ʻana i ka kaulahao lako. ʻOi aku ka maʻalahi o ka mana o Vortex no ka mea e hōʻoiaʻiʻo ana ia i hoʻokahi hoʻolaha ʻana, ʻaʻole ia he kaulahao hoʻokuʻu lehulehu. Hiki iā mākou ke hoʻohana iā Sigstore ma v0.4 no nā hoʻokuʻu lehulehu.
controller.h3_a: Holo nā aniani i ke code hoʻoponopono like me ke kī hoʻokuʻu like. Kuhikuhi nā helu DNS / SNS / IPFS i kekahi o nā aniani.
controller.h3_b: Hoʻonohonoho nā mea hana i nā aniani N (maʻamau 3-5). E holo ana kēlā me kēia me ke code `vortex_controller` like me nā `keys/release.key` like. ʻIke nā mea kūʻai aku i ka 'signed_by' ma waena o nā aniani - kahi nānā hoʻomaʻemaʻe maikaʻi. DNS/SNS/IPFS hoʻopaʻa inoa i nā aniani me nā mea nui. E ho'āʻo nā mea kūʻai ma ka papa hana mua, me ka manawa pau 7-kekona i kēlā me kēia ho'āʻo. ʻO ka papa kuhikuhi `vortex.sol-mirror/` i loko o kēia repo he laʻana hoʻohālike trycloudflare i hoʻohana mua ʻia.
controller.h3_c: ʻO nā aniani he nui me ka nānā mua ʻana he ʻano like SMTP hoʻohana no MX mooolelo a me HTTPS hoʻohana no SRV mooolelo. He kumu hoʻohālike pili nā mana papa kuhikuhi o Tor — 9 DAs paʻakikī + koho. Ua koho ʻo Vortex i "koho i kahi aniani e hana ana" ma mua o "koho koho" no ka mea ʻoi aku ka maʻalahi o nā hoʻolālā koho balota akā ʻoi aku ka lohi i ka bootstrap.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/kūpono : GET → hopena hōʻoia
/v1/ola: GET → {kūlana, mana, pubkey, stats}
/v1/komo : GET → [{protocol, url}, ...]
/v1/nā aniani : GET → [controller_url, ...]
/v1/trusted_nodes : GET → [{pubkey, endpoint, health}, ...]
/v1/heartbeat/{pk} : POST (mai nā node i hoʻopaʻa ʻia wale nō)
/v1/register : POST (nodes hou)
controller.h3_f:
DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: dnslink=/ipfs/<CID>
SNS moʻo vortexx.sol: {"nā aniani": [url1, url2, url3]}
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json hana hou ʻia
Nā koho o ka mea kūʻai aku: pane mua i ka papa hana mua, 7 s manawa pau

storage.title: Papa waiho
storage.subtitle: SQLite no dev, Postgres no prod, Alembic no ka neʻe ʻana, GRDB/Room/IndexedDB ma nā mea kūʻai.
storage.intro: ʻO Vortex ka waihona node ʻo SQL. ʻO ka hoʻololi ʻana ma waena o SQLite (dev) a me Postgres (prod) kahi hoʻololi DATABASE_URL - ʻaʻohe kīʻaha code.
storage.h1p1: `mea hoʻohana(id, username, password_hash, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key?, display_name, avatar_url, phone, email, created_at, is_active)` - papa ʻike mua.
storage.h1p2: `mea hoʻohana (id, user_id, device_id, user_agent, last_seen_at, revoked_at)` — nā lālani kau pākahi.
storage.h1p3: `lumi(id, type, name, is_private, is_channel, is_dm, member_count, avatar_url, created_at, created_by, description)` — papakaukau lumi, hookahi lalani no ke keena.
storage.h1p4: `room_members(room_id, user_id, role, joined_at, muted_until)` — lālā + ACL.
storage.h1p5: `messages(id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at, edited_at?, deleted_at?, reply_to?, thread_id?, kind)` — kēlā me kēia memo, i kuhikuhi ʻia ma `(room_id, id)`.
storage.h1p6: `nā pane(mesage_id, user_id, emoji, created_at)` — hui pū kī mua `(message_id, user_id, emoji)`.
storage.h1p7: `faila(id, user_id, mime_type, nui, sha256 /* ʻoiaʻiʻo BLAKE3 */, storage_path, uploaded_at)` — waihona metadata.
storage.h1p8: `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` — helu helu hou loa no ka mea hoʻohana no ka lumi.
storage.h1p9: `Pence(user_id, last_seen_at, is_typing_in_room_id?)` — ephemeral, Redis-backed in prod.
storage.h1p10: `Federations(pubkey, endpoint, health_score, added_at, added_by, revoked_at)` — papa inoa o na hoa.
storage.h1p11: `federation_outbox(id, target_node, payload, ho'āʻo, next_retry_at)` - ka laina i waho.
storage.h1p12: `messages_scheduled(id, room_id, ciphertext, nonce, send_at, created_by, created_at, cancelled_at)`.
storage.h1p13: `contacts(user_id, contact_user_id, nickname, added_at)` — puke helu wahi.
storage.h1p14: `saved_gifs(user_id, url, width, height, added_at)` — kēlā me kēia mea hoʻohana GIF hōʻiliʻili.
storage.h1p15: `folders(user_id, id, name, room_ids, is_system, created_at)` — nā waihona kamaʻilio.
storage.h1p16: `bot_installations(user_id, bot_id, installation_at)` — hoʻokomo i kēlā me kēia mea hoʻohana bot.
storage.h1p17: `nā kau (jti, user_id, device_id, expires_at)` — hōʻano hou i ka papa inoa hōʻailona.
storage.h1p18: `Push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_at)` — hoʻopaʻa inoa.
storage.h2p1: Alembic ma ka 'alembic/versions/`. Moʻolelo laina, hoʻokahi hoʻoponopono no ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana (i kekahi manawa he liʻiliʻi no ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana).
storage.h2p2: ʻO ke ʻano Dev: `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` no ka hoʻololi wikiwiki.
storage.h2p3: Ke ʻano hana: 'alembic upgrade head' ma mua o ka hoʻomaka ʻana. Ke holo nei ke kiʻi Docker ma ka helu komo.
storage.h3p1: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — papa kuhikuhi mua no ka kiʻi ʻaoʻao.
storage.h3p2: `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — no ka hoʻonohonoho manawa ma ka hoʻoponopono.
storage.h3p3: `rections(message_id)` - no ka houluulu ma ka lumi hamama.
storage.h3p4: `read_receipts(room_id, message_id)` - no ka 'ike 'ia e N` hulina.
storage.h3p5: `mea hoʻohana_devices(user_id)` — no ka papa inoa ʻana i nā mea hana.
storage.h3p6: FTS papa ʻaina (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) no ka huli kikokikona piha.
storage.h4p1: ʻO ka 'make db-backup' e hana i kahi waihona manawa. Hoʻopili ʻia i ka wā hoʻomaha me ke kī mea hoʻohana.
storage.h4p2: Paʻa: i kēlā me kēia lā no 14 mau lā, i kēlā me kēia pule no 4 mau pule, i kēlā me kēia mahina no 12 mau mahina.
storage.h4p3: Hoʻihoʻi: `make db-restore FILE=<path>`. Holo ma ke kahua DB mua; hōʻoia ka mea hoʻohana a laila hoʻololi.
storage.h1_a: ʻO SQL ka waihona node. SQLite no dev a me ka liʻiliʻi hoʻokipa ponoʻī; ʻO PostgreSQL no ka hana hui ʻana a i ʻole multi-node. Hoʻokahi ka SQLAlchemy 2.x async code ʻelua.
storage.h1_b: Hoʻopili ma o `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` a i ʻole `postgresql+asyncpg://user:pw@host/db`. Hoʻokahi config, ʻaʻohe code forks. Ke holo nei ʻo SQLite i ka hana; Holo kaʻawale ʻo Postgres. Hana: Hoʻohana ʻo SQLite i ka ~50 mea hoʻohana like me ka ʻoluʻolu ma kahi M1; Hoʻonui ka Postgres i nā tausani. Migration Postgres → SQLite he ala hoʻokahi ma o `pg_dump --data-only` + SQLite import; ua like ka aoao e ae.
storage.h1_c: ʻO ke kumu "hoʻokahi ORM, ʻelua hope" he hana SQLAlchemy he ʻumi makahiki. Vortex hoʻohana i ka async 2.x API no laila ke kali nei kēlā me kēia nīnau. Ua koho mākou iā SQLAlchemy Core ma luna o Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` no ka moʻolelo neʻe waiwai a me ka hoʻokūkū me nā ʻōlelo async a FastAPI.
storage.h2_a: 18 papa nui: mea hoʻohana, mea hoʻohana_devices, lumi, room_members, memo, reactions, files, read_receipts, presence, federations, federation_outbox, scheduled_messages, contacts, saved_gifs, folders, bot_installations, sessions, push_subscriptions.
storage.h2_b: ʻO ka papa ʻaina mea hoʻohana ke kumu ʻike. paʻa nā lālā_room (lumi, mea hoʻohana, kuleana, hui ʻia, muted_until). lawe nā memo i ka ciphertext + metadata; kuhikuhi ʻia ma (room_id, id) no ka kiʻi ʻana i ka palapala. ʻO nā reactions he pākaukau hui-kumu-kumu. ʻO nā mea'ē aʻe he pololei. Hoʻonui ʻia ka waihona me ka helu memo - ma kahi o 1 KB i kēlā me kēia memo ma ka disk ma hope o ka papa kuhikuhi.
storage.h2_c: Ua kūpaʻa ka schema ma hope o v0.0.4. Ma mua, ua hoʻokaʻawale mākou i nā papa `dm_messages` a me `group_messages`; hoʻohui ʻia i v0.0.3 ma hope o ke kope kope ʻia ʻana o ke code fanout ma waena o lāua. ʻO nā papa he 18 ka liʻiliʻi loa no ka ʻelele piha piha; ʻO nā hoʻolālā nui e hoʻohui i nā papa ʻikepili akā ʻaʻole pono ia no ka hana.
storage.h3_a: Mālama ʻo Alembic i nā neʻe. Moʻolelo hoʻoponopono laina, hoʻokahi hoʻoponopono i kēlā me kēia hoʻokuʻu. Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia hoʻoponopono nā hana `upgrade()` a me `downgrade()`.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` mālama i nā hoʻoponopono. He faila Python kēlā me kēia me ka hoʻonui/hōʻemi. CI holo `alembic upgrade head` + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alembic upgrade head` e hō'oia i ka holo a puni. Hana: 'make db-migrate' hoʻokō i ka Docker entrypoint ma mua o ka hoʻomaka ʻana o ka app. Hoʻohana ʻo Dev mode `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` no laila wikiwiki ka ʻike me ka ʻole o ka neʻe ʻana i kēlā me kēia rebase.
storage.h3_c: ʻO Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) ʻo ia ka canonical SQLAlchemy migration tool. ʻO ka mōʻaukala laina (ʻaʻole ka lālā) he koho - pale ia i ka pilikia "hoʻokumu ʻelua mea hoʻomohala i ka helu hoʻoponopono like". Hoʻohana like ka neʻe ʻana o Django. Ua neʻe ʻo Rails mai ka laina a i ka timestamped i ka makahiki 2014 akā ua lawe hou ʻia ka linear-me-merge ma 2020.
storage.h4_a: Kohi ʻia nā papa kuhikuhi nui no laila ʻaʻole hiki ke paʻi i ka disk i nā heluhelu wela (nā memo, nā pane, nā loaʻa heluhelu).
storage.h4_b: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — helu helu helu helu helu mua. `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — hāʻule i kauoha ʻia no nā hoʻoponopono. `rections(message_id)` — hui ma ka lumi hamama. `read_receipts(room_id, message_id)` — "ʻike ʻia e N" helu. `mea hoʻohana_devices(user_id)` — papa inoa mea hana. FTS nā papa ʻaina no ka huli ʻana (FTS5 ma SQLite, tsvector ma Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Loaʻa nā koho papa kuhikuhi mai ka wehewehe-plan-profiling i ka wā hoʻāʻo hoʻouka v0.0.4. Ua hoʻomaka mākou me nā index naive a hoʻohui / wehe ʻia e pili ana i nā ʻano nīnau i ʻike ʻia. ʻO ka `messages(room_id, id DESC)` ʻo ia ka papa kuhikuhi hoʻokahi wela loa - ma kahi o 80 % o nā heluhelu i paʻi. ʻO ka mālama ʻana i ka haiki (ʻaʻole hoʻokomo i nā kolamu) hiki ke kūpono i ka hoʻomanaʻo.
storage.h1_f:
SQLite (dev): DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./vortex.db
Postgres (prod): DATABASE_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://u:p@host/db

config i hoʻouka ʻia e app.database.get_engine() → hoʻokahi ala code

bots.title: Pākuʻi Bot
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + wahi kūʻai + antispam.
bots.intro: ʻO nā bots nā mea komo lumi papa mua. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā memo me ke kī Ed25519 o ka bot no laila ʻike ʻia nā hoʻopunipuni.
bots.h1: Ke kākau ʻana i ka bot
bots.h1p1: ʻElua koho: Python SDK a i ʻole Gravitix DSL. Python no nā kaʻina hana paʻakikī; Gravitix no nā bots kamaʻilio i alakaʻi ʻia i ka hanana e pono e holo wikiwiki.
bots.h1p2:
Python laʻana: `mai vortex_bot import Bot
bot = Bot(token=...)
@bot.on_message
async def echo(msg): kali bot.send(msg.room_id, msg.text)
bot.run()`. Hoʻopili ka SDK i ka WebSocket, hoʻohui hou, hoʻololi kī hoʻopunipuni.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix laʻana: `on /start { emit "Aloha, {ctx.first_name}!" }`. Hoʻopili i ka bytecode a holo i loko o kahi unuhi ʻōlelo sandboxed.
bots.h1p4: Hoʻopuka ʻia ka hōʻailona bot ma ka hana ʻana i ka bot. Nalo ka hōʻailona? Hoʻopuka ʻo `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` i kahi mea hou.
bots.h2p1: ʻElua mau hiʻohiʻona hoʻolālā: in-process (coroutine i loko o ka node) a me waho (bot votes `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: Ke kaʻina hana: zero network hop, wikiwiki loa, akā pono ka mea hoʻohana e hilinaʻi i ka code bot. Good no nā bots ponoʻī.
bots.h2p3: Ma waho: webhook a i ʻole long-poll. ʻAʻole pono ka hilinaʻi node-level. Good no nā bots ʻaoʻao ʻekolu a me ka mākeke.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix holo mau nā bots i loko o ka pahu one — ʻaʻohe o lākou waihona waihona a i ʻole ke komo pūnaewele koe wale nō API.
bots.h3p1: Hiki i nā bots lehulehu ke waiho i ka mākeke. Hōʻoia ka poʻe loiloi ʻaʻole phish, ʻaʻole spam, ʻaʻole hoʻokahe i ka ʻikepili mea hoʻohana.
bots.h3p2: Māhele: huahana, pāʻani, nūhou, pono, ai, unuhi.
bots.h3p3: E hoʻouka: hoʻokahi kaomi. Kākoʻo ʻo Node i ka mea hoʻohana i ka inoa inoa o ka bot no laila ke ala pololei ʻo DM.
bots.h3p4: Monetization: manuahi, kūʻai hoʻokahi manawa, kau inoa. Uku kahua 10 %% o ka nui.
bots.h4p1: Mālama ʻia kēlā me kēia lumi e kahi bot antispam ʻike ʻole. Nā hōʻoia: ka nui o ka loulou > 3 i kēlā me kēia minuke, ka lākiō hua nui-letter > 70 %% no 10+ mau chars, hoʻihoʻi i nā memo, pohā koke o nā mea hoʻohui moʻokāki hou.
bots.h4p2: Nā hana: e aʻo → ka manawa pau (5 min) → kik → pāpā. Hele nā ​​hoʻopiʻi i ka luna hoʻomalu lumi.
bots.h4p3: Hiki ke hoʻokani ʻia i kēlā me kēia lumi ma o ka bot config.
bots.h1_a: ʻO nā bots nā mea komo lumi papa mua. Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia me kahi kī Ed25519 a me kahi hōʻailona; kau inoa ʻia kēlā me kēia memo a lākou e hoʻouna ai, no laila ʻike ʻia nā hoʻopunipuni.
bots.h1_b: Hana: ka mea nona ka POSTs `/api/bots` me `{inoa hoohana, display_name, code}`. Hana ʻo Node i kahi lālani `mea hoʻohana` me `is_bot=true`, hoʻopuka i kahi kī kī Ed25519, hoʻihoʻi i ka hōʻailona bot kī pilikino i ka mea nona (hōʻike ʻia i hoʻokahi manawa). Holo: noho ka bot ma ke kaʻina hana ma ke ʻano he coroutine a i ʻole nā ​​koho balota waho `/api/bots/{id}/updates` me kāna hōʻailona. Lawe ʻia nā memo mai nā bots `from_bot: true` hae a ua pūlima ʻia me ke kī pilikino o ka bot.
bots.h1_c: Ua hoʻomaka ʻia nā Bot API e Slack (2014) a hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻia e Telegram (2015). ʻO Vortex wīwī: hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā pūlima bot i nā memo i ka ʻike bot, no laila ʻaʻole hiki i kahi node hoʻopaʻapaʻa ke hana "@bot ʻōlelo ʻo X". Ua hoʻohui ke kākoʻo bot Matrix i kēia waiwai ma 2021 ma o nā pūlima hui; Loaʻa iā Vortex mai ka v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: ʻO Gravitix he ʻōlelo kikoʻī kikowaena no ke kākau ʻana i nā bots hoʻokele hanana. Liʻiliʻi, hōʻike, hōʻuluʻulu ʻia i ka sandboxed bytecode.
bots.h2_b: Syntax: `on /start { emit "Aloha, {ctx.first_name}!" }`. Hoʻopili nā mea lima i nā mea hoʻoulu (kauoha, regex, hanana). He kaʻina o ke kino o `emit`, `let`, `if`, `schedule`, etc. Hoʻopuka ka mea hōʻiliʻili i ka bytecode; Unuhi ʻo runtime i loko o kahi pahu one me ka waihona waihona ʻole, ʻaʻohe pūnaewele ʻokoʻa, ʻo Vortex's API wale nō. Kuhikuhi piha ma ka mokuna Gravitix docs.
bots.h2_c: Ua hoʻolālā ʻia ʻo Gravitix i ka wā v0.0.6 ma hope o ka ʻike ʻana i ka hapa nui o nā code bot he 80 % boilerplate e uea i ka Vortex SDK, me kahi kernel o ka loiloi maoli ma waenakonu. Hiki i ka DSL ke alohilohi a pale i ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana i ka Python i loko o kahi kaiapuni bot-dev kahi e pakele ai ka pahu one.
bots.h3_a: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia lumi kahi bot antispam i ʻike ʻole ʻia e nānā ana i ka waikahe, loulou spam, memo hou, a me ka hui pū ʻana o ka moʻokāki hou.
bots.h3_b: Nā rula: ka nui o ka loulou > 3 i kēlā me kēia minuke mai hoʻokahi mea hoʻohana, ALL-CAPS ratio > 70 % ma nā memo ≥ 10 chars, hoʻihoʻi hou i ka memo > 3 mau manawa i 30 s, pohā o nā mea hoʻohui me ka makahiki helu <24 h > 20 i 60 s. Hoʻonui ʻia nā hana: ʻōlelo aʻo → 5 mau minuke manawa → 1 hola kiki → pāpā (ʻae ʻia e ke alakaʻi no ka pāpā). Hiki ke hoʻokani ʻia i kēlā me kēia lumi ma o ka `/antispam config`.
bots.h3_c: Hele mai nā heuristic Antispam mai kahi synthesis o nā lula bot IRC-era (Eggdrop, BitchX) a me nā ʻōnaehana hou e like me Discord AutoMod. Ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā paepae kikoʻī ma Vortex e kūʻē i kahi kino beta 6 mahina o 200k memo; ʻO ka helu kuhi hewa he ~0.3 % no ka helu hoʻopiʻi pāpā i ʻike ʻia.
bots.h4_a: Hoʻouna nā bots lehulehu i ka mākeke. Hōʻoia ka poʻe loiloi ʻaʻole phishing / ʻaʻohe spam / ʻaʻohe leak data. Nānā nā mea hoʻohana ma ka māhele a hoʻokomo me hoʻokahi kaomi.
bots.h4_b: Hoʻouna: hoʻopuka ka mea nona ke kumu bot + wehewehe. Holo ka mea nānā i ke code i loko o kahi pahu one, heluhelu iā ia no nā ʻano anti-pola i ʻike ʻia, nānā i nā kelepona pūnaewele ma o nā API i ʻae ʻia, hōʻoia i ke kulekele pilikino. Papa inoa: waeʻano, kumukūʻai, helu helu, helu hoʻokomo. E hoʻouka: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — hana ka node i ke kau inoa no kēlā me kēia mea hoʻohana. Monetization: manuahi / hoʻokahi manawa / kau inoa; e lawe ana ka paepae i 10 %.
bots.h4_c: Hoʻi hou nā mākeke App i ka 2008 App Store. Slack App Directory (2015), Discord Bot Listings (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). ʻOi aku ka 10% ʻoki o Vortex ma mua o ka 30% o Apple a haʻahaʻa iki ma mua o ka 20% o Shopify, i koho ʻia e hoʻoikaika i nā mea hoʻomohala e paʻi. Hoʻohālikelike ʻia ke kulekele loiloi ma ka "review by default, delist on complaint" a GitLab.
bots.h3_f:
nā mea hoʻoulu:
  link_density > 3/min → aʻo
  all_caps_ratio > 0.7 (≥10c) → aʻo
  repeat_count > 3 i 30s → aʻo
  new_joiner_burst > 20 i 60s → laka lumi

piʻi ʻana:
  2 mau ʻōlelo aʻo → 5 min ka pau ʻana
  3 ʻōlelo aʻo → 1 h kiki
  4 mau ʻōlelo aʻo → pāpā ʻia (ʻae ke alakaʻi)
bots.h4_f:
waeʻano: huahana, pāʻani, nūhou, pono, ai, unuhi
kumu kūʻai: manuahi | hoʻokahi manawa (USD nui) | kau inoa (USD/mahina)
ʻoki: 90 % i ka mea hoʻomohala, 10 % i Vortex
loiloi: manual, ~ 3 mau lā ʻoihana huli huli

ops.title: Nā hana
ops.subtitle: Hoʻopili, nānā, hoʻihoʻi.
ops.intro: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia hana hana he 'make' target a i ʻole he kauoha CLI. Noho nā ʻaoʻao ops ma `deploy/`.
ops.h1p1: Hoʻopuka ʻo 'docker compose up' i ka node, ka mea hoʻoponopono, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p2: Nui: `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs`. Mauna i hookipa no ka hoomau ana.
ops.h1p3: Kaiapuni: `.env` ma ke kumu repo. Mai hoʻohiki. ʻO `.env.example` ke kumu hoʻohālike.
ops.h1p4: Kiʻi kaʻa Caddy Let's Encrypt palapala. Let's Encrypt kau palena palena — hoʻohana i ka hoʻokūkū no nā hoʻokolohua.
ops.h2p1: `make install` — hoʻokomo i nā mea hana Python deps + dev.
ops.h2p2: 'make dev' - uvicorn me ka hoʻouka hou ʻana ma ke awa 9000.
ops.h2p4: `make lint` — ruff + mypy. CI poloka i nā hemahema.
ops.h2p5: `make docker-build` — kūkulu i ke kiʻi i hōʻailona ʻia `vortex:<VERSION>`.
ops.h2p8: `make ci` - holo i ka paipu CI piha ma ka ʻāina.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` he puolo PyInstaller me kahi pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Holo mua: koho i ka inoa node → hoʻopuka i nā kī hoʻokuʻu → hoʻonohonoho TLS (Let's Encrypt / lawe mai iā ʻoe iho / pūlima ponoʻī) → koho i nā URL komo → hiki i ka stealth → wehe i nā awa pā ahi.
ops.h3p3: Ma hope o ka hoʻonohonoho ʻana, noho ʻo wizard ma ke ʻano he admin console: hoʻomaka / hoʻomaha node, nānā i nā lāʻau, hoʻololi i nā kī, hoʻohui i nā hoa hui.
ops.h4p1: Hoʻopili ʻia kēlā me kēia hoʻokuʻu ma git. Ua pūlima pū ʻia me ke kī hoʻokuʻu no laila hiki ke hōʻoia ʻia ka tag ponoʻī.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && hana docker-build && docker compose up -d`. Holoi nā nodes a hoʻomaka hou.
ops.h4p3: DB: Kākoʻo ʻia ʻo Alembic `downgrade <rev>` no hoʻokahi mana liʻiliʻi i hope. ʻO ka hope aku e pono ai ka hana lima.
ops.h1_a: Hoʻopuka ʻo `docker compose up` i ka waihona Vortex piha: node, controller, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` ma ke kumu repo. Nā Volumes `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` i kau ʻia i mea hoʻokipa no laila e mau ana ka ʻikepili ma nā hoʻomaka hou ʻana. Healthchecks: node health inā ho'iho'i '/health/ready` 200; mea hoʻoponopono inā hōʻoia ʻo `/v1/integrity`. Kiʻi kaʻa Caddy Let's Encrypt palapala. Hāʻawi ʻo .env` i nā mea huna (ʻaʻole loa e hana). ʻO `.env.example` ke kumu hoʻohālike.
ops.h1_c: ʻO Docker Compose ke kumu de-facto no nā lawelawe hoʻokipa ponoʻī multi-container. Hoʻohana ʻo Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux. Vortex ka waihona haku mele mai v0.0.2 aku; ua paʻa ke ʻano o kēia manawa ma v0.0.5. Waiho ʻia nā mea ʻokoʻa (k8s, nomad) ma ke ʻano he hoʻomaʻamaʻa no nā mea hana nui.
ops.h2_a: ʻO Makefile ke kikowaena kikowaena no kēlā me kēia hana dev a me ops. 'E hana i kōkua' papa inoa i nā pahuhopu.
ops.h2_b: `make install` → `pip install -r requirements.txt`. `make dev` → uvicorn me ka hoʻouka hou. `hana ho'āʻo` → pytest + uhi, hoʻopuka 'coverage.xml`. `make lint` → ruff + mypy. `make docker-build` → `docker build -t vortex:$VERSION`. `make db-migrate` → `alembic upgrade head`. `make db-backup` / `make db-restore FILE=...`. `make ci` → piha CI paipu ma ka ʻāina.
ops.h2_c: ʻO kahi Makefile ma ke ʻano he canonical entrypoint kahi hana Unix he mau ʻumi makahiki, ʻae ʻia e kēlā me kēia papahana Python nui (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). ʻO nā mea hana ʻē aʻe (Poetry, Hatch, uv) he ʻono-o-ka-makahiki; Hana ʻoluʻolu a puni.
ops.h3_a: ʻO ka wizard hoʻonohonoho he pūʻolo PyInstaller (`Vortex Wizard.app`) me kahi pywebview GUI e hele ana i kahi mea hoʻohana mua ma o ka hoʻolālā ʻana.
ops.h3_b: Holo mua: koho i ka inoa node → hoʻopuka i nā kī hoʻokuʻu (Ed25519 keypair mālama ʻia i `keys/release.key`) → hoʻonohonoho TLS (Let's Encrypt / lawe mai iā ʻoe iho / kaulima ponoʻī) → koho i nā URL komo (vortexx.sol / custom domain / . (iptables/ufw/pf). Ma hope o ka holo mua, noho ʻo wizard ma ke ʻano he admin console: hoʻomaka / hoʻōki i ka node, nānā i nā lāʻau, hoʻololi i nā kī, hoʻohui i nā hoa hui.
ops.h3_c: ʻO nā wizards hoʻonohonoho ke kumu no nā mea hana hoʻokipa ponoʻī e huli ana i nā mea hoʻohana non-sysadmin: Ghost's onboarding (2015), Standard Notes 'server setup, Mastodon's installation questions. Hāʻawi ʻo PyInstaller iā mākou e hoʻouna i hoʻokahi binary kaomi pālua; Hāʻawi ʻo pywebview i kahi ʻaoʻao HTML kūloko i lawelawe ʻia e kahi pūʻulu FastAPI API ma 127.0.0.1 — polokalamu kele pūnaewele UX me ka paʻakikī o ke kūkulu ʻana i kahi kamaʻāina GUI.
ops.h4_a: Hoʻopili ʻia kēlā me kēia hoʻokuʻu ma git. ʻO Rollback ka `git checkout <tag> && hana docker-build && docker compose up -d`. Loaʻa i nā neʻe nā hana `downgrade()`.
ops.h4_b: Ua pūlima ʻia nā lepili me ke kī hoʻokuʻu no laila hiki ke hōʻoia ʻia ka hōʻailona ponoʻī. ʻO ke kaʻina hana hoʻihoʻi: nānā i ka hōʻailona kahiko, kūkulu hou i ke kiʻi, hana hou i nā ipu - e holo ana nā pilina ma SIGTERM (ʻo 15 s ka lokomaikaʻi). DB: Hoʻihoʻi ʻo `alembic downgrade <rev>` i hoʻokahi hoʻoponopono. Ka pale ʻana i ka pohō ʻikepili: ʻaʻole mākou e hāʻule i nā kolamu i ka hoʻokuʻu hoʻokahi; hiki mai nā hāʻule N+1 ma hope o ka pau ʻana o ke code i ka heluhelu ʻana iā lākou.
ops.h4_c: ʻO ke ʻano o ka neʻe ʻana o ka "code-then-code" (expand-migrate-contract) he mea maʻamau no ka hoʻomoe ʻana i ka zero-downtime. ʻO kā Stripe's migration guide (2019) ka wehewehe maikaʻi loa. Vortex apono ia ia ma hope o kekahi hanana ma v0.0.3 kahi i hoʻokuʻu ai ke kolamu i ka puka makani mālama 30 minuke.

mobile.title: Nā mea kūʻai kelepona
mobile.subtitle: IOS a me Android — kamaaina UI, protocol like.
mobile.intro: He mau hoa piha nā mea kūʻai paʻa lima ʻelua, ʻaʻole nā ​​wīwī pūnaewele lahilahi. Nā hiʻohiʻona maoli, ka hana ʻōiwi, nā hoʻohui ʻōiwi (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lock Screen widgets).
mobile.h1p1: ʻO ka Swift Package ma `ios/Modules/`. 30+ hiʻohiʻona modules, kēlā me kēia SOLID-split `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: Pahu polokalamu ma `ios/VortexApp/`. XcodeGen spec ma `ios/project.yml` hana hou i ka xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p3: Crypto: CryptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Hele nā ​​hoʻololi a pau ma o `db.write`.
mobile.h1p6: Push: Nā APN ma o `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Hoʻonui lawelawe hoʻolaha no ka wehe ʻana.
mobile.h2p1: Gradle papahana ma `android/`. 22 feature modules with Hilt DI, same `api / impl / di / ui` split.
mobile.h2p4: DB: lumi me FTS4 mau mea hoʻonāuki.
mobile.h3p1: Puʻolo like 146-local me nā inoa ʻōiwi (`Русский ru`, `English en`, `中文 zh`, …).
mobile.h3p2: Kākoʻo like 1500-emoji me 9 mau ʻano + ʻili-ʻili + MRU + huli.
mobile.h3p3: Ka helu lehulehu X25519 hoʻopiʻi-pane no ka hoʻololi ʻana.
mobile.h3p4: Nā waihona kamaʻilio like (All / Archived / custom) me ka hoʻonohonoho hou ʻana.
mobile.h3p5: Ka papa inoa o nā GIF i mālama ʻia (ʻaʻohe Tenor - hōʻiliʻili pilikino wale nō).
mobile.h3p6: Nā memo i hoʻonohonoho like ʻia UI, ʻaoʻao pili, ʻaoʻao kūlana premium.
mobile.h1_a: ʻO ka mea kūʻai aku ʻo iOS he Swift Package me 30+ hiʻohiʻona modules. ʻO ka protocol HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC like me kēlā me kēia mea kūʻai aku.
mobile.h1_b: Hoʻonohonoho ʻia nā modula e ka hiʻohiʻona: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Files`, `Calls`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Folders`, `Accounts`, `SavedGifs`, `Contacts`, `Scheduled`, `Premiuma`. ʻO kēlā me kēia māhele i `api/` (nā protocols), `impl/` (nā papa paʻa), `ui/` (SwiftUI nānā). Crypto: CryptoKit no X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift no Argon2id. DB: GRDB me FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFramework. Push: Nā APN me ka Hoʻonui lawelawe Hoʻolaha no ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana.
mobile.h1_c: ʻO nā ʻeke modular ka hana Swift maʻamau mai ka Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). ʻO kā mākou māhele ʻana i api/impl/ui ʻo SOLID-ish: hoʻohuli i ka hilinaʻi (pili nā modules i api/ wale nō), ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana o nā hopohopo, hiki ke hōʻoia (swap impl no nā hoʻokolohua). ʻO ka helu 30+ module he koho no ke kūkulu ʻana i ka parallelism - ʻo kēlā me kēia module e hōʻuluʻulu kaʻawale.
mobile.h2_a: Hōʻike ka mea kūʻai aku Android iā iOS: Kotlin + Compose + Hilt DI. 22 hiʻohiʻona modules, like `api / impl / di` mahele.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), targetSdk 34 (Android 14). Crypto: palekana AndroidX + Tink no AES-GCM; argon2-jvm no Argon2id. DB: lumi me FTS4 mau mea hoʻonāuki. WebRTC: Stream WebRTC Android. Push: FCM ma o FirebaseMessagingService + i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i ka envelopp decryption. Gradle multi-module, hoʻohui ʻo Hilt i nā modula hiʻona me ka ʻole o ka hilinaʻi pololei.
mobile.h2_c: ʻO Compose ka Google's declarative UI toolkit, stable mai ka makahiki 2021. Hilt (2020) is the Google-endorsed DI framework on top of Dagger 2. Hoʻohui like lākou i nā mea hoʻopili waiwai SwiftUI + ma IOS no kahi hale kūkulu like like. Vortex apono 'ia Compose/Hilt mai v0.0.4 ma luna; ʻO ka Android ma mua he View-based.
mobile.h3_a: Hoʻonohonoho ʻia ʻo iOS a me Android i ka 146-locale JSON i hoʻonohonoho ʻia me nā inoa ʻōiwi a me 1500-emoji catalog — he mea hoʻohana e kākau 🥹 ma iOS 17 renders 🥹 ma Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Sources/I18N/Resources/locales/*.json` aniani `android/app/src/main/assets/locales/*.json`. Hoʻouka nā polokalamu ʻelua i ka wahi kūpono i ka hoʻomaka mua ʻana (ka ʻōlelo koho ʻōlelo) a hoʻomau i ke koho. ʻO ka papa inoa emoji he 9-kaulana JSON i hoʻouna ʻia ma nā pūʻolo ʻelua; ʻo ia ka ʻaoʻao OS-level emoji-set divergence i ʻole e hoʻoulu i nā glyphs `?` unrendered ma nā OS kahiko.
mobile.h3_c: ʻO ka hoʻouna ʻana i kāu palapala emoji ponoʻī ke kumu hoʻohana Telegram (kā lākou Twemoji fork) a me WhatsApp i hoʻohana ʻia a hiki i 2022. ʻO ke kālepa-off: ~300 KB keu no kēlā me kēia pūʻulu app no ​​emoji + ~1.2 MB no nā wahi. Pono ia no ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana o ke kahua paʻa.

webclient.title: Mea kūʻai pūnaewele
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanilla JS, mode offline, limahana lawelawe.
webclient.intro: ʻO ka mea kūʻai pūnaewele he vanilla-JS PWA. ʻAʻohe React, ʻaʻohe puʻupuʻu ma mua o ESM. ~400 KB ka huina o ka gzip, me 146 mau wahi.
webclient.h1p1: ʻO static/js/main.js ke komo. Hōʻikeʻike modules lazy-load ma ka hoʻohana mua.
webclient.h1p2: Mokuʻāina: nā pahu apo no kēlā me kēia lumi ma IndexedDB, kahi huna huna i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i loko o ka memo. Lawelawe ka limahana lawelawe.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Nā hopena Glass Liquid ma o CSS backdrop-filter. ʻAʻohe papa; 'elele hanana
webclient.h2p1: ʻO kekahi kākau i hana ʻia i ka wā e hoʻopaʻa ʻia ana ka laina i IndexedDB. Holoi ka SW ke hoʻi ka pilina.
webclient.h2p2: ʻO ke kī Idempotency ma kēlā me kēia POST e ʻae i ka hoʻāʻo hou ʻana me ka palekana.
webclient.h2p3: Hoʻohana paʻa ʻole ka heluhelu ʻana - ola nā ciphertext i hoʻonohonoho ʻia ma IndexedDB.
webclient.h3p1: 146 mau wahi ma `static/locales/*.json`. ʻO ka pale hoʻokipa (`lang-picker.js`) nā pōʻai ma o nā ʻōlelo hōʻailona inoa ʻōiwi.
webclient.h3p2: Hoʻololi kaʻina manawa holo: `document.documentElement.lang = code` + hoʻihoʻi hou i nā lepili ma o nā ʻano ʻikepili-i18n.
webclient.h1_a: ʻO ka mea kūʻai pūnaewele he vanilla-JS PWA. ʻAʻohe React, ʻaʻohe pae kūkulu ma mua o ESM pūʻulu. Huina JS i hoʻouna ʻia: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: ʻO `templates/base.html` ʻo ia ka pūpū i hāʻawi ʻia e Jinja2. ʻO `static/js/main.js` ka ES-module komo. Nā modula hiʻona ma `static/js/<feature>/` lazy-load ma ka hoʻohana mua ʻana. CSS ma `static/css/` me kahi hui 1-file-per-component. Hana ʻo Service Worker i kahi huna huna; ʻO ka hoʻouka mua mai ka pūnaewele, ma hope mai kahi huna; hōʻano hou i nā loiloi ma ka hoʻokele.
webclient.h1_c: ʻO ka noho ʻana ma waho o nā frameworks he hoʻoholo v0.0.1 noʻonoʻo ma hope o ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i ka React a me Vue PWA ma ~1.5 MB gzipped me nā hiʻohiʻona like. Hāʻawi nā modules Vanilla JS + ES iā mākou ~400 KB. ʻOi aku ka nui o ka DOM-manipulation boilerplate, a mākou e hoʻēmi ai me nā mea kōkua liʻiliʻi ma `static/js/lib/dom.js`.
webclient.h2_a: Ke ʻano hoʻopahemo: kākau i waho i ka pila i IndexedDB; Holoi ka mea hana lawelawe ke hoʻi ka pilina.
webclient.h2_b: ʻO kēlā me kēia POST / PATCH ka mea hoʻohana e hana i waho e loaʻa i kahi kī idempotency a pae i ka `outbox` (IndexedDB). Hoʻolohe ʻo Service Worker no ka hanana 'online' a hoʻouna hou me ke kī idempotency ma ke poʻo. Hoʻomaopopo ke kikowaena i nā kope ma o ke kī idempotency a hoʻihoʻi i ka pane kumu. Helu piha ka heluhelu ʻana — ola nā ciphertext i hoʻopaʻa ʻia a pau ma IndexedDB a hoʻokaʻawale i ka ʻāina me nā kī hoʻomanaʻo.
webclient.h2_c: ʻO nā kī Idempotency no nā POST hiki ke hoʻāʻo hou ʻia ʻo Stripe's 2017 convention, i hāpai ʻia e ka hapa nui o nā API hou. ʻO IndexedDB ma ke ʻano he pahu puka waho ke kumu hoʻohana Google Hoʻohana i ka pūnaewele no nā hoʻoponopono waho waho. ʻO ka hoʻokō ʻana o Vortex he ~200 laina ma `static/js/lib/outbox.js`.
webclient.h3_a: 146 pūʻolo ʻōlelo ma `static/locales/*.json`. ʻO nā pōʻai hoʻokipa ma o nā ʻōlelo hōʻailona inoa maoli (`Выберите язык` / `E koho i kāu ʻōlelo` / `选择语言` / …).
webclient.h3_b: ʻO ka hoʻomaka mua: 'lang-picker.js' hōʻike i kahi hōʻailona kikokikona-animated e huli ana ma nā wahi he 97 ma 45 ms/char, hoʻomaha 1.8 s, holoi ma 30 ms/char, holomua. Koho ka mea hoʻohana i ka ʻōlelo; Ua hoʻomau ʻia ma `localStorage.vortex_lang`. Heluhelu ʻia kēlā me kēia holo hope i ke koho i mālama ʻia. Hoʻololi ka wā holo: `setLang(code)` hoʻouka i ka JSON, hoʻihoʻi hou i nā mea ʻikepili-i18n`.
webclient.h3_c: ʻO ke ʻano mea kākau-hint he mea hoʻomana i nā pale splash terminal kahiko a ua lawe ʻia no ka UX mehana ma hope o ka hōʻike ʻana o ka v0.0.6 beta i nā mea hoʻohana i ka hāʻule ʻana i lalo. Hāʻawi nā ʻōlelo hōʻike kaʻa kaʻa i ka pukaaniani 1 kekona no kēlā me kēia mea hoʻohana e ʻike i ka inoa o kā lākou ʻōlelo a ʻike koke iā ia.
webclient.h1_f:
shell: templates/base.html (server-rendered Jinja2)
komo: static/js/main.js (ES module)
nā hiʻohiʻona: static/js/{kamailio, lumi, auth, kelepona, faila, bots}/...
SW: static/service-worker.js
nui: ~400 KB ka nui o ka gzip
webclient.h2_f:
ke kahe kākau pahemo:
  1. helu idempotency_key = rand(16).hex
  2. db.outbox.put({url, ala, kino, idempotency_key, ts})
  3. ma ka 'online': pahu pahu pahu
     no kēlā me kēia lālani: kiʻi (url, {ʻano, kino, poʻomanaʻo: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: wehe i ka lālani
       → 4xx: hāʻule lālani (hiki ʻole)
       → 5xx/pahemo: hoʻāʻo hou ma hope
webclient.h3_f:
lang-picker.js:
  hōʻike = ["Выберите язык", "E koho i kāu ʻōlelo", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  ʻAno hōʻailona ma 45 ms/char → hoʻomaha 1.8 s → holoi ma 30 ms/char → hoʻomaha 0.2 s → aʻe

hoʻololi manawa holo:
  localStorage.vortex_lang = code
  fetch('locales/' + code + '.json') → pili i nā mea data-i18n

security.title: Kūlana palekana
security.subtitle: ʻO ke ʻano hoʻoweliweli, pale-i-hohonu, WAF, ala hoʻoponopono, canary.
security.intro: Vortex hoʻohana i ka pale-hohonu: ʻaʻole lawa ka haki ʻana i hoʻokahi papa, pono ka mea hoʻouka kaua maoli i nā lanakila kūʻokoʻa he nui.
security.h1p1: **Ka mea nānā pūnaewele paʻa**: ʻike i nā ʻeke TLS; hana i ka nui / ka nānā ʻana i ka manawa. Hoʻopio ʻia e ka pae 1 ʻaihue.
security.h1p2: **Ka mea hoʻouka kaua pūnaewele **: hiki ke hāʻule / lohi / hoʻokomo. Hoʻopio ʻia e ka pae 2-4 malū.
security.h1p3: **Ka mea hoʻohana node i hoʻopaʻa ʻia**: ʻike i ka ciphertext + metadata. Mālama ʻia ka ʻike memo.
security.h1p4: **Mea mea kūʻai aku ʻaihue**: hōʻike ʻia ke kikokikona o nā memo i hala. Nā palena ʻelua Ratchet i ke kau o kēia manawa; hiki i ka holoi ʻana i ka wehe ʻana.
security.h1p5: **He ʻenemi kūhelu me nā kaʻa i mālama ʻia i hala**: lanakila ʻia e nā kī hui hybrid Kyber-768 i ka wā i hoʻolaha ai nā hoa ʻelua PQ.
security.h2p1: Noi i ka mea nānā: nā ʻano SQLi, ke ala ala, ka hoʻoheheʻe ʻana, LFI, NoSQLi. Hāʻule ma mua o ke code app.
security.h2p2: Nā palena helu: honua 1000 req/s pāpale palupalu me ka pohā; no kēlā me kēia ala (e komo 10 / min, hoʻopaʻa inoa 5 / min); no ka mea hoʻohana 100 req/s ma hope o ka hōʻoia.
security.h3p1: Nā hanana pili i ka palekana (hana admin, hoʻololi hui, hoʻokuʻu hou, panic wipe) i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma o `app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Ua ʻike ʻia ka hoʻopaʻa kaulahao ⇒ hoʻopunipuni. Ke ahi makaʻala.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` hōʻike i ka log (admin auth wale nō). Pākuʻi-wale.
security.h4p1: Kālima ʻia ka faila Canary i kēlā me kēia lā me ke kī hoʻokuʻu. ʻAʻole ʻae ⇒ hoʻopaʻapaʻa ʻia.
security.h4p2: Hoʻopau ulia pōpilikia: hoʻolaha ka luna i ka `{type:"n", event:"compromise", ...}` i kēlā me kēia WebSocket. Holoi nā mea kūʻai i nā kī huna.
security.h4p3: Hoʻololi: kī hoʻokuʻu hou, hōʻailona hōʻike hou, hoʻolaha hou. Nā mea kūʻai hou-bootstrap.
security.h1_a: ʻEhā mau papa ʻenemi e alakaʻi i ka hoʻolālā: ka mea nānā passive, ka mea hoʻouka kaua, ka mea hoʻohana i hoʻopaʻa ʻia, ka mea hoʻopili. Ua pio kēlā me kēia me kahi papa ʻokoʻa.
security.h1_b: ʻO ka mea nānā paʻa: ʻike i nā ʻeke TLS-encrypted, hana ka nānā ʻana i ke kaʻa. Hoʻopio ʻia e ka pae 1-2 malū. ʻO ka mea hoʻouka kaua: hiki ke hāʻule / hoʻopaneʻe / hoʻokomo i nā ʻeke. Hoʻopio ʻia e ka pae 3-4 malū. Mea hoʻohana ʻae ʻia: ʻike i ka ciphertext + metadata. Hoʻopio ʻia e E2E crypto + hōʻemi metadata. Mea hana i hoʻopaʻa ʻia: ʻike i ke kikokikona o nā memo i hala. Hoʻopili ʻia ka pōʻino e ka hūnā i mua (Double Ratchet) a me ka holoi ʻana i ka makaʻu.
security.h1_c: Mai ka Schneier's 1999 "Applied Cryptography" hoʻoweliweli model taxonomy, i hoʻonui ʻia me ka nānā ʻana ma hope o Snowden e pili ana i nā mea nānā mokuʻāina. Kuhi ʻia kēlā me kēia hoʻolālā palekana-ʻelele hou i kekahi mea like me ia. Hoʻohui ka Vortex i ka papa ʻelima no ka palapala alanui v0.4: quantum-enabled adversary with stored past traffic, which Kyber handled.
security.h2_a: Nānā ka WAF i kēlā me kēia noi ma mua o ka hiki ʻana i ke code app, e hōʻole ana i ka SQL-i, ke ala ala, ka hoʻoheheʻe ʻana, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` holo ~50 regex nānā i URL, nīnau, a me ke kino. Nā hiʻohiʻona ʻino i ʻike ʻia (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Nā palena helu: global 1000 req/s pāpale palupalu me ka hoʻomanawanui ʻana; no kēlā me kēia ala ʻ/login` 10/min, `/register` 5/min; no ka mea hoʻohana 100 req/s ma hope o ka hōʻoia. ʻO ke koho geo-blocking ma o `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` e hoʻokō i nā koi hoʻopaʻi no nā mea hoʻohana pono.
security.h2_c: ʻO nā WAF ma ke ʻano he middleware he kumu hoʻokumu - mod_security (2002), Cloudflare's WAF, AWS WAF. ʻO ka Vortex he mea liʻiliʻi loa no ka mea he WAF koʻikoʻi ka hana ʻana i nā mea maikaʻi hoʻopunipuni e hoʻopau i nā hoʻoweliweli maoli. Ua hōʻuluʻulu ʻia ka papa inoa regex mai OWASP Top 10 pūlima a hoʻomaʻemaʻe ʻia ma v0.0.5 ma hope o ka beta WAF rule i ālai i ke kaula maoli "DROP TABLE" i loko o kahi memo kamaʻilio e pili ana iā SQL.
security.h3_a: Hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā hanana pili i ka palekana i loko o kahi log hoʻopaʻa hash-chained. ʻO ka haki ʻana i ke kaulahao e hōʻike ana i ka hana ʻino.
security.h3_b: Hoʻokomo ʻia kēlā me kēia hana hoʻokele, hoʻololi hui, hoʻokuʻu hou, a i ʻole holoi panic i `audit_log(ts, event, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor)`. Lawe ʻia kēlā me kēia lālani `prev_hash = hash(prev_row)`. Ua helu ʻia ka hash o ka lālani i kēia manawa ma luna o `ts ∥ hanana ∥ prev_hash`. Inā holoi ʻia a hoʻololi ʻia paha kekahi lālani, ʻoki ʻia nā kaulahao 'prev_hash' hope - hiki ke ʻike ʻia e ka hoʻokani hou ʻana o ke kaulahao.
security.h3_c: He mea kahiko kahiko nā lāʻau loiloi i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i ka hash (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Hoʻohana ʻo Linux auditd iā lākou. ʻO kā Git commit DAG he ʻano like ke ʻano. Vortex i hoʻohui iā lākou i ka v0.0.6 ma hope o ka hōʻike ʻana o kahi mea aʻoaʻo e hiki ke holoi malie i nā lālani log.
security.h4_a: Ua hoʻolālā mua ʻia ka pane ʻana i nā hanana: hōʻike ʻo canary i ke kī hoʻokuʻu ʻaʻole i hoʻopaʻa ʻia; ʻO ka hoʻopau pilikia e holoi i nā kī i hūnā ʻia ma waena o nā mea kūʻai aku a pau.
security.h4_b: ʻO kēlā me kēia lā 'canary.txt' i pūlima ʻia e ke kī hoʻokuʻu, i paʻi ʻia me ka mea hoʻoponopono. Hōʻoia nā mea kūʻai aku ma ka hoʻomaka ʻana - ʻaʻohe ⇒ hoʻohālikelike ʻia. Inā hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka ʻae ʻana: hoʻolaha ka luna i ka `{type:"n", event:"compromise", reason}` ma kēlā me kēia WebSocket. Holoi nā mea kūʻai aku i nā kī i hūnā ʻia, hoʻoikaika i ke komo hou ʻana. Hoʻopuka hou ʻia ke kī hoʻokuʻu hou, hōʻike hou ʻia, hoʻihoʻi hou nā mea kūʻai mai ka ʻaoʻao hope o ka pono. ʻAʻole hiki ke heluhelu ʻia ka ciphertext kahiko e ka hoʻolālā.
security.h4_c: Hoʻopili nā faila Canary i ka canary warrant 2013 a Apple a me ka papahana `canarywatch.org`. Hoʻohana ka hōʻailona iā lākou. Vortex's 'akomi: hō'ailona cron 'canary.txt' me ke kī ho'oku'u i kēlā me kēia 24 hola. ʻO nā hoʻolaha hoʻopau ulia pōpilikia ʻo ia ke ʻano like Let's Encrypt e hoʻohana ai no ka hōʻoia ʻana i ka nui o ka hoʻopau ʻana.

privacy.title: Pilikino a me ka hoʻokō
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, pono-e- holoi, hoemi metadata, hiki ke lawe i ka ikepili.
privacy.intro: Vortex moku GDPR a me CCPA mea hana ma waho o ka pahu. Loaʻa i nā mea hoʻohana ma nā ʻāina i hoʻoponopono ʻia i hoʻokahi hope admin no kēlā me kēia noi kānāwai.
privacy.h1p1: ʻAʻohe IP log ma ka paʻamau. Hoʻohuli i nā ʻāpana koho `X-Real-IP` ke ʻole ka mea hoʻohana e koho.
privacy.h1p2: ʻO `sender_pseudo` ma nā lālani memo i hoʻopaʻa inoa i nā ID hoʻouna maoli - hōʻike ʻia kahi DB dump i nā inoa pseudony no kēlā me kēia lumi.
privacy.h1p3: Hoʻohana ʻia ka huli ʻana i nā hōʻailona hoʻopunipuni. Hoʻopili ka mea kūʻai aku i nā huaʻōlelo me ke kī lumi; hale kūʻai node i nā hōʻailona opaque; ʻO ka huli ʻana he hoʻohālikelike pololei i nā hōʻailona ciphertext.
privacy.h1p4: Ua ʻoki ʻia ka ʻike hope i ka granularity i koho ʻia e ka mea hoʻohana.
privacy.h2p1: ʻO `POST /api/privacy/erase` ka inoa ʻole i ka lālani mea hoʻohana, holoi i kā lākou mau memo i hoʻouna ʻia (mau metadata no ka quorum), holoi i nā faila mai ka disk.
privacy.h2p2: Hui Pūʻulu: hōʻike ʻia ka ʻōlelo hōʻino i nā hoa; holoi lākou ma ko lākou ʻaoʻao i loko o 72 mau hola.
privacy.h2p3: Hoʻoponopono: hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka holoi ʻana me ka timestamp a (hashed) mea hoʻohana i hiki i ka mea hoʻohana ke hōʻoia i ka hoʻokō.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` hoʻoheheʻe i kahi zip: profile JSON, hoʻouna/loaʻa ciphertext, nā kuhikuhi waihona me nā kī kumu no kēlā me kēia faila, papa inoa hoʻopili.
privacy.h3p2: Ka manawa hana: ~5 min no 10 k memo, i kaupalena ʻia e IO.
privacy.h3p3: Pono ka mea loaʻa e hoʻokaʻawale i ka ciphertext ma ka ʻāina; Hoʻouna pū ʻia nā mea paahana hoʻokuʻu aku.
privacy.h4p1: Paʻi lōʻihi i ka logo 5 s → holoi koke i ka ʻāina: nā kī, nā leka huna, nā mea hoʻopili.
privacy.h4p2: Hoʻopili ʻia ka holoi ʻana: `/api/privacy/panic` ʻo ia hoʻi nā pōhaku kupapaʻu i ka mooolelo ʻaoʻao kikowaena.
privacy.h1_a: ʻAʻohe IP log ma ka paʻamau. ʻAʻohe metadata ʻike mea hoʻohana ma nā lālani memo. Huli kikokikona piha ma luna o nā hōʻailona i hoʻopili ʻia.
privacy.h1_b: Hoʻohuli i nā ʻāpana koho `X-Real-IP` ma mua o ka ʻike ʻana o ka node ke ʻole ke koho ʻana o ka mea hoʻohana no ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana. Mālama nā lālani memo `sender_id` (no ACL) a me `sender_pseudo` (no fan-out); ʻO sender_pseudo ʻo HMAC(room_salt, sender_id) no laila ʻaʻole hōʻike ka DB dump i ka mea nāna i ʻōlelo i ka mea ma waena o nā lumi. Huli: hoʻopili ka mea kūʻai aku i nā huaʻōlelo me ke kī lumi; hale kūʻai node i nā hōʻailona opaque; Hoʻohālikelike pololei ka huli ʻana ma nā hōʻailona ciphertext, ʻaʻohe papa kuhikuhi plaintext.
privacy.h1_c: ʻO ka hoʻohaʻahaʻa metadata ka ʻae ʻana ma hope o Snowden - Ua hoʻolaha ʻia ʻo Signal ma 2014, ua ukali ʻo WhatsApp me ka mea hoʻouna-pseudo i 2019. ʻO ka huli ʻana i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma luna o nā hōʻailona ciphertext ʻo ia ka CryptDB (2011) a me ShadowCrypt (2014). ʻO ka hoʻokō ʻana o Vortex he mana wehe ʻia e kūʻai ana i ka maʻalahi o ka nīnau no ka maʻalahi.
privacy.h2_a: ʻO `POST /api/privacy/erase` inoa ʻole i ka lālani mea hoʻohana, holoi i kā lākou ciphertext i hoʻouna ʻia, holoi i nā faila, a hoʻolaha i nā hoa hui.
privacy.h2_b: ʻO ka ʻaoʻao kikowaena: ʻAʻohe ʻaoʻao koʻikoʻi o ka lālani `mea hoʻohana (`username = "deleted-<id>"`, `phone = null`, `email = null`, `display_name = "[deleted]"`); `messages.ciphertext` hoʻonohonoho NULL no nā lālani a pau kahi `sender_id = u.id`; nā faila i hoʻopili ʻia mai kēlā mau memo i holoi ʻia mai ka disk. Loaʻa i nā hoa hui pū kekahi ʻōlelo ʻōlelo `{event: "erasure", user_id, signed_by}`; holo like lākou ma ko lākou ʻaoʻao i loko o 72 h (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: He GDPR Pono ka holoi ʻana i ka Paukū 17 mai ka makahiki 2018. CCPA i ukali ʻia ma 2020; LGPD (Brazil) i ka makahiki 2021. Vortex moku i ka mea kahiko ma waho o ka pahu no laila, ʻaʻole pono nā mea hoʻohana i nā ʻāina i hoʻoponopono ʻia. ʻO ka hui 72 h SLA pili i ka GDPR's 30 mau lā pane pane me ke poʻo no ka hoʻolaha.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` hoʻoheheʻe i kahi zip: profile JSON, hoʻouna/loaʻa ciphertext, nā kuhikuhi waihona me nā kī kumu no kēlā me kēia faila, papa inoa hoʻopili.
privacy.h3_b: He async ka hanauna no ka mea he mau minuke nā moʻolelo nui. Noi nā POST o nā mea kūʻai aku → hoʻopili ka node i ka hana → holo ka hana ma hope → nā koho koho `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 me ka pūlima URL ke mākaukau. Zip maʻiʻo: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (hoʻokahi no ka lumi), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + per-file root keys), `files/` (downloaded-as-is blobs).
privacy.h3_c: ʻO ka lawe ʻana i ka ʻikepili ke koi māhoe me ka holoi ʻana ma GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Loaʻa i nā hōʻailona nā mea paahana a pau. Hoʻohui ʻo Vortex i ka mea kī (file_root no kēlā me kēia faila) no laila hiki i nā mea hoʻohana ke hoʻokaʻawale i ka hoʻokuʻu aku ma ka ʻāina - inā ʻaʻole pono ka lawe ʻana aku. Me ka ʻole o kēia kikoʻī, ʻo ka Apple / Google ka lawe ʻana i ka palapala maʻalahi-wale nō no ka mea ua wehe mua lākou.
privacy.h4_a: Panic holoi: paʻi lōʻihi i ka logo Vortex no 5 kekona e hoʻopau koke i nā kī āpau a me ka ʻikepili huna ma ka polokalamu. Hiki ole ke hoohuliia.
privacy.h4_b: ʻO ka ʻaoʻao Client: ma ka 5-kekona lōʻihi paʻi, hōʻike hōʻoia; ma ka hōʻoia ʻana, e kāhea iā `wipeKeychainItems()` /`clearKeystore()` /`localStorage.clear() + indexedDB.databases().forEach(deleteDatabase)`. Ua hala ka ciphertext, ua hala nā kī, ua pau nā JWT. ʻO ka holoi ʻana i hui pū ʻia: `POST /api/privacy/panic` ʻo ia hoʻi ka lua kupapaʻu i ka ʻaoʻao kikowaena moʻokāki a hoʻohui i kahi ʻōlelo ʻino.
privacy.h4_c: He moʻolelo lōʻihi nā pihi panic / make-man switch: Wickr's 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat's 2013 "Forget", Signal's "Secure Deletion" proposal (2016, ʻaʻole i hoʻouna ʻia). ʻO ka 5-kekona lōʻihi paʻi paʻakikī o Vortex i ka hoʻomaka ʻole ʻia - ua aʻo mākou i nā manaʻo haptic ma iPhone 15 a me Pixel 8 a koho mākou i 5 s ma ke ʻano he wahi maikaʻi ma waena o ka "wikiwiki i kahi pilikia" a "ʻaʻole hiki ke puhi ʻia ma ka pihi ʻeke".
privacy.h1_f:
sender_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256(room_salt, sender_id)[:16]
  ⇒ DB hoʻolei: {lumi, sender_pseudo, ciphertext}
  ⇒ ʻaʻole hiki i ka mea hoʻouka ke hoʻopili i ka sender_pseudo ma waena o nā lumi (nā paʻakai like ʻole)

huli i ka hōʻailona = HMAC-SHA256(room_key, huaʻōlelo)
  ⇒ nīnau "hello" ⇒ hōʻailona helu ⇒ huli kuhikuhi kikoʻī
  ⇒ ʻaʻole ʻike ka node i ka huaʻōlelo maʻalahi
privacy.h2_f:
POST /api/privacy/erase (lawelawe ponoʻī)
  UPDATE mea hoʻohana SET inoa inoa='deleted-'||id, phone=NULL, leka uila=NULL, ... WHERE id=$u
  UPDATE memo SET ciphertext=NULL WHERE sender_id=$u
  DELETE FROM faila WHERE uploaded_by=$u
  ʻōhumu {event:"erasure", user_id, sig:Ed25519(release_priv, event)}

export.zip
├── profile.json (nā kahua hoʻohana)
├── rooms.jsonl (hoʻokahi lumi no ka laina)
├── messages.jsonl.enc (ciphertext + per-msg file_root)
├── decrypt.py (kōkua kōkua)

kaomi lōʻihi ≥ 5 s ma ka logo VORTEX:
  hoʻopaʻa kamaʻilio
