debugging.title: Debugging a me ka diagnostics
debugging.subtitle: Nā mea hana no ka nānā ʻana i nā pilikia ma dev, staging, a me prod.
debugging.intro: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia subsystem ka hoʻopaʻa inoa ʻana a me kahi / metric surface. Eia ka puke pāʻani maʻamau maʻamau.
debugging.h1p1: JSON-kūkulu ʻia e ka paʻamau. `logger.info("action", extra={"user_id": ...})` produces `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"action", "user_id": ...}`.
debugging.h1p2: Kahuli ma 100 MB; mālama i 14 gens gzipped.
debugging.h1p3: Papa no kēlā me kēia module ma o `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG` (e laʻa. `LOG_LEVEL_TRANSPORT=DEBUG`).
debugging.h1p4: Id pili: loaʻa i kēlā me kēia noi kahi 'X-Request-Id'; Hoʻohana hou nā RPC i lalo.
debugging.h2p2: RED: helu / hewa / lōʻihi no kēlā me kēia ala.
debugging.h2p3: USE: hoʻohana / saturation / hewa i kēlā me kēia DB pool, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Kuʻia: lumi hana, nā memo/s, histogram pae ʻaihue.
debugging.h3p1: 'py-spy' no ka la'ana manawa holo. E hoʻopili i ka node holo PID.
debugging.h3p2: 'memray' no ka hoʻopili ʻana i ka puʻu. Hōʻike ka paʻi kiʻi 1-minuke i ka lele wikiwiki.
debugging.h3p3: Rust hoʻonui ʻo `vortex_chat` hoʻokuʻu aku i ka hae `--profile` e kākau ana i kahi meheu pili i ka flamegraph.
debugging.h4p1: ʻO `scripts/smoke/all.sh` holo i ka papa inoa/login/send/receive/logout e kū'ē i kahi node kūloko. Puka ʻole ʻole ma ka hāʻule ʻole.
debugging.h4p2: CI holo i ka uahi ma kēlā me kēia PR a me ka hui pū ʻana i ka nui.
debugging.h4p3: ʻO ka uahi hana: ka ʻimi ʻana o waho e pā ana i kahi moʻokāki canary i hoʻokahi minuke.
debugging.h1_a: JSON-kūkulu ʻia nā lāʻau e ka paʻamau. Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia laina log ts, pae, module, memo, a me kahi id pili.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("user_created", extra={"user_id": u.id})` produces `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"user_idcreated", "msg":"user_idcreated" "..."}`. Loaʻa ka id hoʻoponopono mai ke poʻomanaʻo ʻo `X-Request-Id`; ʻo kēlā me kēia kahawai RPC hoʻohana hou iā ia. Ka hoʻololi ʻana ma 100 MB; mālama i nā hanauna 14 gzipped. Papa no kēlā me kēia module ma o `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: ʻO ka logging JSON i kūkulu ʻia ʻo ia ka ʻae ʻana i kēia manawa - apono ʻia e Stripe, Datadog, kēlā me kēia mea kūʻai nānā ʻike hou. Hoʻopili ʻia nā ID Correlation i X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) a lilo i canonical i nā microservices ma o Jaeger / Zipkin (2015). Vortex hoʻohana i ka id hoʻopili maʻalahi i hoʻolaha ʻia ma ke poʻo ma mua o nā meheu i puʻunaue ʻia no ka mea ʻoi aku ka paʻakikī o ka mea hana i hāʻawi ʻia ʻaʻole pono mākou.
debugging.h2_a: Nā anana Prometheus ma `/metrics` (hōʻoia-admin i ka hana ʻana). Hoʻouna ʻia nā dashboards Grafana ma `deploy/grafana/`.
debugging.h2_b: RED metric no kēlā me kēia ala: ka helu noi, ka helu kuhi, ka histogram lōʻihi. USE ana i kēlā me kēia kumu waiwai: DB ka hoʻohana ʻana i ka loko wai, WebSocket ka hoʻoheheʻe ʻana i waho, TURN ka bandwidth relay. Maʻamau: nā lumi hana, nā memo i kēlā me kēia kekona, histogram pae ʻaihue. Hōʻike ʻia ka papa kuhikuhi luna ma `/admin/metrics` i nā pakuhi kiʻekiʻe; ʻO Prometheus e ʻimi ana no ka mōʻaukala piha.
debugging.h2_c: ʻO RED (ka helu / nā hewa / ka lōʻihi) ʻo ka Weaveworks '2016 acronym. USE (hoʻohana / saturation / hewa) ʻo ia ke ʻano hana a Brendan Gregg i ka makahiki 2013. Hoʻopili pū lākou i nā hōʻailona pae lawelawe a me ka pae waiwai. ʻO Prometheus + Grafana ka mea paʻamau i wehe ʻia mai ka makahiki 2016.
debugging.h3_a: 'py-spy' no ka la'ana manawa holo; 'memray' no nā kiʻi paʻi; ʻO `vortex_chat` Rust hoʻonui i loaʻa ʻo `--profile` no nā meheu lapalapa.
debugging.h3_b: ʻO `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` no 60 mau kekona e hoʻopuka ana i ka lapalapa SVG e hōʻike ana i nā pūʻulu wela Python. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` tracks alllocations; `memray flamegraph mem.bin` renders. Rust hoʻonui i nā moʻolelo kūloko e like me Chrome-tracing JSON ke kāhea ʻia me `--profile`. Hoʻohui i kekahi o kēia me ka hoʻāʻo hoʻouka e holo ana ma o 'scripts/smoke/all.sh' no nā ʻano like ʻole.
debugging.h3_c: ʻO py-spy (2018) he mea hoʻopuka helu helu non-intrusive e pili ana i kahi kaʻina holo Python me ka ʻole o nā hoʻololi code - ka Go o Python profilers. ʻO memray (Bloomberg, 2022) ʻo ia ka Python heap profiler maikaʻi loa i kēia lā. ʻO ko Rust kaiaola kaiaola ponoʻī he makua akā ʻaʻole i hoʻohui ʻia; ʻO kā mākou hoʻonui e hoʻokuʻu aku iā Chrome-tracing kikoʻī no ka mea he mea nānā i kūkulu ʻia i kēlā me kēia polokalamu.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` exercises register/login/send/receive/logout e pili ana i kahi node kūloko. CI holo ia ma kēlā me kēia PR.
debugging.h4_b: Holo ka uahi i ~5 kekona. Hana i ʻelua mau moʻolelo hou, wehe i kahi DM, hoʻouna i kahi leka, hōʻoia i ka lawe ʻana, hoʻopaʻa i nā mea ʻelua. Puka ʻole ʻole ma ka hāʻule ʻole. Kāhea ʻo CI iā ia ma hope o ke kūkulu ʻana. Holo ka canary prod-smoke kaʻawale i kēlā me kēia minuke mai kahi hoʻokolohua waho e kūʻē i kahi moʻokāki hoʻāʻo hoʻolaʻa ma ka node hana.
debugging.h4_c: ʻO ka hoʻāʻo ʻana i ka uahi he mea hoʻohālikelike ʻo Toyota (1950s) - e holo wikiwiki e hōʻoia i ka haki ʻole o ka ʻōnaehana. Ma ka lako polokalamu ua lilo lākou i mea maʻamau ma hope o Michael Feathers '"Working Effectively with Legacy Code" (2004). ʻO ka Vortex ka ʻatikala he ~200 laina o bash + curl.

testing.title: Hoʻolālā hoʻāʻo
testing.subtitle: 29 k laina o nā hoʻokolohua ma waena o Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia papa kona papa hoʻāʻo ponoʻī. CI holo ia mau mea a pau ma lalo o 10 minuke.
testing.h1p1: ʻO ka 'pytest app/tests' e uhi ana i nā mea hoʻokele, palekana, halihali, nā bots.
testing.h1p2: Nā ho'āʻo pili waiwai kuhia ma ka crypto: ` assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` no 1000 random m.
testing.h1p3: AFL-ʻano fuzz ma WAF: miliona o nā mea hoʻokomo hewa - ʻaʻole i ʻōlelo ʻia he 5xx leaks.
testing.h2p1: ʻO `swift test` ma `ios/Modules/` holo i nā ho'āʻo ʻāpana me RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446 hoʻāʻo vectors.
testing.h2p2: XCUI hoʻāʻo e hoʻokele i nā hiʻohiʻona SwiftUI i kahi simulator poʻo ʻole; kiʻi-hoʻohālikelike.
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` e holo ana i na hoao ana ma ka emulator holo.
testing.h4p1: Hoʻokele ka mea pāʻani i ka mea kūʻai aku pūnaewele, ʻo Chrome poʻo ʻole + Firefox poʻo ʻole. Hoʻohana ʻia nā kelepona me `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream`.
testing.h4p2: Nā hiʻohiʻona: hoʻopaʻa inoa i ʻelua moʻolelo → DM → hoʻouna i ka faila → holoi → hōʻoia i ka sync → pau.
testing.h1_a: Python hoʻohana i ka pytest + uhi. ʻO kēlā me kēia alalai, kēlā me kēia palekana palekana, kēlā me kēia module transport i nā hoʻokolohua. ~80 % uhi.
testing.h1_b: Hoʻohana ʻo `pytest app/tests` i ka suite piha ma lalo o 2 mau minuke ma ke kumu hoʻokahi. Nā ho'āʻo pili waiwai kuhiakau ma nā crypto primitives: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` no 1000 mau leka uila. AFL-ʻano fuzz hoʻāʻo ma ka WAF: miliona o nā mea hoʻokomo hewa i ʻōlelo ʻia e hana i kahi pane 4xx (ʻaʻole 5xx). `pytest --cov=app` no ka uhi.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) ʻo ia ka de-facto Python hoʻāʻo hoʻokūkū. ʻO ke kuhiakau (2015) no ka hoʻāʻo ʻana i ka waiwai i lawe ʻia i ka manaʻo QuickCheck mai Haskell. ʻO AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) no ka fuzz ʻo ka fuzzer alakaʻi uhi canonical. ʻO ka waihona o Vortex ka mea nui; ʻO ka mea ʻono wale nō kā mākou makemake no ka pytest parametrisation ma luna o ka hoʻoilina papa hoʻāʻo.
testing.h2_a: ʻO nā hoʻāʻo wikiwiki ma `ios/Modules/` uhi i nā crypto primitives e kū'ē i RFC hōʻike vectors me nā hoʻāʻo snapshot SwiftUI.
testing.h2_b: ʻO `swift test` mai `ios/Modules/` holo i nā ho'āʻo ʻāpana ma lalo o 1 mau kekona. RFC 7748 (X25519) vectors. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) vectors. RFC 5869 (HKDF) vectors. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) mea paʻa. Hoʻohālikelike ʻia nā kiʻi kiʻi ʻo SwiftUI ma ke kiʻi ʻokoʻa i ka baseline git-tracked; ka hoʻihoʻi hou ʻana i kēlā me kēia pika i hāʻule i ke kūkulu.
testing.h2_c: ʻO ka hoʻāʻo ʻana i ka crypto e kūʻē i nā vector hoʻāʻo kūhelu ka hana pale pōkā loa - inā ʻae kāu code me nā vectors RFC, ua kūlike ia ma ka wehewehe. ʻO ka hoʻāʻo kiʻi kiʻi no SwiftUI he ~ 2022 state of the art, kaulana ʻia e pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing. Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i kahi mana liʻiliʻi i loko o ka hale e pale i ka hilinaʻi.
testing.h3_a: Nā ho'āʻo Kotlin: JVM-wale nō ma o `./gradlew test`; hoʻohana ʻia ma o `./gradlew connectedCheck` ma kahi emulator holo.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` holo i loko o kekahi mau kekona — ʻaʻole pono ka Android framework, ʻo JUnit + Hilt-android-testing wale nō. Nā pahuhopu hoʻāʻo ʻāpana: crypto, nā mea hōʻike, nā kahe e pili ana i ka coroutine. `./gradlew connectedCheck` wili i kahi emulator, ho'okomo i ka polokalamu, holo UI ho'āʻo ma o Espresso. E2E kahe: komo → hoʻouna memo → ʻike ma ke kamaʻilio.
testing.h3_c: ʻO ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i nā hoʻāʻo JVM-wale nō mai nā hoʻāʻo i hoʻohana ʻia ʻo ia ka Android 2019+ convention. JVM wikiwiki nā hoʻokolohua (kekona); lohi (mau minuke). Ua hoʻohana ʻia ʻo Robolectric (2014) e hoʻopili i ke āpau akā ua hoʻololi nui ʻia e kēia māhele i ka hoʻomohala Android hou.
testing.h4_a: Hoʻokuʻu ʻo Playwright i ka mea kūʻai aku ma ke poʻo ʻole ʻo Chrome a me Firefox, e hoʻohana ana i ka papa inoa maoli → DM → nā kahe kelepona.
testing.h4_b: ʻO `playwright-tests/` paʻa i nā hiʻohiʻona ma TypeScript. Hoʻopili ʻia kahi node kiola + Postgres i kēlā me kēia kau hoʻāʻo ma o docker compose. E hoʻāʻo i ka pūnaewele UI: hoʻopaʻa inoa i ʻelua moʻolelo, wehe DM, hoʻouna i ka memo, hōʻoia i ka hoʻouna ʻana, hana i ke kelepona wikiō me `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` nā hae no laila e hoʻopuka ʻo Chrome i nā leo/wikiō synthetic. Holo like nā hiʻohiʻona ma o nā limahana Playwright.
testing.h4_c: Ua hoʻololi ʻo Playwright (Microsoft, 2020) iā Selenium no ka hapa nui o ka hoʻāʻo pūnaewele E2E no ka mea ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki, ʻoi aku ka hilinaʻi, a ʻoi aku ka maikaʻi o ka debugging. WebRTC ʻo ka hoʻāʻo ʻana i nā mākaʻikaʻi poʻo ʻole he wahi ʻeha a hiki i ka hoʻohui ʻana o Chrome 69 i nā hae mea hoʻopunipuni; mai ia manawa ua lilo ia i hana maʻamau.

apiSurface.title: API ʻili
apiSurface.subtitle: ʻO kēlā me kēia HTTP helu hope e hōʻike ana ka node, i hui pū ʻia e ka ʻāpana.
apiSurface.intro: ʻO kēia ka papa inoa mana o nā ala ākea. Hoʻonui ʻia kēlā me kēia kāleka hope e hōʻike i ke kumu, ka pae mana, noi / pane schemas, papa kuhi, a me kahi laʻana curl. Ua kāpae ʻia nā ala mālama hale ma lalo o `/loko/*` e ke kulekele.

auth.title: Hōʻoiaʻiʻo
auth.subtitle: E hoʻopaʻa inoa, hoʻopaʻa inoa, hōʻano hou, hoʻopau - a me nā ala hoʻihoʻi.
auth.intro: ʻO nā ala āpau ma lalo o `/api/authentication/*`. ʻO ka JWT i puka mai i waho o ka hoʻopaʻa inoa kūleʻa e lawe ana iā `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, type: access|refresh}` i pūlima HS256 ma luna o ka huna o ka node. Loaʻa ka loaʻa ʻana he 15 min, hōʻano hou i nā lā 30.

register.title: POST /api/authentication/register
register.subtitle: E hana i mea hoʻohana hou me X25519 ʻike + Argon2id password.
register.intro: E hana i ka mooolelo — auth: **none**.
register.h1_a: Hoʻokumu i kahi moʻokāki mea hoʻohana hou a hoʻopuka i kahi pālua JWT mua. Hoʻopaʻa i ke kī lehulehu X25519 lōʻihi o ka mea hoʻohana i ka moʻokāki mai ke kelepona mua loa.
register.h1_b: Hoʻopaʻa ʻo Node i nā kahua āpau ma o Pydantic, nānā i ka inoa inoa a me ka x25519_public_key kū hoʻokahi, holo Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ma ka ʻōlelo huna, hoʻokomo i loko o nā 'mea hoʻohana', ʻohana_devices`, ʻpush_subscriptions`, komo mints + hōʻoluʻolu JWTs.
register.h1_c: Hoʻouna ʻia ma v0.0.1 ma ke ʻano he hopena mua. Ua hoʻohui ʻia ka X25519 pubkey parameter ma v0.0.2 ma hope o ka ʻike ʻana he pono ke hana ʻia ka ʻike a me ka moʻokāki - inā ʻaʻole hiki i ke kikowaena ke MITM i mea hoʻohana ma waena o ke kākau inoa a me ka hoʻouka kī mua.
register.h2_a: Pono: **ʻaʻohe**. ʻO ka middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` i ʻīpuka i kēia ala a hōʻole me `401 unauthenticated` inā nalo a ʻaʻole pono ka hōʻoia i koi ʻia.
register.h2_b:
- 'ʻaʻohe' - ʻaʻole i hōʻoia ʻia (pre-login).
- `jwt` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona komo ma ke poʻomanaʻo `Authorization`.
- `refresh` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona hōʻano hou.
- `admin` — JWT nona nā koi i loaʻa iā `is_admin: ʻoiaʻiʻo`.
- `peer-signed` - noi i ke kino i pūlima ʻia e ke kī Ed25519 a kekahi hoa hilinaʻi.
register.h2_c: Hōʻike ka ʻauth tier i ke kumu o ka pono liʻiliʻi: ua kaupalena ʻia nā helu hope ma mua o ke komo ʻana i ka hana ʻana a me ka hoʻihoʻi ʻana; ʻO nā mea a pau ma hope o kahi JWT ʻike i kahi mea hoʻohana maoli; Hōʻike nā ʻaoʻao hope i kahi hōʻailona ma ka UI no laila ʻike ʻia ka hoʻohana hewa ʻana.
register.h3_a: JSON kino me ka mea hoʻohana pono + ʻōlelo huna + x25519_public_key; kelepona koho (E.164), leka uila (RFC 5322 lite), display_name, avatar_emoji, invite_code, kyber_public_key.
register.h3_f:
{
  "mea hoʻohana": "alice", // [a-z0-9_]{3,30}
  "password": "…", // ≥ 8 mau pū
  "x25519_public_key": "<64-hex>", // 32 byte hex
  "display_name": "Alice", // koho
  "kelepona": "+15551234567", // koho, E.164
  "email": "a@example.com", // koho
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // koho, 1 emoji
  "invite_code": "..."", // ke koho inā INVITE mode
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // koho, no PQ
}
register.h4_a: 201 Hana ʻia me ka pālua JWT a me ka ʻaoʻao canonical o ka mea hoʻohana hou.
register.h4_f:
{
  "ok": ʻoiaʻiʻo,
  "access_token": "eyJ…", // 15 min TTL
  "refresh_token": "eyJ…", // 30 lā TTL
  "user_id": 42,
  "mea hoʻohana": "alice",
  "display_name": "Alice",
  "avatar_url": null,
  "x25519_public_key": "<64 hex>",
  "kyber_public_key": "<hex>"
}
register.h5_a: ʻO ka hōʻoia maʻamau + ʻelua hōʻole kikoʻī kikoʻī. `409 username_taken` ke loaʻa ka inoa; `409 pubkey_reused` i ka wā i hoʻopaʻa inoa ʻia ai ka X25519 kī lehulehu i kahi moʻokāki ʻē aʻe.
register.h5_f:
409 mea hoʻohana_hoʻohana ʻia ka hui ʻana
409 pubkey_reused X25519 pubkey ua hoʻohana ʻia
422 validation_error kaohi kahua i uhai ia
429 rate_limited >5 kakau/min/IP
Aia ka 403 registration_closed node ma ke ʻano INVITE a nalo ke code
register.h6_a: ʻO ka liʻiliʻi liʻiliʻi me ke kelepona ʻole / leka uila:

login.title: POST /api/authentication/login
login.subtitle: E hōʻoia i ka inoa inoa + ʻōlelo huna, e hoʻihoʻi JWT pai.
login.h1_a: Hoʻololi i nā hōʻoia no kahi JWT pai. Ua hōʻoia ʻia ka ʻōlelo huna e kūʻē i ka hash Argon2id ma `users.password_hash`. ʻO ka manawa ka manawa mau no nā inoa inoa ʻike ʻole e pale i ka helu ʻana.
login.h1_b: Nānā i ka mea hoʻohana ma ka inoa inoa haʻahaʻa, holo 'argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(mālama ʻia, waiho ʻia)`. Inā ʻaʻole i loaʻa ka mea hoʻohana, e hōʻoia i ka hash dummy i helu mua ʻia e hoʻohālikelike i ka manawa. Pōmaikaʻi → hoʻopuka JWT + lālani `mea hoʻohana_devices`.
login.h1_c: Hoʻouna ʻia me ka hoʻopaʻa inoa ma v0.0.1. Hoʻohui ʻia ka hashing dummy manawa mau ma v0.0.2 ma hope o ka hōʻike ʻana o nā mea noiʻi i ka helu manawa ma ka hoʻolālā mua.
login.h2_a: Pono: **ʻaʻohe**. ʻO ka middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` i ʻīpuka i kēia ala a hōʻole me `401 unauthenticated` inā nalo a ʻaʻole pono ka hōʻoia i koi ʻia.
login.h2_b:
- 'ʻaʻohe' - ʻaʻole i hōʻoia ʻia (pre-login).
- `jwt` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona komo ma ke poʻomanaʻo `Authorization`.
- `refresh` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona hōʻano hou.
- `admin` — JWT nona nā koi i loaʻa iā `is_admin: ʻoiaʻiʻo`.
- `peer-signed` - noi i ke kino i pūlima ʻia e ke kī Ed25519 a kekahi hoa hilinaʻi.
login.h2_c: Hōʻike ka ʻauth tier i ke kumu o ka pono liʻiliʻi: ua kaupalena ʻia nā helu hope ma mua o ke komo ʻana i ka hana ʻana a me ka hoʻihoʻi ʻana; ʻO nā mea a pau ma hope o kahi JWT ʻike i kahi mea hoʻohana maoli; Hōʻike nā ʻaoʻao hope i kahi hōʻailona ma ka UI no laila ʻike ʻia ka hoʻohana hewa ʻana.
login.h5_a: Vortex hoʻopaʻa kuhi hewa `{hewa, kūlana, ala}`. `401` ma nā palapala hōʻoia hewa; '403' no ka pono ʻole; `422` ma ka hōʻoia; '429' ma ka palena uku; '5xx' ma ka hewa kūloko.
login.h5_f:
401 invalid_credentials hewa inoa inoa a ʻōlelo huna
401 account_suspended account ua hoʻopaneʻe ʻia
401 totp_koi hoʻolako totp a ho'āʻo hou
429 rate_limited >10 hoao/min/IP

refresh.title: POST /api/authentication/refresh
refresh.subtitle: E kūʻai i kahi hōʻoluʻolu JWT no ke komo hou JWT.
refresh.intro: Hoʻohou hou i ka hōʻailona komo — hōʻoia: **refresh**.
refresh.h1_a: Mint i kahi hōʻailona komo 15-minuke hou me ka nīnau ʻole i ka mea hoʻohana no ka ʻōlelo huna. Hoʻohana ʻia inā kokoke pau ka hōʻailona komo i kēia manawa a i ʻole i hoʻihoʻi mai i kahi 401.
refresh.h1_b: Hoʻokaʻawale a hōʻoia i ka hōʻailona hōʻoluʻolu (hōʻailona, ​​exp, ʻaʻole i hoʻopau ʻia), e hana i kahi komo hou JWT me ka `jti` like. Inā 'ROTATE_REFRESH=ʻoiaʻiʻo', hoʻopuka pū i kahi hōʻano hou.
refresh.h1_c: E hahai ana iā RFC 6749 OAuth 2.0. Hoʻopau ʻia ka hoʻololi hou ʻana ma ke ʻano paʻamau no ka pale ʻana i nā lāhui ke hōʻano hou nā mea kūʻai he nui i ka manawa like.

- 'ʻaʻohe' - ʻaʻole i hōʻoia ʻia (pre-login).
- `jwt` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona komo ma ke poʻomanaʻo `Authorization`.
- `refresh` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona hōʻano hou.
- `admin` — JWT nona nā koi i loaʻa iā `is_admin: ʻoiaʻiʻo`.
- `peer-signed` - noi i ke kino i pūlima ʻia e ke kī Ed25519 a kekahi hoa hilinaʻi.
refresh.h2_c: Hōʻike ka ʻauth tier i ke kumu o ka pono liʻiliʻi: ua kaupalena ʻia nā helu hope ma mua o ke komo ʻana i ka hana ʻana a me ka hoʻihoʻi ʻana; ʻO nā mea a pau ma hope o kahi JWT ʻike i kahi mea hoʻohana maoli; Hōʻike nā ʻaoʻao hope i kahi hōʻailona ma ka UI no laila ʻike ʻia ka hoʻohana hewa ʻana.
refresh.h5_a: Vortex hoʻopaʻa hewa `{hewa, kūlana, ala}`. `401` ma nā palapala hōʻoia hewa; '403' no ka pono ʻole; `422` ma ka hōʻoia; '429' ma ka palena uku; '5xx' ma ka hewa kūloko.
refresh.h5_f:
401 token_expired refresh has expired
Ua hoʻopau ʻia ka polokalamu 401 token_revoked
401 token_malformed JWT parse hemahema

logout.title: POST /api/authentication/logout
logout.subtitle: Hoʻopau i ke kau o kēia manawa
logout.h1_a: Hōʻailona i ka mea hana o kēia manawa me he mea lā ua kāpae ʻia. Hoʻihoʻi hou ʻia me ka hoʻihoʻi ʻana o ka device_id i kēia manawa 401.

logout.h1_c: Hoʻouna ʻia i kahi hoʻokuʻu mua Vortex ma ke ʻano he ʻāpana o ka hiki ke `logout`.
logout.h2_a: Pono: **jwt**. ʻO ka middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` i ʻīpuka i kēia ala a hōʻole me `401 unauthenticated` inā nalo a ʻaʻole pono ka hōʻoia i koi ʻia.

- `refresh` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona hōʻano hou.
- `admin` — JWT nona nā koi i loaʻa iā `is_admin: ʻoiaʻiʻo`.
- `peer-signed` - noi i ke kino i pūlima ʻia e ke kī Ed25519 a kekahi hoa hilinaʻi.

logout.h5_f:
401 ʻaʻole i hōʻoia ʻia e nalowale ana/ʻaʻole kūpono

422 validation_error kaohi kahua i uhai ia

devices.title: GET /api/authentication/devices
devices.subtitle: E papa inoa i nā mea hana

create.h1_a: ʻAe ʻo `{type, name, is_private, is_channel, members}`. Lilo ka mea nāna i hana; hoʻohui ʻia nā lālā i hoʻokahi kālepa; ʻO ka envelope root_key mua i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i ka ʻaoʻao o ka mea kūʻai aku a laila POST ma ke kelepona ʻelua.
create.h1_b: Noho ka mea hoʻohana no kēia ala i ka module pili ma lalo o `app/`. Hōʻike ʻia ke kumu ala `/api/rooms` me `@router.post('/api/rooms')`.
create.h1_c: Hoʻouna ʻia i kahi hoʻokuʻu Vortex mua ma ke ʻano he ʻāpana o ka hiki 'lumi'.
create.h2_a: Pono: **jwt**. ʻO ka middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` i ʻīpuka i kēia ala a hōʻole me `401 unauthenticated` inā nalo a ʻaʻole pono ka hōʻoia i koi ʻia.
create.h2_b:

- `jwt` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona komo ma ke poʻomanaʻo `Authorization`.
- `refresh` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona hōʻano hou.
- `admin` — JWT nona nā koi i loaʻa iā `is_admin: ʻoiaʻiʻo`.
- `peer-signed` - noi i ke kino i pūlima ʻia e ke kī Ed25519 a kekahi hoa hilinaʻi.

userUnsuspend.h1_b: Noho ka mea hoʻohana no kēia ala i ka module pili ma lalo o `app/`. Hōʻike ʻia ke kumu ala `/api/admin/user/{id}/unsuspend` me `@router.post('/api/admin/user/{id}/unsuspend')`.
userUnsuspend.h1_c: Hoʻouna ʻia i kahi hoʻokuʻu mua Vortex ma ke ʻano he ʻāpana o ka hiki ke `unsuspend`.
userUnsuspend.h2_a: Pono: **admin**. ʻO ka middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` i ʻīpuka i kēia ala a hōʻole me `401 unauthenticated` inā nalo a ʻaʻole pono ka hōʻoia i koi ʻia.
userUnsuspend.h2_b:
- 'ʻaʻohe' - ʻaʻole i hōʻoia ʻia (pre-login).
- `jwt` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona komo ma ke poʻomanaʻo `Authorization`.
- `refresh` — Mea lawe JWT hōʻailona hōʻano hou.
- `admin` — JWT nona nā koi i loaʻa iā `is_admin: ʻoiaʻiʻo`.
- `peer-signed` - noi i ke kino i pūlima ʻia e ke kī Ed25519 a kekahi hoa hilinaʻi.
userUnsuspend.h2_c: Hōʻike ka ʻauth tier i ke kumu o ka pono liʻiliʻi: ua kaupalena ʻia nā helu hope ma mua o ke komo ʻana i ka hana ʻana a me ka hoʻihoʻi ʻana; ʻO nā mea a pau ma hope o kahi JWT ʻike i kahi mea hoʻohana maoli; Hōʻike nā ʻaoʻao hope i kahi hōʻailona ma ka UI no laila ʻike ʻia ka hoʻohana hewa ʻana.
userUnsuspend.h5_a: Vortex hoʻopaʻa hewa `{hewa, kūlana, ala}`. `401` ma nā palapala hōʻoia hewa; '403' no ka pono ʻole; `422` ma ka hōʻoia; '429' ma ka palena uku; '5xx' ma ka hewa kūloko.

roadmap.title: Palapala alanui
roadmap.subtitle: He aha ka mea i hoʻolālā ʻia a i ka wā hea.
roadmap.intro: Nānā kiʻekiʻe. ʻO nā lā i makemake nui ʻia; pilikia palekana pre-empt hiʻona hana.
roadmap.h1: v0.2 - hoʻokuʻu lua i ka lehulehu
roadmap.h1p1: Hoʻohana ʻia ʻo Kyber-768 PQ ma ka paʻamau ma nā hoʻouka hou.
roadmap.h1p2: Nā pūʻulu a hiki i 50 000 mau lālā me Variant-B kī paʻi.
roadmap.h1p3: Papakaukau (Tauri) hoʻopili no ka macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h1p4: Wehe ka mākeke Bot i nā hoʻouna lehulehu.
roadmap.h2p1: Kāhea ka hui leo-wale i 100 mau mea komo ma o SFU.
roadmap.h2p3: Hoʻomumu / kīkī i ke kelepona UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Kāpena Miro-like like ʻole ma luna o CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) ma o ka papa memo.
roadmap.h3p2: ʻO ka hele ʻana o ka cursor manawa maoli.
roadmap.h3p3: Hoʻokuʻu aku i PNG / SVG / PDF.
roadmap.h4p1: Escrow ma ke kaulahao no nā kūʻai bot (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Kaʻana kālā o ka mea hoʻohana, 10%% uku kahua.
roadmap.h4p3: Fiat on/off ramp ma o Stripe connect.
roadmap.h5p1: Ma luna aʻe o ka hoʻopaʻa ʻia, ka loiloi palekana maʻamau, kūkulu hou ʻia, SemVer maloʻo.
roadmap.h5p3: ʻO ka liʻiliʻi o hoʻokahi loiloi palekana kūʻokoʻa me ka palapala lehulehu.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 - hoʻokuʻu lua i ka lehulehu. ʻO Kyber PQ ma ke ʻano maʻamau, ʻoi aku ka nui o nā lumi lehulehu ma o Variant-B, nā pūʻolo papapihi Tauri, ka mākeke bot wehe.
roadmap.h1_b: ʻO Kyber-768 paʻamau no ka hoʻokomo hou ʻana; nā mea kūʻai aku me ke kākoʻo ʻole e hoʻohaʻahaʻa. Nā lumi a hiki i 50 000 lālā ma o Variant-B kī hoʻolaha — ʻaʻohe fanout no kēlā me kēia lālā i ka hoʻololi ʻana. ʻO Desktop (Tauri 2 wrapper a puni ka mea kūʻai pūnaewele) i paʻi ʻia no macOS, Windows, Linux me ka pūʻulu like. Wehe ʻia ka mākeke Bot i nā hoʻouna lehulehu me kahi loiloi 3-lā ʻoihana SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: ʻO v0.2 e pili ana i ka hoʻonui ʻana i nā mea kahiko ma mua o ka hana ʻana i nā mea hou. Aia ʻo Kyber ma ka palapala alanui; ʻo ka hoʻololi i ka paʻamau e pili ana i ke kūpaʻa ma lalo o ka ukana. Ua koho ʻia ʻo Tauri ma luna o Electron no ka mea ʻo ka pūʻolo he ~5 MB vs ~150 MB. Ua ālai ʻia nā palapala hoʻouna lehulehu ma ka mākeke Bot ma nā ʻōnaehana loiloi i pae i ka v0.1.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 — kahea hui. SFU nā pūʻulu leo ​​a hiki i 100; hui wikiō a hiki i 32; adaptive simulcast.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU i hoʻokō ʻia ma Rust no ka hana. Opus DTX + FEC + hoʻolele like ʻole no ka leo. VP9 L1/L2/L3 hoʻolele like ʻia no ka wikiō me ka SFU ʻohi ʻana i ka papa o ka mea nānā ma muli o ka loulou iho i hōʻike ʻia. Hoʻomumu a kīkī ka mea komo mai ka UI. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka hoʻopaʻa kelepona (ʻae ʻia, hoʻopaʻa ʻia) i hoʻopili ʻia ma lalo o kahi kī kumu no kēlā me kēia kelepona i kaʻana like ʻia ma waena o nā mea komo.
roadmap.h2_c: ʻO nā kelepona pūʻulu ka mea i noi nui ʻia mai ka v0.1 beta. SFU hoʻolālā ma muli o Jitsi Videobridge + Janus patterns. Rust ka hoʻokō ʻana ma mua o ka hoʻohana hou ʻana i ka mediasoup no ka mea ʻo Node.js runtime o mediasoup e hoʻohui i ka latency ʻaʻole mākou makemake ma ke ala wela.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 — kāwele hui pū. ʻO ka papa kaʻana like ʻo Miro ma luna o CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) ma o ka papa memo.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT palapala sync piggybacks ma nā memo lumi e noho nei. ʻO kēlā me kēia hoʻoponopono papa he hana CRDT i hoʻonohonoho ʻia ma ke ʻano he CBOR, i hoʻopili ʻia me ke kī lumi, i kau ʻia ma ke ʻano he ʻano:"board_op"`. Hoʻopau nā mea kūʻai aku, hoʻopili, hāʻawi. ʻO ka hele ʻana o ka cursor manawa maoli ma o ke ʻano memo ʻano ʻokoʻa:"board_cursor"`. E hoʻokuʻu aku i PNG / SVG / PDF ma o ka unuhi ʻana i ka canvas ʻaoʻao.
roadmap.h3_c: Ua lilo ʻo CRDTs (Shapiro et al. 2011) i mea hana-viable me Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Ua kūkulu kaulana ʻo Figma i kā lākou hui pū ʻana ma kahi ʻano like CRDT. ʻO ka manaʻo e hoʻohana hou i kā mākou papa memo i hoʻopili ʻia ma mua o ke kūkulu ʻana i nā kahawai WebSocket kaʻawale mai kahi kumu: liʻiliʻi nā ala kaʻa, liʻiliʻi nā pōpoki.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 — uku. Escrow ma ke kaulahao (Solana + EVM) + fiat on/off ramp ma o Stripe Connect.
roadmap.h4_b: Kūʻai ʻo Bot i ke ala ma o kahi ʻaelike escrow ma ke kaulahao. Apono ka mea kuai; 24 h kaohi; a laila hoʻokuʻu kālā i ka mea kūʻai aku me ka 10% uku kahua. Hele nā ​​hoʻopaʻapaʻa i nā mea hoʻoponopono kaiāulu i koho ʻia ma o staking. Fiat on-ramp: Nā moʻokāki Stripe Connect no ka mea hoʻohana a i ʻole ka mea kūʻai aku bot; off-ramp: hoʻoili panakō pololei a i ʻole USDC hoʻoholo. Kākoʻo Crypto: SOL, USDC, USDT ma Solana a me Ethereum.
roadmap.h4_c: He kahiko nā ʻaelike akamai Escrow (OpenBazaar 2016) akā paʻakikī a puni nā ʻaoʻao ma ke ʻano o UX. Vortex hoʻoili i ka paʻakikī akā hūnā ka hapa nui o ia mea - ʻike nā mea kūʻai i kahi pihi "kūʻai" maʻamau. ʻO ka 10 % ka uku paena e pili ana i nā hui ʻo App Store (ʻoiai ʻo Apple he 30 %); ʻO ka ʻoki haʻahaʻa e noʻonoʻo e huki i nā mea kūʻai aku.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 - kūpaʻa. ʻO ka loiloi palekana, kūkulu hou ʻia ma nā ʻanuʻu āpau, SemVer maloʻo.
roadmap.h5_b: Ua hoʻonohonoho ʻia ka loiloi ʻaoʻao ʻekolu ma mua o ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana i ka 1.0 - ʻo Trail of Bits a i ʻole NCC Pūʻulu e pili ana i nā ʻōlelo pāʻoihana. ʻO ke kūkulu hou ʻana, ʻo ia hoʻi ka kumu kumu hoʻokahi e hoʻopuka ai i nā binaries like-like ma nā mīkini kūkulu ʻelua; ʻike kēia i ka hoʻopili ʻana i ke kaulahao lako. ʻO SemVer frozen 'o ia hoʻi, loaʻa i nā kuʻina uea, ka papahana mālama, a me ka SDK ka lehulehu i nā hōʻoia hope-compat i loko o 1.x. Hoʻomaka ka polokalamu Bug bounty me kahi $25k kiʻekiʻe kiʻekiʻe no ka hoʻokō code mamao ma ka node.
roadmap.h5_c: ʻO ke kaʻina stabilise-audit-freeze ʻo ia ke kumu ʻo Signal, Tor, I2P, a me WireGuard i ukali ʻia. Ua lilo nā hale hana hou i mea nui ma hope o ka papahana Reproducible Builds (2014). Vortex hoʻohana i ka Reproducible Builds toolkit. He kūlana maʻamau nā makana bug no kēlā me kēia papahana e lawelawe ana i ka ʻikepili mea hoʻohana; ʻO $25k ka waena waena e nā kūlana 2025.
roadmap.h1_f:
v0.2 hoʻouna (i hoʻolālā ʻia):
  PQ hybrid default : ʻO Kyber-768 ma ke ʻano paʻamau
  lumi nui : Variant-B kī paʻi, a hiki i 50k lālā
  papapihi: Tauri 2 no macOS / Windows / Linux (~5 MB)
  hale kūʻai bot : nā hoʻouna lehulehu, loiloi 3 lā SLA
roadmap.h2_f:
v0.3 ka lawe ʻana (i hoʻolālā ʻia):
  SFU mīkini : Rust, hoʻohana hou i ka libwebrtc
  nā pūʻulu leo: ≤ 100 i komo, Opus simulcast
  pūʻulu wikiō : ≤ 32 poʻe komo, VP9 L1/L2/L3 hoʻokani pila
  hoʻopaʻa hoʻopaʻa ʻana: koho i loko, E2E-hoʻopili ʻia ma lalo o ke kī call_root
roadmap.h3_f:
v0.4 ka lawe ʻana (i hoʻolālā ʻia):
  canvas : Yjs-flavoured CRDT, piggyback ma nā memo lumi
  ʻano hana: CBOR{v:1, op_type, pahu hopu, uku uku}
  ka hele ʻana o ka cursor: kind="board_cursor", i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i 10 Hz
  hoʻokuʻu aku : ʻaoʻao kūʻai PNG / SVG / PDF
roadmap.h4_f:
v0.5 ka lawe ʻana (i hoʻolālā ʻia):
  escrow : Polokalamu Solana + EVM ʻaelike, 24 hola hoʻopaʻa
  uku paena: 10 % o ka nui
  fiat : Stripe Connect no ka mea kūʻai aku
  crypto : SOL, USDC, USDT ma Solana + Ethereum
  hoʻopaʻapaʻa : ka poʻe hoʻoponopono kaiāulu, koho pākēneka
roadmap.h5_f:
v1.0 hoʻouna (i hoʻolālā ʻia):
  hōʻoia palekana : Alahele o nā Bits a i ʻole NCC (Q3)
  kūkulu hou ʻia: kumu SHA256 → binary deterministic SHA256
  Hoʻokuʻu ʻia ʻo SemVer : protocol wire a me SDK API paʻa i loko o 1.x
  ka makana ʻino: $25k ka pae kiʻekiʻe no RCE ma ka node

glossary.title: Papa'ōlelo
glossary.subtitle: ʻO kēlā me kēia huaʻōlelo i hoʻohana ʻia ma nā Vortex docs, spelled out.
glossary.intro: Kuhikuhi huahelu. Hoʻonui ʻia kēlā me kēia kāleka huaʻōlelo i kahi wehewehe piha, kahi i hoʻohana ʻia ai, kona mōʻaukala, a me kahi ʻano a i ʻole ka laʻana inā pili.

aead.title: AEAD
aead.subtitle: Hoʻopiʻi ʻia me ka ʻikepili pili.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) he cryptographic primitive e hoʻohui i ka hūnā a me ka pololei i hoʻokahi kelepona. Hāʻawi ʻia i kahi kī, nonce, plaintext, a me nā ʻikepili pili i koho ʻia (AAD), hana ia i ka ciphertext + hōʻailona hōʻoia i hiki ʻole i ka hoʻololi ʻana i ka plaintext, ciphertext, a i ʻole AAD ka hōʻoia.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) he cryptographic primitive e hoʻohui i ka hūnā a me ka pololei i hoʻokahi kelepona. Hāʻawi ʻia i kahi kī, nonce, plaintext, a me nā ʻikepili pili i koho ʻia (AAD), hana ia i ka ciphertext + hōʻailona hōʻoia i hiki ʻole i ka hoʻololi ʻana i ka plaintext, ciphertext, a i ʻole AAD ka hōʻoia.
aead.h1_b: ʻO Vortexʻo AEAD he AES-256-GCM mau. ʻO ka AAD slot e lawe i ka pōʻaiapili e pono i ka mea loaʻa ke ʻike e wehe pololei (room id, file id, offset). ʻO ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana AAD pale i ka hoʻihoʻi hou ʻana i ke ʻano ʻokoʻa — ʻaʻole hiki ke wehe ʻia kahi ciphertext mai ka lumi A ma ke ʻano he lumi B.
aead.h1_c: ʻO AEAD ma ke ʻano he inoa kahiko i kapa ʻia iā Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) ua hoʻohālikelike ʻia e NIST ma SP 800-38D (2007). Ua lilo i mea paʻamau AEAD ma TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Hoʻohana kēlā me kēia protocol palekana hou i kahi AEAD.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc(k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, lepe) // ct = len(pt) paita, tag = 16 paita
AEAD.Dec(k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt a i ʻole ⊥
aead.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

alembic.title: ʻAlembic
alembic.subtitle: Mea hana hoʻoneʻe waihona no SQLAlchemy.
alembic.intro: ʻO Alembic ka ʻōnaehana neʻe canonical no SQLAlchemy. ʻO kēlā me kēia neʻe ʻana he faila Python me nā hana `upgrade()` a me `downgrade()` e wehewehe ana i nā hoʻololi schema ma ke ʻano he SQL a i ʻole ORM hana.
alembic.h1_a: ʻO Alembic ka ʻōnaehana neʻe canonical no SQLAlchemy. ʻO kēlā me kēia neʻe ʻana he faila Python me nā hana `upgrade()` a me `downgrade()` e wehewehe ana i nā hoʻololi schema ma ke ʻano he SQL a i ʻole ORM hana.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex hoʻohana iā Alembic me ka mōʻaukala hoʻoponopono laina (ʻaʻohe lālā). Holo ʻo 'alembic upgrade head' i kēlā me kēia pahu Docker e hoʻomaka. Hoʻihoʻi ka 'alembic downgrade -1' i hoʻokahi ʻanuʻu no ka rollback. Hoʻohana ke ʻano Dev i ka `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` no laila ʻaʻole pono ka hoʻololi kūloko i nā neʻe i kēlā me kēia rebase.
alembic.h1_c: Ua kākau ʻia ʻo Alembic e Mike Bayer (mea kākau o SQLAlchemy) i ka makahiki 2011 ma ke ʻano he mea pani i ka `sqlalchemy-migrate`. Ua hōʻaiʻē ʻo Django's built-in migration (2014) i ke kumu hoʻohālike. Ua noho mua ʻo Alembic ma nā hiʻohiʻona — rollback, autogenerate, branching — ʻoiai ʻaʻole hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i nā lālā.
alembic.h1_f:
alembic/versions/
  20240101_<revision>_<slug>.py kēlā me kēia me ka upgrade()/downgrade()
alembic.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

apns.h1_a: ʻO nā APN ka Apple ka lawelawe hoʻolaha hoʻolaha no iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Hoʻopaʻa inoa nā polokalamu i kahi hōʻailona hāmeʻa a hoʻouna nā mea hoʻolako i nā uku hoʻolaha i nā APN e hoʻolaha iā lākou i nā polokalamu.
apns.h1_b: Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i nā APN me nā envelopes i hoʻopaʻa ʻia: hoʻopili ka node i kēlā me kēia uku hoʻolaha no ka X25519 pubkey a ka mea loaʻa; ʻIke wale nā ​​APN i kahi opaque blob. argon2id.title: Argon2id
argon2id.subtitle: Hash password paʻakikī (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: ʻO Argon2id kahi hana hashing password me ka paʻakikī me ka ʻaoʻao. Nā ʻāpana: ka nui hoʻomanaʻo (m), ke kumu kūʻai manawa (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), a me ka lōʻihi hash. Hoʻohui ka ʻano 'id' i ka data-independent (Argon2i) a me ka data-dependent (Argon2d) pass.
argon2id.h1_a: ʻO Argon2id kahi hana hashing password me ka paʻakikī me ka ʻaoʻao. Nā ʻāpana: ka nui hoʻomanaʻo (m), ke kumu kūʻai manawa (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), a me ka lōʻihi hash. Hoʻohui ka ʻano 'id' i ka data-independent (Argon2i) a me ka data-dependent (Argon2d) pass.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex hoʻohana iā Argon2id me m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32. Lawe kēia i ~ 0.5 s ma kahi iPhone X (kā mākou mea kākoʻo lohi loa) a ma kahi o 5 ms ma kahi kiʻekiʻe ASIC - ʻaʻole hiki ke hoʻohālikelike ʻia ka wikiwiki 100x i hoʻohālikelike ʻia me nā hashes e pili ana i ka SHA-256 kahi i lanakila ai nā ASIC e nā miliona.
argon2id.h1_c: Ua lanakila ʻo Argon2 i ka 2015 Password Hashing Competition i hoʻonohonoho ʻia e Dmitry Khovratovich lāua ʻo Alex Biryukov. Hoʻohana ʻia e like me RFC 9106 i 2021. Hoʻohana ʻia e 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Mai ka OWASP 2023 nā ʻōkuhi.
argon2id.h1_f:
Argon2id(ʻōlelo huna, paʻakai, m, t, p, hashLen) → hash
paʻamau: m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32
kumukūʻai ≈ 0.5s ma iPhone X; ~5ms ma ASIC (100× ka wikiwiki o ka mea hoʻouka kaua)
argon2id.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

blake3.title: BLAKE3
blake3.subtitle: Hash cryptographic wikiwiki.
blake3.intro: ʻO BLAKE3 kahi hana hash cryptographic i iho mai BLAKE2 a me BLAKE. Hoʻopuka i ka hoʻopuka arbitrary-lōʻihi mai ka hoʻokomo arbitrary; ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o 10× ma mua o SHA-256 ma nā pōpō nui me ka hashing lāʻau i loko.
blake3.h1_a: ʻO BLAKE3 kahi hana hash cryptographic i iho mai BLAKE2 a me BLAKE. Hoʻopuka i ka hoʻopuka arbitrary-lōʻihi mai ka hoʻokomo arbitrary; ʻOi aku ka wikiwiki o 10× ma mua o SHA-256 ma nā pōpō nui me ka hashing lāʻau i loko.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex hoʻohana i ka BLAKE3 no ka paʻa o ka waihona: lawe ʻia kēlā me kēia faila i ka `plain_blake3` hash o kāna ʻike decrypted i hiki i nā mea loaʻa ke hōʻoia ma hope o ka hoʻoiho + decrypt. Ua kapa ʻia ke kolamu DB ʻo `sha256` no ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i ka neʻe ʻana akā aia ka BLAKE3 pukana.
blake3.h1_c: Ua hoʻokuʻu ʻia ʻo BLAKE3 e Jack O'Connor et al. i ka makahiki 2020. Ua iho mai ka BLAKE, he SHA-3 ka mea hope loa i ka makahiki 2012. Hāʻawi ka hoʻolālā lāʻau-hashing i ka BLAKE3 unahi me nā cores no nā hoʻokomo nui. ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki o SHA-256 no nā hoʻokomo liʻiliʻi; BLAKE3 mana ma luna o kekahi mea > 4 KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bytes) = 32 bytes // puka paʻamau
BLAKE3(bytes, len) = len bytes (XOF)
ka puka ʻana: ~3 GB/s ma Apple Silikon vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s
blake3.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

bmp.title: BMP
bmp.subtitle: Palekana pahu leta makapō.
bmp.intro: ʻO BMP ka papa inoa inoa ʻole o Vortex hale kūʻai-a-mua. Hoʻouna nā mea hoʻouna i nā blobs i hoʻopili ʻia ma kekahi node i hiki i ka haʻihaʻi, i kī ʻia e kahi hash hoʻokahi o ka pubkey o ka mea loaʻa. Holo ʻo Blobs i ka ʻōlelo ʻino a hiki i ka huki ʻana o ka node o ka mea hoʻokipa.
bmp.h1_a: ʻO BMP ka papa inoa inoa ʻole o Vortex hale kūʻai-a-mua. Hoʻouna nā mea hoʻouna i nā blobs i hoʻopili ʻia ma kekahi node i hiki i ka haʻihaʻi, i kī ʻia e kahi hash hoʻokahi o ka pubkey o ka mea loaʻa. Holo ʻo Blobs i ka ʻōlelo ʻino a hiki i ka huki ʻana o ka node o ka mea hoʻokipa.
bmp.h1_b: Hāʻawi ʻo BMP i ʻekolu mau waiwai pilikino kūʻokoʻa: huna hoʻouna (TLS + onion koho), huna huna (mailbox_id he opaque i nā node waena), huna ʻike (ua E2E-hoʻopili ʻia ka blob). ʻO ka blob nui 1 MB, pāpale node 500 MB, ka helu hoʻopaʻa 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: Ua hoʻolālā ʻia ʻo BMP mai ka wā ʻōpala e ka hui Vortex. Ua kūkulu mākou iā ia no ka mea ʻaʻohe ʻelele nui i makemake e uku i ke kumukūʻai ʻenehana no ka hūnā ʻana i ka metadata hope-a-hope - hoʻopili lākou i ka ʻike akā leʻaleʻa i ka pakuhi kaiapili. ʻO kā mākou kūlana mai ka lā hoʻokahi, he ʻelele palekana e hoʻoheheʻe i ka mea-kamaʻilio-ʻo ia ka hapalua palekana. Hoʻopau ʻo BMP i kēlā hapalua ma ka hoʻolilo ʻana i ka mea hoʻouna, ka mea loaʻa, a me ka ʻike i ka opaque kūʻokoʻa, ma luna o ko Vortex mesh ponoʻī ʻaʻole i hoʻopaʻa ʻia.
bmp.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
bmp.h3_a: ʻōlelo ʻino, lawelawe ʻonika, hoʻouna i hoʻopaʻa ʻia, Pond

cbor.title: CBOR
cbor.subtitle: Hōʻike i nā mea Binary Concise.
cbor.intro: ʻO CBOR (RFC 8949) he palapala ʻikepili binary i hoʻolālā ʻia no ka nui code liʻiliʻi a me ka hoʻopili wikiwiki. Superset o ka JSON kŘkohu ikepili, binary-encoded, strictly deterministic.
cbor.h1_a: ʻO CBOR (RFC 8949) he palapala ʻikepili binary i hoʻolālā ʻia no ka nui code liʻiliʻi a me ka hoʻopili wikiwiki. Superset o ka JSON kŘkohu ikepili, binary-encoded, strictly deterministic.
cbor.h1_b: Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i ka CBOR ma ke ʻano he hōʻano uku i loko o nā envelope AES-GCM. ~30 % liʻiliʻi ma mua o JSON ma ke kamaʻilio unicode-kaumaha; ʻO ka parsing koʻikoʻi (ʻaʻohe keʻokeʻo keʻokeʻo) e kūʻē i ka hoʻouka ʻana i ka parser-differential attacks; schema-free no laila ʻaʻole pono ka hoʻohui ʻana i kahi kahua i kahi .proto recompilation.
cbor.h1_c: Ua hoʻohālikelike ʻia ka CBOR e like me RFC 7049 ma 2013, hōʻano hou ʻia i RFC 8949 i 2020. Hoʻohana ʻia e Signal (ka hoʻopili ʻana i loko mai ka makahiki 2017), Matrix's state-resolution object, WebAuthn (attestation). Koho ʻia e Vortex ma v0.0.2 ma hope o ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana me JSON a me protobuf.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR hoʻopāpā: {major_type (3 bits), hoʻopaʻapaʻa (5 bits), [ʻikepili]}
palapala 'āina: type=5 pairs
array: ʻano=4 mau mea
kikokikona: type=3 bytes
bytes: ʻano=2 raw
cbor.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
cbor.h2_a: ʻO kēlā me kēia envelope memo, kēlā me kēia hoʻopaʻa hoʻopaʻa paʻa, kēlā me kēia envelope hui.

controller.title: Mea hooponopono
controller.subtitle: Vortex's hōʻoia + lawelawe ʻike.
controller.intro: He kaʻina Python kaʻawale ka mea hoʻoponopono (`vortex_controller`) nona ka hana wale nō ke paʻi ʻana i ka hōʻike pūlima (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) a me nā URL komo. Hoʻopaʻa nā mea kūʻai aku i ka Ed25519 pubkey o ka mea hoʻoponopono i ka manawa hoʻokuʻu.
controller.h1_a: He kaʻina Python kaʻawale ka mea hoʻoponopono (`vortex_controller`) nona ka hana wale nō ke paʻi ʻana i ka hōʻike pūlima (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) a me nā URL komo. Hoʻopaʻa nā mea kūʻai aku i ka Ed25519 pubkey o ka mea hoʻoponopono i ka manawa hoʻokuʻu.
controller.h1_b: Hōʻike i kahi ʻili liʻiliʻi API (~12 ala). Ua noʻonoʻo ka ʻili haiki - ʻo ia ka pahuhopu hoʻouka kaua kiʻekiʻe loa i ka wā e paʻi ai nā mea kūʻai aku. Holo nā aniani i ke code like me ke kī hoʻokuʻu like; DNS/SNS/IPFS hoʻopuka i nā papa inoa o nā aniani.
controller.h1_c: Hoʻokomo ʻia ma v0.0.3 ma hope o ka mana monolith mua i hoʻopaʻa ʻia i ka hōʻoia node i ka node ponoʻī (hiki i kahi node hoʻohālikelike ke wahaheʻe e pili ana i kāna code ponoʻī). Ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i ka hōʻoia i loko o kahi kaʻina kaʻawale i hoʻohālike ʻia ma hope o Debian's Release.gpg + hale kūʻai kumu o Chrome.
controller.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

doubleRatchet.title: ʻAi ʻAilua
doubleRatchet.subtitle: ʻO ka hōʻailona no ka-DM i mua-maluna protocol.
doubleRatchet.intro: Hoʻohui ka Double Ratchet i kahi ratchet Diffie-Hellman me kahi kaulahao kiʻi symmetric. Hoʻonui kēlā me kēia leka i kāna kaulahao; DH nā latike maʻamau e kī hou i ke kumu. Hāʻawi i kahi huna huna (palekana nā memo i hala ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻapaʻa ʻana) a me ka palekana ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana (palekana nā memo e hiki mai ana ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻa hou ʻana).
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Hoʻohui ka Double Ratchet i kahi ratchet Diffie-Hellman me kahi kaulahao kiʻi symmetric. Hoʻonui kēlā me kēia leka i kāna kaulahao; DH nā latike maʻamau e kī hou i ke kumu. Hāʻawi i kahi huna huna (palekana nā memo i hala ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻapaʻa ʻana) a me ka palekana ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana (palekana nā memo e hiki mai ana ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻa hou ʻana).
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i ʻelua Ratchet no nā kaulahao memo pololei. Hoʻohana nā lumi hui i kahi hoʻolālā kī hoʻouna maʻalahi i kī ʻia mai ke kumu o ka lumi. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka lōʻihi o ke kaulahao ma 1000 mau leka ma mua o ka hoʻihoʻi hou ʻana; hoʻokuʻu ʻia-key cache a hiki i 1000 out-of-order messages; paʻamau ka hoʻopunipuni poʻomanaʻo.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Hoʻolālā ʻia e Trevor Perrin lāua ʻo Moxie Marlinspike ma 2013; kau ʻia ma Signal 2014; apono ʻia e WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Secret Conversations, Skype Private Conversations. Public spec 2016. ʻO ka hoʻokō ʻana o Vortex he awa pololei.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
kaulahao hoʻouna: CK_send → HKDF(CK_send, "step") → CK_send'
                    MK → HKDF(CK_send, "msg")
kaulahao loaʻa: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "step") → CK_recv'
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(kou_eph, their_eph), RK_prev)
doubleRatchet.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
doubleRatchet.h3_a: hūnā i mua, palekana ma hope o ka hoʻopaʻapaʻa ʻana, X25519

ech.title: ECH
ech.subtitle: Aloha ka mea kūʻai hoʻopunipuni (RFC 9460).
ech.intro: ECH hūnā i ka SNI (Server Name Indication) ma TLS 1.3 ma ke kāʻei ʻana i ka ClientHello i loko i loko o kahi ClientHello waho i hoʻopili ʻia ma lalo o kahi kī lehulehu i paʻi ʻia ma ka moʻolelo DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_a: ECH hūnā i ka SNI (Server Name Indication) ma TLS 1.3 ma ke kāʻei ʻana i ka ClientHello i loko i loko o kahi ClientHello waho i hoʻopili ʻia ma lalo o kahi kī lehulehu i paʻi ʻia ma ka moʻolelo DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_b: Vortex nodes e hoʻopuka i nā ECHConfigs ma kā lākou DNS HTTPS moʻolelo. Hoʻohana nā mea kūʻai me ke kākoʻo ECH i ka inoa hoʻokipa o waho (e laʻa. `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) e like me ka SNI ʻike ʻia; ʻike wale ka poʻe nānā paʻa i kēlā inoa waho maʻamau. ʻAʻole hiki iā DPI ke haʻi aku i kahi mea kūʻai Vortex mai kekahi mea kūʻai Cloudflare ʻē aʻe.
ech.h1_c: Ua hele ʻo ECH i 5 IETF kiʻi ma mua o ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana e like me RFC 9460 i 2024. Nā ʻano like ʻole mua: ESNI (2018-2019, haʻalele ʻia), ECH draft-00 i ka draft-12 (20240-13 (20240). Ua hoʻohana ʻo Chrome i ka ECH ma ka paʻamau i 2023; ʻO Firefox ma 2024. Kākoʻo ʻo Vortex iā ia mai ka v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
waho SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← ʻike ʻia e nā mea nānā
i loko SNI: "node.vortex.example" ← i hoʻopili ʻia
ECHConfig: paʻi ʻia ma DNS HTTPS moʻolelo o ka waihona waho
ech.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

ed25519.title: Ed25519
ed25519.subtitle: Pulima EdDSA ma luna o edwards25519 (RFC 8032).
ed25519.intro: ʻO Ed25519 kahi papa inoa elliptic-curve. 32-byte kī lehulehu, 64-byte pūlima, deterministic pūlima ma ka paʻamau. ʻO ka hōʻoia wikiwiki (~ 200 µs ma kahi CPU hou), hiki ke hōʻoia i ka hui.
ed25519.h1_a: ʻO Ed25519 kahi papa inoa elliptic-curve. 32-byte kī lehulehu, 64-byte pūlima, deterministic pūlima ma ka paʻamau. ʻO ka hōʻoia wikiwiki (~ 200 µs ma kahi CPU hou), hiki ke hōʻoia i ka hui.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex hōʻailona i kēlā me kēia envelop hui, kēlā me kēia hōʻike pono, kēlā me kēia node hōʻoia, a me kēlā me kēia memo bot me Ed25519. Hoʻohana ʻo Apple's CryptoKit ma iOS 17+ i ka ʻano like ʻole RFC 8032bis; ʻAe ʻo Vortex i kēlā me kēia - ʻo kekahi mea hōʻoia kūpono e lawelawe i nā mea ʻelua.
ed25519.h1_c: Ua paʻi ʻia ʻo Ed25519 e Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang i ka makahiki 2011. Hoʻohālikelike ʻia e like me RFC 8032 i 2017. Apono ʻia e OpenSSH 6.5 (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple-pro Keychain. Ua koho ʻia ka pūlima deterministic ma luna o ECDSA i mea e pale aku ai i ka ECDSA RNG-hoohana hou i ka papa haʻahaʻa.
ed25519.h1_f:
Hōʻailona(d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m)
              R = r · G
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m)
              S = r + c · a
              hoʻi (R, S)
E hōʻoia: c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
ed25519.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
ed25519.h3_a: X25519, ECDSA, pūlima, hūnā i mua

fanout.title: Fan-waho
fanout.subtitle: Ka hoʻolaha ʻana i kahi hanana mai kahi kumu i nā mea kākau inoa he nui.
fanout.intro: ʻO Fan-out ke kumu hoʻolālā kahi e hoʻopuka ai kekahi mea hana i kahi hanana a loaʻa iā N nā mea kūʻai aku. Ma ka papa Vortex WebSocket, hoʻokahi memo POST hoʻāla i ke kumu N e hoʻouna - hoʻokahi no ka mea kākau ma ka lumi.
fanout.h1_a: ʻO Fan-out ke kumu hoʻolālā kahi e hoʻopuka ai kekahi mea hana i kahi hanana a loaʻa iā N nā mea kūʻai aku. Ma ka papa Vortex WebSocket, hoʻokahi memo POST hoʻāla i ke kumu N e hoʻouna - hoʻokahi no ka mea kākau ma ka lumi.
fanout.h1_b: Hoʻokō ʻia ma ke ʻano he lumi pākahi o WebSocket lima i kiaʻi ʻia e kahi asyncio.Lock. Kākau i loaʻa, kope i ka hoʻonohonoho, hoʻokuʻu, a laila hoʻihoʻi hou i ke kope e kali ana i ka `ws.send_bytes(payload)` me ka pau ʻana o ka manawa 1 s. Loaʻa i nā mea kūʻai lohi he 256-frame queue ma mua o ka hāʻule ʻana o nā papa.
fanout.h1_c: Hoʻi hou ʻo Fan-out e hoʻopuka/kau inoa i nā ʻōnaehana i ka makahiki 1980 (POP, TIBCO). ʻO nā hoʻolālā hou (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) e hoʻonui i ke kumu i nā miliona o nā mea kākau inoa. Vortex ʻaʻole liʻiliʻi loa ka fan-out hoʻomanaʻo no kēlā me kēia lumi no ka mea ʻaʻole pono ia i ka hoʻopili hou ʻana i ke ʻano ma ke ʻano node hoʻokahi; Hoʻomaka ka Redis pub/sub i nā pūʻulu node lehulehu.
fanout.h1_f:
hoʻolaha (room_id, uku uku):
  subs = fanout[room_id] # O(1) dict lookup
  no ka ws ma ke kiʻi (subs): # kope e hoʻomaʻamaʻa pono
      e kali i ws.send_bytes(kaumaha, manawa pau=1s)

fanout.h2_a: `app/chats/fanout.py`, ke ala wela loa no kēlā me kēia memo, ka pane ʻana, ka hanana paʻi ʻana, ka hōʻailona kelepona.

fcm.title: FCM
fcm.subtitle: ʻO ka memo ʻo Firebase Cloud.
fcm.intro: FCM ʻo Google ka lawelawe hoʻolaha hoʻolaha no Android, iOS, pūnaewele. Ua hoʻololi i ka Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) kahiko i ka makahiki 2016. ʻAe ʻo OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_a: FCM ʻo Google ka lawelawe hoʻolaha hoʻolaha no Android, iOS, pūnaewele. Ua hoʻololi i ka Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) kahiko i ka makahiki 2016. ʻAe ʻo OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_b: Vortex hoʻohana i ka FCM ma ke ʻano `data` (ʻaʻole `notification` mode) no laila e holo ka FirebaseMessagingService o ka polokalamu i ka hōʻea ʻana a hoʻokaʻawale i ka uku hoʻopaʻa i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma mua o ka hoʻoholo ʻana inā e hōʻike i kahi hae. Hoʻohana pū ʻia nā memo ʻikepili FCM i nā ala hoʻopuka hāmau.
fcm.h1_c: Ua hoʻokuʻu ʻia ʻo FCM i ka makahiki 2016 e pani ana i ka GCM. Ua hoʻopau ʻia ka hoʻoilina HTTP hope ma 2024; Vortex hoʻohana i ka HTTP v1 hope me OAuth2. Hoʻololi ʻia ka hoʻololi ʻana i nā hōʻailona i kēlā me kēia hola ma o nā hōʻoiaʻiʻo lawelawe lawelawe.
fcm.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
fcm.h3_a: Nā APN, Push Web, pahu i sila, OAuth2

federation.title: Huihui
federation.subtitle: Hāʻawi ʻia ka memo hilinaʻi ma waena o nā node kūʻokoʻa Vortex.
federation.intro: ʻO ka Federation kahi pilina hilinaʻi ma waena o nā mea hoʻohana node ʻelua. Hoʻohui kēlā me kēia i ka Ed25519 pubkey a kekahi i kāna papaʻaina 'federations'. Hiki i nā mea hoʻohana ma ka node A ke hoʻouna aku i nā mea hoʻohana ma ka node B ma ka hoʻokele ʻana i nā envelopp ma o kahi `POST /federation/deliver` i pūlima ʻia.
federation.h1_a: ʻO ka Federation kahi pilina hilinaʻi ma waena o nā mea hoʻohana node ʻelua. Hoʻohui kēlā me kēia i ka Ed25519 pubkey a kekahi i kāna papaʻaina 'federations'. Hiki i nā mea hoʻohana ma ka node A ke hoʻouna aku i nā mea hoʻohana ma ka node B ma ka hoʻokele ʻana i nā envelopp ma o kahi `POST /federation/deliver` i pūlima ʻia.
federation.h1_b: E koho i ka mea hoʻohana: ʻaʻohe "node hiki ke hoʻohui" paʻamau. Pono ka hoʻohui ʻana i kahi hoa i kahi hana hoʻokele i kau inoa ʻia e ka mea hoʻohana. Hoʻomaha nā helu olakino (AIMD ±1) i ka hui ʻana i nā hoa hana kolohe. ʻAʻole i hāʻawi ʻia ka hoʻopuka hou ʻana o ka pahu pahu me ka hoʻihoʻi nui ʻana a hiki i 14 lā.
federation.h1_c: ʻO Federation ka Matrix's killer hiʻona (2014) a ma mua o kēlā XMPP/Jabber (1999). Hoʻolālā ʻia ka hoʻolālā o Vortex mai ʻelua: nā envelopp i pūlima ʻia (Matrix), nā heleuma hilinaʻi maopopo (ʻaʻole hoʻi — ʻoi aku ka koʻikoʻi), nā helu olakino (AIMD mai TCP). Hoʻohui ʻia ma v0.0.5.
federation.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

fts5.title: FTS5
fts5.subtitle: ʻO ka papaʻaina virtual huli kikokikona piha o SQLite.
fts5.intro: FTS5 ʻo ia ka hoʻonui ʻimi kikokikona piha o SQLite. Hoʻokumu i kahi papa ʻaina e mālama ai i nā ʻōlelo kuhikuhi no nā nīnau wikiwiki LIKE / MATCH.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 ʻo ia ka hoʻonui ʻimi kikokikona piha o SQLite. Hoʻokumu i kahi papa ʻaina e mālama ai i nā ʻōlelo kuhikuhi no nā nīnau wikiwiki LIKE / MATCH.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex hōʻike i nā hōʻailona kikokikona maʻemaʻe (i hoʻopili ʻia e ka mea kūʻai aku e like me nā hōʻailona opaque) i loko o kahi papa ʻaina FTS5 no laila e paʻi ka ʻimi iā `O(log n)` ma kahi o `O(n)` scans. Ma ka lumi o Android, hoʻohana ʻia ka FTS4 me nā mea hoʻokalakupua e mālama i ka papa ʻaina virtual i ka sync. Hoʻohana ʻia nā hoʻolaha ʻo Postgres i ka 'tsvector' / `tsquery' no ke kumu like.
fts5.h1_c: FTS hoʻi i SQLite 3.7 (2010). FTS5 i hoʻouna ʻia ma SQLite 3.9 (2015). Hoʻohana nui ʻia; Ke hoʻohana nei kēlā me kēia polokalamu leka uila ma IOS / Android. Ua loaʻa iā Postgres 'tsvector' mai 8.3 (2008).
fts5.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

gossip.title: Gossip
gossip.subtitle: Hoʻololi papa inoa hoa ma waena o Vortex nodes.
gossip.intro: ʻO Gossip kahi protocol e pono ai ka bandwidth kahi e hoʻololi ai kēlā me kēia node i kēlā me kēia manawa i ka ʻike i hōʻuluʻulu ʻia me kahi hoa like ʻole. I ka wā lōʻihi, hoʻohuli ʻia kēlā me kēia node i ka nānā like me ka ʻole o kahi papa kuhikuhi kikowaena.
gossip.h1_a: ʻO Gossip kahi protocol e pono ai ka bandwidth kahi e hoʻololi ai kēlā me kēia node i kēlā me kēia manawa i ka ʻike i hōʻuluʻulu ʻia me kahi hoa like ʻole. I ka wā lōʻihi, hoʻohuli ʻia kēlā me kēia node i ka nānā like me ka ʻole o kahi papa kuhikuhi kikowaena.
gossip.h1_b: ʻO Vortex nodes e ʻōlelo ʻino i kēlā me kēia 60 kekona. ʻO kēlā me kēia hoʻololi he kānana Bloom 256-bit e hōʻuluʻulu ana i nā hoa i ʻike ʻia; pane ka ʻaoʻao ʻē aʻe me nā hoa nalo mai ka kānana me kāna kānana ponoʻī. ʻO O (nā hoa hou × 32 B), ma lalo o 1 KiB no kēlā me kēia pōʻai.
gossip.h1_c: Bloom-filter gossip lā i ka Cornell's 1998 bimodal multicast pepa. Hoʻohana ʻo Apache Cassandra iā ia no ka lālā; Bitcoin no ka hoʻokuʻu ʻana i ke kālepa; IPFS no ka DHT mālama. ʻO ka convergence O(log N) ka mea e hana pono ai no nā ʻupena nui.
gossip.h1_f:
hoʻololi (A, B):
  A → B: kānana_A = insert_all(peers_A, k=5, m=256)
  B → A: new_peers_for_A = {p ∈ peers_B : p ∉ kānana_A}, kānana_B
  He unuhi like
palena palena: 1 hoʻololi i kēlā me kēia hoa no 30 mau kekona
gossip.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

gravitix.title: Gravitix
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex DSL no ke kākau ʻana i nā bots.
gravitix.intro: ʻO Gravitix he ʻōlelo kikoʻī kikowaena i hoʻolālā ʻia no ke kākau ʻana i nā bots Vortex. Nā mea hoʻokele hanana hanana (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), i kūkulu ʻia i loko, ʻuʻuku liʻiliʻi. Hoʻopili ʻia i bytecode a holo i loko o kahi unuhi ʻōlelo sandboxed.
gravitix.h1_a: ʻO Gravitix he ʻōlelo kikoʻī kikowaena i hoʻolālā ʻia no ke kākau ʻana i nā bots Vortex. Nā mea hoʻokele hanana hanana (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), i kūkulu ʻia i loko, ʻuʻuku liʻiliʻi. Hoʻopili ʻia i bytecode a holo i loko o kahi unuhi ʻōlelo sandboxed.
gravitix.h1_b: ʻOkoʻa i ka Python SDK. Gravitix ʻaʻole hiki i nā bots ke komo i ka ʻōnaehana waihona a i ʻole ka pūnaewele hoʻopaʻa ʻole — ʻo Vortex wale nō ka API ʻili. Hoʻopuka ʻo Compiler i ka bytecode; ka Rust manawa holo ma `Gravitix/` wehewehe. Kuhikuhi piha ma ka mokuna Gravitix docs.
gravitix.h1_c: Hoʻolālā ʻia i ka wā v0.0.6 ma hope o ka ʻike ʻana ʻo ka hapa nui o nā code bot he 80 % SDK boilerplate a puni kahi kernel liʻiliʻi o ka loiloi maoli. Hiki i ka DSL ke alohilohi a me ka pilikia o ka pahu one. Ua like ka manaʻo me Hubot (2011) akā me ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i ka sandboxing a me ka Vortex hoʻohui.
gravitix.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
gravitix.h2_a: `Gravitix/` repo aʻa, pahu code field ma `POST /api/bots`.
gravitix.h3_a: bot, wahi kuai, pahu one, Architex

hkdf.title: HKDF
hkdf.subtitle: HMAC-hoʻokumu i ka hana hoʻoili kī (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: ʻO HKDF kahi hana hoʻopuka kī ʻelua ʻanuʻu: Hoʻoemi ʻo Extract i ka mea kī hoʻokomo i loko o kahi kī pseudo-random (PRK); Hoʻolahalaha ʻo Expand i ka PRK i loko o nā mea kī puka o kēlā me kēia lōʻihi, i hoʻokaʻawale ʻia e nā lepili ʻike.
hkdf.h1_a: ʻO HKDF kahi hana hoʻopuka kī ʻelua ʻanuʻu: Hoʻoemi ʻo Extract i ka mea kī hoʻokomo i loko o kahi kī pseudo-random (PRK); Hoʻolahalaha ʻo Expand i ka PRK i loko o nā mea kī puka o kēlā me kēia lōʻihi, i hoʻokaʻawale ʻia e nā lepili ʻike.
hkdf.h1_b: Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i ka HKDF-SHA256 ma nā wahi a pau: ka hoʻokaʻawale ʻana i ka X25519 i nā mea huna i loko o ka hoʻopunipuni + MAC + kī poʻomanaʻo, e kiʻi ana i nā kī file per-chunk, e kiʻi ana i nā kī hoʻihoʻi mai Argon2id output. Lawe mau nā kaula ʻike i kahi prefix mana (e laʻa. "v1: encryption") no laila hiki ke hoʻololi i ka hierarchy kī holoʻokoʻa ma ke kuʻi ʻana i ka v1 → v2.
hkdf.h1_c: Hoʻopuka ʻia e Hugo Krawczyk ma EUROCRYPT 2010; hoʻohālikelike ʻia ʻo RFC 5869 i ka makahiki hoʻokahi. Hoʻohana ʻia e TLS 1.3 no kāna papa manawa, hōʻailona no Double Ratchet, WireGuard no nā kī kau.
hkdf.h1_f:
Unuhi: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(paakai, IKM)
Hoʻonui: T(1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, ʻike ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ ʻike ∥ i)
          OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ … ʻoki ʻia i len
hkdf.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

hmac.title: HMAC
hmac.subtitle: Code hōʻoia memo ma ka Hash (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: ʻO HMAC kahi hana e hoʻololi ai i kekahi hash cryptographic (SHA-256, SHA-512) i MAC. Hāʻawi i ka pono a me ka hōʻoia i hāʻawi ʻia i kahi huna huna.
hmac.h1_a: ʻO HMAC kahi hana e hoʻololi ai i kekahi hash cryptographic (SHA-256, SHA-512) i MAC. Hāʻawi i ka pono a me ka hōʻoia i hāʻawi ʻia i kahi huna huna.
hmac.h1_b: Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i ka HMAC-SHA256 ma HKDF, no nā pūlima JWT (HS256), no ka hoʻouna_pseudo derivation i loko o nā lumi, a no ka coturn TURN hōʻoia. Pono ka hoʻohālikelike manawa mau ma ka ʻaoʻao hōʻoia - `hmac.compare_digest` ma Python.
hmac.h1_c: Ua hoʻolauna ʻia ʻo HMAC e Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk i ka makahiki 1996. Hoʻohālikelike ʻia ʻo RFC 2104 (1997) a me FIPS 198 (2002). Ua lilo i MAC paʻamau ma TLS, IPsec, SSH. Hoʻohana ka hōʻailona, ​​Matrix, Discord, Slack i ka HMAC-SHA256 no kā lākou JWT a me nā hōʻailona hālāwai.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(ki, msg) = H( (ki ⊕ opad) ∥ H( (ki ⊕ ipad) ∥ msg ) )
  kahi opad = 0x5c i hana hou ʻia, ipad = 0x36 i hana hou ʻia, like ka nui o ka poloka H
hmac.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
hmac.h2_a: Ma nā wahi a pau o ka waihona crypto. Grep no `hmac_sha256` a i ʻole `HKDF`.
hmac.h3_a: HKDF, JWT, SHA-256, hoʻohālikelike manawa mau

ice.title: ICE
ice.subtitle: Hoʻokumu Hoʻohui Kūkākūkā (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ʻO ICE ke ʻano WebRTC no ka ʻimi ʻana i kahi ala pūnaewele ma waena o nā hoa ʻelua ma hope o NAT. E helu ana nā hoa i nā moho (host, server-reflexive, relay), hoʻololi iā lākou, a hoʻāʻo pālua a lanakila kekahi.
ice.h1_a: ʻO ICE ke ʻano WebRTC no ka ʻimi ʻana i kahi ala pūnaewele ma waena o nā hoa ʻelua ma hope o NAT. E helu ana nā hoa i nā moho (host, server-reflexive, relay), hoʻololi iā lākou, a hoʻāʻo pālua a lanakila kekahi.
ice.h1_b: Vortex's node brokers ICE hoʻololi moho ma o WebSocket hōʻailona. Hāʻawi ʻo coturn i STUN (no ka ʻike srflx) a me TURN (no ka relay inā hāʻule nā ​​ala pololei). Hāʻawi ʻia nā hōʻoia HMAC pōkole i kēlā me kēia kelepona.
ice.h1_c: Ua hoʻohālikelike ʻia ʻo ICE e like me RFC 5245 (2010) a hōʻano hou ʻia e like me RFC 8445 (2018). Ma hope o ka papa lawe NAT, hāʻule nā ​​ala pololei ~15 % o ka manawa — ʻaʻole hiki ke ʻalo ʻia ka relay TURN. WebRTC hana ʻia ICE ka mana nui; ke hoʻohana nei kēlā me kēia huahana kelepona wikiō.
ice.h1_f:
nā moho:
  mea hoʻokipa : rtp://192.168.1.5:49152 (kaiakahi IP)
  srflx : rtp://203.0.113.5:49152 (STUN-heluhelu lehulehu i ʻike ʻia)
  relay : rtp://turn.vortex:49153 (TURN-hoʻokuʻu ʻia)
nānā paʻa: STUN Noi Hoʻopaʻa; lua mua i lanakila = koho ʻia
ice.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
ice.h3_a: WebRTC, TURN, STUN, huli, NAT hele wāwae

jwt.title: JWT
jwt.subtitle: JSON Pūnaewele Pūnaewele (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: ʻO JWT kahi hōʻailona hōʻailona paʻa i loaʻa i ʻekolu mau ʻāpana base64-url-encoded: header, payload (claims), signature. Hoʻohana ʻia no ka hōʻoia ʻana o ke kau mokuʻāina.
jwt.h1_a: ʻO JWT kahi hōʻailona hōʻailona paʻa i loaʻa i ʻekolu mau ʻāpana base64-url-encoded: header, payload (claims), signature. Hoʻohana ʻia no ka hōʻoia ʻana o ke kau mokuʻāina.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex hoʻohana HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) JWTs. Loaʻa i ka hōʻailona komo `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, type: access, exp}`, 15 min TTL. Hōʻailona hōʻailona `type: hōʻano hou`, 30 d TTL. Kau inoa ma luna o kahi huna 64-byte mai '.env`. ʻAʻohe koi koʻikoʻi ma mua o user_id.
jwt.h1_c: Ua hoʻohālikelike ʻia nā JWT e like me RFC 7519 (2015). Ua hoʻolaha ʻo OAuth 2.0 iā lākou mai ka makahiki 2012. He ʻumi makahiki o ka hoʻohewa ʻana: alg-confusion attacks, nele o ka hoʻopau ʻana. Vortex hoʻēmi: HS256 wale nō (ʻaʻohe RS/ES huikau), jti kī kiʻi kiʻi (hiki ke hoʻihoʻi ʻia ma o user_devices).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE
poʻo = base64url({alg: "HS256", type: "JWT"})
uku uku = base64url({sub, jti, typ, exp})
sig = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(huna, poʻo + "." + uku uku))
jwt.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, hōʻailona hōʻano hou, hōʻailona komo

kyber.title: Kyber-768
kyber.subtitle: Hoʻopili kī hope-kuantum (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: ʻO Kyber-768 (ma ka inoa ML-KEM-768) ʻo ia ka NIST i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma hope-quantum key encapsulation mechanical. Nā kī lehulehu 1184-byte, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte nā mea huna. Hoʻemi ka palekana i Module-LWE, manaʻoʻiʻo quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_a: ʻO Kyber-768 (ma ka inoa ML-KEM-768) ʻo ia ka NIST i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ma hope-quantum key encapsulation mechanical. Nā kī lehulehu 1184-byte, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte nā mea huna. Hoʻemi ka palekana i Module-LWE, manaʻoʻiʻo quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex hoʻohana iā Kyber ma ke koho ʻana i loko o kahi hybrid: `session_key = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1")`. Inā paʻa ka hapalua, palekana ke kau. E koho i ka v0.1, i hoʻolālā ʻia no v0.2. Uku: ~2 KB keu no ka lulu lima; haʻahaʻa haʻahaʻa.
kyber.h1_c: ʻO Kyber kekahi o ~70 hoʻouna i ka NIST's PQ hoʻokūkū (2016). Koho ʻia no ka hoʻohālikelike ʻana i Iulai 2022; hoʻopau ʻia ʻo FIPS 203 i ʻAukake 2024. Ua hoʻohana ʻo Chrome i ka hybrid Kyber ma TLS 1.3 i 2024. Hoʻohui ʻia ka hōʻailona i kā lākou protocol i kēlā makahiki.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Hoʻopili(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Decaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶
hybrid = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, "kau-v1")
kyber.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
kyber.h3_a: X25519, HKDF, kūpaʻa kuantum, hybrid KEM

mailbox.title: pahu leta
mailbox.subtitle: Ua ʻōlelo ʻia ka pahu waiho i ka mea loaʻa ma BMP.
mailbox.intro: ʻO ka pahu leta kahi unuhi a BMP no "kahi kahi e kali ai nā memo no ka mea lawe". ʻIke ʻia e kahi `mailbox_id` 32-byte i loaʻa mai ka pubkey o ka mea hoʻokipa ma o HKDF.
mailbox.h1_a: ʻO ka pahu leta kahi unuhi a BMP no "kahi kahi e kali ai nā memo no ka mea lawe". ʻIke ʻia e kahi `mailbox_id` 32-byte i loaʻa mai ka pubkey o ka mea hoʻokipa ma o HKDF.
mailbox.h1_b: ʻO ka mea hoʻouna wale nō (ka mea i ʻike i ka recipient_pubkey) a me ka mea loaʻa (ʻo ia ka mea i ʻike i kā lākou pubkey ponoʻī) hiki ke helu i kahi mailbox_id i hāʻawi ʻia. ʻIke ʻia nā node waena i ka mea ʻike 32-byte opaque. Loaʻa i kēlā me kēia pahu leta TTL 7200 s a me ka pāpale mālama 500 MB i kēlā me kēia node.
mailbox.h1_c: No ka leka uila maʻamau ka huaʻōlelo. BMP ʻaiʻē i ka ʻōlelo hoʻohālikelike akā hana i ka pahu leta i loaʻa ma mua o ka mea i hoʻolako ʻia e ka server - ʻaʻohe hana "hoʻokumu pahu leta", ʻaʻohe kikowaena e ʻike i nā helu wahi.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(recipient_pubkey, info="bmp-v1", len=32)
ʻO ka mea hoʻouna wale nō (ʻike i ka recipient_pk) a me ka mea loaʻa (ʻike iā ia iho pk) hiki ke helu
mailbox.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
mailbox.h3_a: BMP, ʻōhumu, HKDF, mea hoʻouna i sila

nonce.title: ʻAʻole
nonce.subtitle: Helu hoʻohana hoʻokahi — he waiwai hoʻohana hoʻokahi manawa.
nonce.intro: ʻO ka nonce kahi waiwai ʻaʻole pono e hana hou ma lalo o kahi kī i hāʻawi ʻia. Ma Vortex kēlā me kēia hana AES-GCM hoʻohana i ka 96-bit random nonce. ʻO ka hoʻohana hou ʻana i kahi nonce me ke kī like e hoʻopau i ka hūnā a me ka ʻoiaʻiʻo - hiki i ka mea hoʻouka me nā ciphertext ʻelua ma lalo o ka like (ki, nonce) hiki ke hoʻihoʻi i nā XORs plaintext.
nonce.h1_a: ʻO ka nonce kahi waiwai ʻaʻole pono e hana hou ma lalo o kahi kī i hāʻawi ʻia. Ma Vortex kēlā me kēia hana AES-GCM hoʻohana i ka 96-bit random nonce. ʻO ka hoʻohana hou ʻana i kahi nonce me ke kī like e hoʻopau i ka hūnā a me ka ʻoiaʻiʻo - hiki i ka mea hoʻouka me nā ciphertext ʻelua ma lalo o ka like (ki, nonce) hiki ke hoʻihoʻi i nā XORs plaintext.
nonce.h1_b: Hoʻopuka ʻo Vortex i nā nonces me ka OS CSPRNG (`secrets.token_bytes`, `SecRandom`, `java.security.SecureRandom`). Hoʻopaʻa ʻia ka lā hānau me 96 bits: ~2^32 mau memo ma mua o ka hiki ʻana o ka hui ʻana ke kūpono, ʻoi aku ka nui ma mua o nā kī lumi i ʻike ʻia i kona wā e ola ana. ʻO ka hoʻopaʻa ʻana i ka lua-nonce ma ka node ma ke ʻano he kāʻei-a-hoʻopaʻa.
nonce.h1_c: ʻO ka manaʻo nonce he mea kahiko i ka cryptography; ʻO ka huaʻōlelo ponoʻī mai ka Old English "no ka manawa". No NIST SP 800-38D ka mana'o 96-bit a GCM. Ua hoʻihoʻi maikaʻi ʻia ka haʻihaʻi ʻana o Adobe 2013 i ka plaintext mai nā nonces mau ma ka ʻaoʻao o ka mea kūʻai aku RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P(kuʻi) ma 10⁹ AES-GCM nonces = ~10⁻¹⁹
ka lā hānau: ka hui mua i manaʻo ʻia ma kahi o 2⁴⁸ nonces no kēlā me kēia kī
GCM palekana: 2³² nonces maʻamau no kēlā me kēia kī ma mua o ka hoʻohaʻahaʻa ʻana
nonce.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
nonce.h2_a: ʻO kēlā me kēia AES-GCM kelepona. Hoʻopaʻa paʻa ka helu helu ma `app/security/crypto.py`.

ohttp.title: OHTTP
ohttp.subtitle: Oblivious HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: ʻO OHTTP kahi protocol no nā noi HTTP i hoʻokuʻu ʻia kahi ʻaʻohe ʻaoʻao e ʻike i ka noi a me ka pane. Hoʻouna ka mea kūʻai ma o ka relay e kāʻili i nā poʻomanaʻo; holo ka relay i ka ʻīpuka nāna e wehe a pane.
ohttp.h1_a: ʻO OHTTP kahi protocol no nā noi HTTP i hoʻokuʻu ʻia kahi ʻaʻohe ʻaoʻao e ʻike i ka noi a me ka pane. Hoʻouna ka mea kūʻai ma o ka relay e kāʻili i nā poʻomanaʻo; holo ka relay i ka ʻīpuka nāna e wehe a pane.
ohttp.h1_b: Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i ka OHTTP ma ke ʻano he hāʻule huna huna Layer-5. Hoʻohui pū ʻia me ka lawelawe ʻonika a me BMP, hāʻawi ʻo OHTTP i kahi ala hoʻomaha hope loa ke paʻa loa ʻia ʻo TLS. He pāʻina hoʻokaʻawale hilinaʻi ka relay (maʻa mau Cloudflare a i ʻole Apple ʻoihana pilikino-relay).
ohttp.h1_c: Ua hoʻohālikelike ʻia ʻo OHTTP e like me RFC 9458 i ka makahiki 2024, i kākau pū ʻia e Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla. ʻO Apple's iCloud Private Relay (2021) kahi hoʻolālā mua OHTTP-e pili ana. Vortex hoʻohui OHTTP kākoʻo fallback ma v0.0.9.
ohttp.h1_f:
mea kūʻai → hoʻokuʻu: Encrypt_gateway_pub(noi) + ʻike ala ala ʻole
relay → puka: i mua, wehe i nā poʻomanaʻo e ʻike ana i ka mea kūʻai aku
puka → pane: wehe, kaʻina hana, Encrypt_client_pub(pane)
relay → mea kūʻai: pane i mua
ohttp.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

onion.title: lawelawe ʻonika
onion.subtitle: lawelawe huna Tor.
onion.intro: He lawelawe TCP ka lawelawe ʻonika ma o ka protocol rendezvous Tor. Hoʻomaopopo ʻia e kahi helu aniani (56-character base32 o kahi Ed25519 pubkey ma v3). ʻAʻohe IP lehulehu, ʻaʻohe DNS, ʻaʻohe papa inoa kikowaena.
onion.h1_a: He lawelawe TCP ka lawelawe ʻonika ma o ka protocol rendezvous Tor. Hoʻomaopopo ʻia e kahi helu aniani (56-character base32 o kahi Ed25519 pubkey ma v3). ʻAʻohe IP lehulehu, ʻaʻohe DNS, ʻaʻohe papa inoa kikowaena.
onion.h1_b: ʻO kēlā me kēia Vortex node e hōʻike iā ia iho he `.onion` a me kona HTTPS maʻamau. Hāʻule nā ​​mea kūʻai aku me ke kākoʻo ʻo Tor i ka aniani ke pau nā mea ʻē aʻe. ʻO ka Bandwidth he ~ 10 × lohi akā hiki ke loaʻa i loko o nā pūnaewele paʻa paʻa.
onion.h1_c: ʻO nā lawelawe Onion i hoʻi i Tor 2004 (v1). Hoʻokumu hou ʻia e like me nā lawelawe aniani v3 ma 2017 me nā kī Ed25519. Hoʻohana ʻia e SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, nā hui crypto-aware nui. Hoʻohui ʻia ka hōʻailona i ka hāʻawi ʻana i ka lawelawe onion i 2022.
onion.h1_f:
helu wahi = base32(Ed25519_pubkey ∥ checksum ∥ version_byte) ∥ ".onion"
          = 56 mau huaʻōlelo ma v3 aniani
onion.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
onion.h2_a: ʻ/etc/tor/torrc` i ka `deploy/`, i paʻi ʻia ma o ka mea hoʻoponopono ʻ/v1/mirrors`.
onion.h3_a: Tor, Snowflake, BMP, hiki ke hoʻokomo

prekey.title: Prekey
prekey.subtitle: Ephemeral pubkey i paʻi ʻia ma mua o ka manawa no ka bootstrap o nā DM hou.
prekey.intro: ʻO ka prekey kahi kī X25519 i paʻi ʻia ma ka node ma mua o ka pono i hiki ai i nā mea hoʻopili hou ke hoʻomaka i nā kamaʻilio hoʻopili ʻia me ka ʻole o ka huakaʻi. Hoʻouka kēlā me kēia mea hoʻohana i kahi pūʻulu (10 prekeys ma ka paʻamau); lawelawe ke kikowaena iā lākou ma ke koi; hoʻouka hou aku ka mea kūʻai aku i ka wā haʻahaʻa.
prekey.h1_a: ʻO ka prekey kahi kī X25519 i paʻi ʻia ma ka node ma mua o ka pono i hiki ai i nā mea hoʻopili hou ke hoʻomaka i nā kamaʻilio hoʻopili ʻia me ka ʻole o ka huakaʻi. Hoʻouka kēlā me kēia mea hoʻohana i kahi pūʻulu (10 prekeys ma ka paʻamau); lawelawe ke kikowaena iā lākou ma ke koi; hoʻouka hou aku ka mea kūʻai aku i ka wā haʻahaʻa.
prekey.h1_b: Hoʻopaʻa inoa ʻia ka puʻupuʻu prekey a Vortex e ke kī ʻike lōʻihi o ka hāmeʻa no laila ʻaʻole hiki i ka mea hoʻouka ke hoʻololi i nā prekey i hoʻopaʻa ʻia me ke komo ʻana i ka pae node. Hoʻohana nā DM hou i kahi Diffie-Hellman puni hoʻokahi e kūʻē i kahi prekey hou ma mua o ka hoʻomaka ʻana o ka Double Ratchet.
prekey.h1_c: No ka hoʻolālā protocol 2013 o Signal (X3DH). Ma mua o X3DH, koi ʻia ka bootstrap i hoʻopili ʻia i nā huakaʻi hele like ʻole - ʻino no ka memo asynchronous. Ke hoʻohana nei kēlā me kēia ʻelele palekana hou i kahi bootstrap kāhua prekey.
prekey.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
prekey.h3_a: X25519, ʻOi ʻelua, X3DH, hoʻololi kī

reality.title: ʻOiaʻiʻo
reality.subtitle: TLS-i loko-TLS masquerade i ka lawe aihue.
reality.intro: ʻO ka ʻoiaʻiʻo, he kaʻa malū ia e hoʻopili ʻia me TLS i kahi kumu ʻenehana nui maoli (maʻamau www.microsoft.com). Nā pahu lima lima waho Microsoft; ʻO Vortex ka lima lima o loko. Hoʻouna ʻia nā ʻimi hoʻoikaika ma waho i ke kumu maoli no laila ʻaʻohe mea e hōʻike ʻia e ka hoʻāʻo ʻana.
reality.h1_a: ʻO ka ʻoiaʻiʻo, he kaʻa malū ia e hoʻopili ʻia me TLS i kahi kumu ʻenehana nui maoli (maʻamau www.microsoft.com). Nā pahu lima lima waho Microsoft; ʻO Vortex ka lima lima o loko. Hoʻouna ʻia nā ʻimi hoʻoikaika ma waho i ke kumu maoli no laila ʻaʻohe mea e hōʻike ʻia e ka hoʻāʻo ʻana.
reality.h1_b: Kākoʻo ʻo Vortex i ka Reality ma ke ʻano he transport pluggable Level-4. Hōʻike ʻo Config i ka pahuhopu masquerade, nā ID pōkole, a me ke kī lehulehu Vortex X25519. Hoʻopaʻa ke kikowaena i nā mea kūʻai mai e ka hoʻokūkū pōkole-ID; loaʻa nā ʻimi like ʻole i nā pane kumu maoli.
reality.h1_c: Ua paʻi ʻia ka ʻoiaʻiʻo i ka makahiki 2022 ma ke ʻano he pane i ka Great Firewall ʻo Kina e ʻike ana i nā halihali TLS ma mua (V2Ray's VMess, Trojan). Apono ʻia e XrayCore i ka makahiki 2023. Vortex i kākoʻo i ka v0.0.9.

lulu lima waho: TLS i Microsoft, SNI=www.microsoft.com
i loko (inā ʻae ʻia): Vortex kaʻa ma luna o kahi kahawai ʻikepili
pane ʻimi: pane ʻia ʻo Microsoft.com maoli i ka mea hoʻouka
                    ⇒ ʻike wale ka mea nānā "ʻae, ʻo microsoft.com"

rbac.title: RBAC
rbac.subtitle: Mana Hoʻonaʻauao Kūlana Kūlana.
rbac.intro: ʻO RBAC he kumu hoʻohālike e ʻae ʻia i nā kuleana a hāʻawi ʻia nā mea hoʻohana i nā kuleana. Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i ʻekolu papa RBAC i kēlā me kēia lumi: mea nona > luna > lālā.
rbac.h1_a: ʻO RBAC he kumu hoʻohālike e ʻae ʻia i nā kuleana a hāʻawi ʻia nā mea hoʻohana i nā kuleana. Hoʻohana ʻo Vortex i ʻekolu papa RBAC i kēlā me kēia lumi: mea nona > luna > lālā.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: Loaʻa i nā mea nona kēlā me kēia mana admin a me ka mana kūʻokoʻa e holoi i ka lumi a i ʻole e hoʻololi i ka kuleana. Kāhea nā luna, kīkī, ʻūlū, hoʻoponopono i nā hoʻonohonoho lumi. Hoʻouna nā lālā i nā memo, pane, hoʻoponopono i kā lākou mau memo. Hoʻopaʻa ʻia nā hoʻololi kuleana e like me nā memo ʻōnaehana i ʻike kēlā me kēia lālā iā lākou.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC ma ke ʻano he kumu hoʻohālike maʻamau i ka NIST ka pepa 1992 na Ferraiolo & Kuhn. Ua lilo i mea nui ma ka ʻoihana IAM (AWS, Azure) i nā makahiki 2010. He kūlana maʻamau ʻo RBAC pae lumi lumi i nā huahana kamaʻilio — IRC's ops/leo/mea hoʻohana (1988), Discord's roles (2015), Slack's admin/member/guest.
rbac.h1_f:
kuleana: haku ⊃ luna ⊃ lālā
hoʻoili: hoʻonoho ka mea nona ka new_owner_id → ka mea kahiko i hoʻemi ʻia i luna
hoʻopau: hiki i ke admin ke hoʻohaʻahaʻa i kekahi lālā; hiki i ka mea nona ke hoʻemi i ka luna
rbac.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex
rbac.h2_a: `room_members.role`, nānā ʻia i kēlā me kēia ala kākau ma o `app/chats/permissions.py`.

sfu.title: SFU
sfu.subtitle: Waena Hoʻouna koho.
sfu.intro: ʻO ka SFU kahi pahu waena e hoʻohui i ka media i nā kelepona hui. Hoʻouka kēlā me kēia mea komo i hoʻokahi kahawai; hoʻouna ka SFU iā ia i nā poʻe ʻē aʻe. Hoʻololi i ka topology mesh piha (e hoʻopili ana kēlā me kēia hoa i nā kahawai N-1) kahi ʻo O(N²).
sfu.h1_a: ʻO ka SFU kahi pahu waena e hoʻohui i ka media i nā kelepona hui. Hoʻouka kēlā me kēia mea komo i hoʻokahi kahawai; hoʻouna ka SFU iā ia i nā poʻe ʻē aʻe. Hoʻololi i ka topology mesh piha (e hoʻopili ana kēlā me kēia hoa i nā kahawai N-1) kahi ʻo O(N²).
sfu.h1_b: Hoʻokō ʻia ka Vortex SFU ma Rust no ka hana. Simulcast-aware: hoʻopili kēlā me kēia mea kelepona i ʻekolu mau ʻōlelo hoʻoholo i ka manawa like; koho ka SFU i ka mea kūpono no kēlā me kēia loulou iho i hōʻike ʻia e ka mea nānā. Nā pūʻulu leo ​​wale nō a hiki i 100 mau mea komo; hui wikiō a hiki i 32 (v0.3 palapala alanui).
sfu.h1_c: SFU nā lā hoʻolālā i Jitsi's Videobridge (2013). Ma mua o ka SFU, WebRTC nā kelepona hui i piha mesh. Zoom, Google Hui, Jitsi, Kāhea pūʻulu hōʻailona e hoʻohana i ka SFU. Vortex pūʻulu leo-wale nō i hoʻouna ʻia ma v0.0.8.
sfu.h1_f:
mesh piha (N hoa): hoʻouna kēlā me kēia i nā kahawai N-1 → O(N²) uplink
SFU (N hoa): hoʻouna kēlā me kēia i 1 kahawai → O(N) uplink no kēlā me kēia hoa
simulcast: L1 (haʻahaʻa) + L2 (waena) + L3 (kiʻekiʻe) hoʻopāpā like
SFU koho i ka papa no ka mea nana ma muli o BWE-i hōʻike ʻia i lalo loulou
sfu.h2: Ma hea i hoʻohana ʻia ma Vortex

snowflake.title: Huli hau
snowflake.subtitle: ʻO ka lawe manawaleʻa-relay Tor ma luna o WebRTC.
snowflake.intro: ʻO Snowflake ka mea hiki ke hoʻopili ʻia ʻo Tor Project kahi e hana ai nā mea hoʻokele manawaleʻa ma ke ʻano he WebRTC relays. Hoʻokomo nā mea hoʻohana i ka hoʻonui ʻia ʻana o ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele a lilo kā lākou polokalamu kele i mea hoʻokuʻu i ka wā e wehe ʻia ana kahi pā.
snowflake.h1_a: ʻO Snowflake ka mea hiki ke hoʻopili ʻia ʻo Tor Project kahi e hana ai nā mea hoʻokele manawaleʻa ma ke ʻano he WebRTC relays. Hoʻokomo nā mea hoʻohana i ka hoʻonui ʻia ʻana o ka polokalamu kele pūnaewele a lilo kā lākou polokalamu kele i mea hoʻokuʻu i ka wā e wehe ʻia ana kahi pā.
snowflake.h1_b: ʻAe ʻo Vortex iā Snowflake ma ke ʻano he Layer-4 fallback ke ālai ʻia ʻo TLS a me nā kaʻa mua. ʻAʻohe infra i koi ʻia ma ko mākou ʻaoʻao - pono mākou i nā alahaka Snowflake i paʻi ʻia ma nā wahi kaulana. Volunteers running the extension provide cover.
snowflake.h1_c: Ua hoʻokuʻu ʻia ʻo Snowflake i 2020 ma ke ʻano he pani o Tor Project no ka obfs4 (i hiki ke hiki i ka manamana lima). He paʻakikī ke kaʻa ʻana o ka WebRTC no ka mea, ʻo ka hana ʻana pēlā e wāwahi ai i nā kelepona wikiō kūpono. Vortex kākoʻo hou i ka v0.0.9.

client → Snowflake broker: "I need a proxy"

mea manawaleʻa → komo Tor: hoʻouna i mua i nā mea kūʻai aku ma luna o WebRTC
